local function buildRoof(root: Instance)
	local f = folder("05_RoofAndRooftopEquipment", root)

	-- Sàn mái bê tông (kết cấu chịu lực -> không gắn máu ẩn)
	box(f, "RoofSlab", Vector3.new(BX1 - BX0 + 0.4, 0.8, BZ1 - BZ0 + 0.4), Vector3.new((BX0 + BX1) * 0.5, ROOF_TOP - 0.4, (BZ0 + BZ1) * 0.5), C.CONCRETE, M.Concrete, nil, nil, nil, { castShadow = false })

	-- Mũ chụp bờ tường (coping) 4 cạnh
	local copGrp = "LSC_ParapetCoping"
	box(f, "CopingSouth", Vector3.new(BX1 - BX0 + 1.6, 0.5, WT + 0.9), Vector3.new((BX0 + BX1) * 0.5, PARAPET_TOP + 0.25, BZ1 - WT * 0.5), C.CONCRETE, M.Concrete, 220, copGrp, 1)
	box(f, "CopingNorth", Vector3.new(BX1 - BX0 + 1.6, 0.5, WT + 0.9), Vector3.new((BX0 + BX1) * 0.5, PARAPET_TOP + 0.25, BZ0 + WT * 0.5), C.CONCRETE, M.Concrete, 220, copGrp, 1)
	box(f, "CopingWest", Vector3.new(WT + 0.9, 0.5, BZ1 - BZ0 - 2.4), Vector3.new(BX0 + WT * 0.5, PARAPET_TOP + 0.25, (BZ0 + BZ1) * 0.5), C.CONCRETE, M.Concrete, 220, copGrp, 1)
	box(f, "CopingEast", Vector3.new(WT + 0.9, 0.5, BZ1 - BZ0 - 2.4), Vector3.new(BX1 - WT * 0.5, PARAPET_TOP + 0.25, (BZ0 + BZ1) * 0.5), C.CONCRETE, M.Concrete, 220, copGrp, 1)

	-- 3 cụm điều hoà rooftop (giàn nóng + quạt + ống gas)
	for i, hp in ipairs({ { -252.0, 18.0 }, { -196.0, 34.0 }, { -238.0, 40.0 } }) do
		local x, z = hp[1], hp[2]
		local grp = "LSC_RooftopHVAC" .. tostring(i)
		box(f, "HVACPad" .. i, Vector3.new(11.0, 0.5, 7.0), Vector3.new(x, ROOF_TOP + 0.25, z), C.CONCRETE_DARK, M.Concrete, 200, grp .. "_Pad", 1)
		box(f, "HVACBody" .. i, Vector3.new(10.0, 4.6, 6.0), Vector3.new(x, ROOF_TOP + 2.8, z), C.GALV, M.Metal, 260, grp .. "_Body", 2)
		box(f, "HVACTop" .. i, Vector3.new(10.4, 0.4, 6.4), Vector3.new(x, ROOF_TOP + 5.3, z), C.STEEL, M.Metal, 180, grp .. "_Top", 3)
		-- quạt giàn nóng
		local fanZ = z - 3.15
		cyl(f, "HVACFan" .. i, Vector3.new(0.4, 4.6, 4.6), CFrame.new(x, ROOF_TOP + 2.8, fanZ) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0), C.DARK_STEEL, M.Metal, 120, grp .. "_Fan", 3)
		for bl = 1, 4 do
			local ang = (bl - 1) * math.pi * 0.5
			box(
				f,
				"HVACFanBlade" .. i .. "_" .. bl,
				Vector3.new(0.3, 3.6, 1.2),
				Vector3.new(x, ROOF_TOP + 2.8 + math.cos(ang) * 1.7, fanZ + math.sin(ang) * 1.7),
				C.GALV,
				M.Metal,
				60,
				grp .. "_Fan",
				4,
				{ canCollide = false, castShadow = false }
			)
		end
		-- ống môi chất chạy xuống
		strut(f, "HVACLine" .. i, Vector3.new(x + 4.4, ROOF_TOP + 1.2, z), Vector3.new(x + 4.4, ROOF_TOP - 0.4, z + 5.0), 0.34, C.CHROME, M.Metal, 70, grp .. "_Line", 2)
	end

	-- 2 giếng trời kính + khung thép
	for i, pos in ipairs({ { -262.0, 4.0 }, { -176.0, 4.0 } }) do
		local grp = "LSC_Skylight" .. tostring(i)
		box(f, "SkylightCurb" .. i, Vector3.new(11.0, 1.4, 11.0), Vector3.new(pos[1], ROOF_TOP + 0.7, pos[2]), C.CONCRETE, M.Concrete, 240, grp .. "_Curb", 1)
		box(f, "SkylightGlass" .. i, Vector3.new(10.2, 0.25, 10.2), Vector3.new(pos[1], ROOF_TOP + 1.5, pos[2]), C.GLASS_BLUE, M.Glass, 40, grp .. "_Glass", 2, {
			transparency = 0.45,
			canCollide = false,
			castShadow = false,
		})
		for _, d in ipairs({ { 5.3, 0 }, { -5.3, 0 }, { 0, 5.3 }, { 0, -5.3 } }) do
			box(f, "SkylightBar" .. i .. tostring(d[1]) .. tostring(d[2]), Vector3.new(if d[1] == 0 then 11.4 else 0.4, 0.35, if d[2] == 0 then 11.4 else 0.4), Vector3.new(pos[1] + d[1], ROOF_TOP + 1.6, pos[2] + d[2]), C.DARK_STEEL, M.Metal, 60, grp .. "_Bar", 3, { canCollide = false })
		end
	end

	-- Buồng cầu thang xuống mái (stair bulkhead) + cửa thép
	local bx, bz = -186.0, -2.0
	box(f, "BulkheadBody", Vector3.new(13.0, 9.0, 10.0), Vector3.new(bx, ROOF_TOP + 4.5, bz), Color3.fromRGB(168, 164, 156), M.Concrete, 320, "LSC_Bulkhead", 1)
	box(f, "BulkheadRoof", Vector3.new(13.8, 0.5, 10.8), Vector3.new(bx, ROOF_TOP + 9.2, bz), C.CONCRETE_DARK, M.Concrete, 200, "LSC_BulkheadRoof", 2)
	box(f, "BulkheadDoor", Vector3.new(4.6, 8.0, 0.4), Vector3.new(bx, ROOF_TOP + 4.0, bz + 5.2), C.DARK_STEEL, M.Metal, 180, "LSC_BulkheadDoor", 2)
	box(f, "BulkheadDoorBar", Vector3.new(4.2, 0.35, 0.5), Vector3.new(bx, ROOF_TOP + 4.4, bz + 5.5), C.CHROME, M.Metal, 90, "LSC_BulkheadDoor", 3, { canCollide = false })
	box(f, "BulkheadLamp", Vector3.new(1.2, 0.35, 0.5), Vector3.new(bx, ROOF_TOP + 8.4, bz + 5.2), C.NEON_WHITE, M.Neon, 25, "LSC_BulkheadLamp", 1, { canCollide = false, castShadow = false })

	-- Ống thông hơi + quạt hút gió thải
	for i, vx in ipairs({ -256.0, -246.0, -220.0, -210.0 }) do

local function railingRun(parent: Instance, name: string, a: Vector3, b: Vector3, group: string)
	local d = b - a
	local len = d.Magnitude
	local dir = d.Unit
	local posts = math.max(2, math.floor(len / 5.0) + 1)
	for i = 0, posts - 1 do
		local alpha = if posts <= 1 then 0 else i / (posts - 1)
		local p = a + d * alpha
		local g = "LSC_Rail_" .. name .. "_post" .. tostring(i)
		box(parent, "RailPost" .. name .. "_" .. i, Vector3.new(0.18, 4.2, 0.18), Vector3.new(p.X, a.Y + 2.1, p.Z), C.DARK_STEEL, M.Metal, 70, g, 1, { canCollide = false })
	end
	strut(parent, "RailTop" .. name, Vector3.new(a.X, a.Y + 4.1, a.Z), Vector3.new(b.X, b.Y + 4.1, b.Z), 0.22, C.DARK_STEEL, M.Metal, 90, "LSC_Rail_" .. name .. "_top", 2, { canCollide = false })
	strut(parent, "RailMid" .. name, Vector3.new(a.X, a.Y + 2.4, a.Z), Vector3.new(b.X, b.Y + 2.4, b.Z), 0.16, C.DARK_STEEL, M.Metal, 70, "LSC_Rail_" .. name .. "_mid", 2, { canCollide = false })
	strut(parent, "RailKick" .. name, Vector3.new(a.X, a.Y + 0.35, a.Z), Vector3.new(b.X, b.Y + 0.35, b.Z), 0.2, C.YELLOW, M.Metal, 60, "LSC_Rail_" .. name .. "_kick", 1, { canCollide = false })
end

	box(f, "Whiteboard", Vector3.new(11.0, 5.4, 0.22), Vector3.new(-262.0, MEZZ_TOP + 5.6, -7.0), C.WHITE, M.SmoothPlastic, 55, og .. "_Whiteboard", 1)
	box(f, "WhiteboardFrame", Vector3.new(11.6, 6.0, 0.12), Vector3.new(-262.0, MEZZ_TOP + 5.6, -7.12), C.GALV, M.Metal, 40, og .. "_WhiteboardFrame", 1, { canCollide = false })
	box(f, "PrinterBody", Vector3.new(3.0, 2.2, 2.6), Vector3.new(-253.0, MEZZ_TOP + 1.3, -5.0), C.GALV, M.Metal, 60, og .. "_Printer", 1)
	box(f, "PrinterTray", Vector3.new(2.6, 0.3, 1.2), Vector3.new(-253.0, MEZZ_TOP + 2.5, -4.2), C.DARK_STEEL, M.Metal, 25, og .. "_Printer", 2, { canCollide = false })
	vcyl(f, "OfficePlantPot", Vector3.new(2.2, 2.0, 2.0), Vector3.new(-269.0, MEZZ_TOP + 1.1, 7.5), Color3.fromRGB(126, 88, 66), M.Concrete, 60, og .. "_Plant", 1)
	ball(f, "OfficePlantLeaf", 3.4, Vector3.new(-269.0, MEZZ_TOP + 3.4, 7.5), Color3.fromRGB(52, 104, 58), M.Grass, 35, og .. "_Plant", 2)

	-- Kho phụ tùng mezzanine + góc nghỉ nhân viên
	for u = 1, 2 do

		local grp = "LSC_MezzShelf" .. tostring(u)
		box(f, "MezzShelfPostA" .. u, Vector3.new(0.3, 9.0, 2.2), Vector3.new(x0, MEZZ_TOP + 4.5, 2.0), C.STEEL, M.Metal, 170, grp .. "_PostA", 1)
		box(f, "MezzShelfPostB" .. u, Vector3.new(0.3, 9.0, 2.2), Vector3.new(x0 + 9.5, MEZZ_TOP + 4.5, 2.0), C.STEEL, M.Metal, 170, grp .. "_PostB", 1)
		for s = 1, 3 do
			local y = MEZZ_TOP + 1.2 + (s - 1) * 2.9
			box(f, "MezzShelfPlank" .. u .. "_" .. s, Vector3.new(9.8, 0.22, 2.1), Vector3.new(x0 + 4.75, y, 2.0), C.GALV, M.Metal, 90, grp .. "_Plank" .. s, s)
			for b = 1, 3 do
				box(f, "MezzShelfBox" .. u .. "_" .. s .. "_" .. b, Vector3.new(2.6, 1.8, 1.8), Vector3.new(x0 + 1.6 + (b - 1) * 3.2, y + 1.0, 2.0), if (b + s) % 2 == 0 then C.YELLOW else C.WHITE, M.Cardboard, 45, grp .. "_Box" .. s .. b, s + 1)
			end
		end
	end
	-- Góc nghỉ: tủ lạnh mini + lò vi sóng + bàn + 4 ghế
	local bg = "LSC_BreakRoom"
	box(f, "FridgeBody", Vector3.new(3.4, 6.6, 3.0), Vector3.new(-212.0, MEZZ_TOP + 3.3, 8.0), C.WHITE, M.Metal, 190, bg .. "_Fridge", 1)
	box(f, "FridgeDoorTop", Vector3.new(0.2, 2.6, 2.7), Vector3.new(-210.25, MEZZ_TOP + 4.9, 8.0), C.WHITE, M.SmoothPlastic, 70, bg .. "_Fridge", 2, { canCollide = false })
	box(f, "FridgeDoorBottom", Vector3.new(0.2, 3.2, 2.7), Vector3.new(-210.25, MEZZ_TOP + 1.9, 8.0), C.WHITE, M.SmoothPlastic, 70, bg .. "_Fridge", 2, { canCollide = false })
	box(f, "FridgeHandle", Vector3.new(0.16, 2.2, 0.2), Vector3.new(-210.1, MEZZ_TOP + 4.6, 6.9), C.CHROME, M.Metal, 25, bg .. "_Fridge", 3, { canCollide = false })
	box(f, "Microwave", Vector3.new(2.4, 1.8, 2.4), Vector3.new(-220.0, MEZZ_TOP + 4.2, 6.0), C.BLACK, M.SmoothPlastic, 50, bg .. "_Microwave", 1)
	box(f, "BreakTable", Vector3.new(7.0, 0.3, 4.0), Vector3.new(-225.0, MEZZ_TOP + 2.9, 6.0), C.WOOD, M.Wood, 90, bg .. "_Table", 1)
	vcyl(f, "BreakTableLeg", Vector3.new(2.7, 0.4, 0.4), Vector3.new(-225.0, MEZZ_TOP + 1.4, 6.0), C.DARK_STEEL, M.Metal, 60, bg .. "_Table", 1)
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local ang = (i - 1) * math.pi * 0.5
		box(f, "BreakChair" .. i, Vector3.new(1.6, 0.35, 1.6), Vector3.new(-225.0 + math.cos(ang) * 3.2, MEZZ_TOP + 1.7, 6.0 + math.sin(ang) * 2.6), C.LSC_BLUE_LIGHT, M.SmoothPlastic, 40, bg .. "_Chair" .. i, 1)
		box(f, "BreakChairLeg" .. i, Vector3.new(0.2, 1.6, 0.2), Vector3.new(-225.0 + math.cos(ang) * 3.2, MEZZ_TOP + 0.8, 6.0 + math.sin(ang) * 2.6), C.DARK_STEEL, M.Metal, 30, bg .. "_Chair" .. i, 1)

	box(f, "BreakCounter", Vector3.new(4.0, 3.2, 2.4), Vector3.new(-232.0, MEZZ_TOP + 1.6, 8.0), C.WOOD, M.Wood, 120, bg .. "_Counter", 1)

	-- Đèn + ổ cắm trên mezzanine
	for i, z in ipairs({ 0.0, 6.0 }) do
		stripLight(f, "MezzLight" .. i, Vector3.new(-230.0, 22.6, z), false, 12.0, "LSC_MezzLight" .. i)
		stripLight(f, "MezzLightOffice" .. i, Vector3.new(-260.0, 22.6, z), false, 10.0, "LSC_MezzLightOffice" .. i)

	for i, x in ipairs({ -262.0, -240.0, -218.0 }) do
		stripLight(f, "UnderMezzLight" .. i, Vector3.new(x, 14.4, 4.0), false, 10.0, "LSC_UnderMezzLight" .. i)

end

-- =============================================================================
-- 17. SÂN TRƯỚC: BÃI ĐỖ XE, CỔNG SOÁT VÉ, CỘT ĐÈN PHA, HÀNG RÀO
-- =============================================================================
local function buildForecourt(root: Instance)
	local f = folder("12_ForecourtAndGate", root)

	-- Tấm bê tông sân trước chia khe co giãn (né Z-fighting với pad 1.20)
	local nx, nz = 7, 5
	local cellW = (FC_X1 - FC_X0) / nx
	local cellD = (FC_Z1 - FC_Z0) / nz
	for ix = 0, nx - 1 do
		for iz = 0, nz - 1 do
			local x0 = FC_X0 + ix * cellW + 0.16
			local z0 = FC_Z0 + iz * cellD + 0.16
			box(
				f,
				string.format("ForecourtSlab_%d_%d", ix, iz),
				Vector3.new(cellW - 0.32, 0.22, cellD - 0.32),
				Vector3.new(x0 + (cellW - 0.32) * 0.5, FC_TOP - 0.11, z0 + (cellD - 0.32) * 0.5),
				jitter(C.CONCRETE, ix * 7 + iz * 3, 2),
				M.Concrete,
				380,
				string.format("LSC_ForecourtSlab_%d_%d", ix, iz),
				1,
				{ castShadow = false }
			)
		end
	end

	-- Dốc hạ lề + vạch dừng trước cổng
	box(f, "DrivewayApron", Vector3.new(60.0, 0.2, 2.6), Vector3.new(-238.0, FC_TOP - 0.1, 121.6), C.ASPHALT, M.Asphalt, 380, "LSC_DrivewayApron", 1, { castShadow = false })
	box(f, "DrivewayStopLine", Vector3.new(58.0, 0.05, 0.5), Vector3.new(-238.0, FC_TOP + 0.03, 118.6), C.WHITE, M.SmoothPlastic, 40, "LSC_StopLine", 1, { canCollide = false, castShadow = false })

	-- Logo "LSC" sơn phẳng giữa sân — MỘT dòng duy nhất, gọn mắt (bỏ dòng CUSTOMS chồng chéo cũ)
	drawTextFlat(f, "ForecourtLogo", "LSC", -238.0, 82.0, FC_TOP + 0.06, 2.15, C.WHITE, M.SmoothPlastic, 60, "LSC_PavementLogo", 1)
	-- 2 mũi tên chỉ hướng vào 2 khoang: thân thẳng + 2 cánh chéo 45° (sơn vàng phẳng)
	for i, ax in ipairs({ -256.25, -230.75 }) do
		box(f, "LaneArrowShaft" .. i, Vector3.new(1.5, 0.05, 12.0), Vector3.new(ax, FC_TOP + 0.05, 104.0), C.YELLOW, M.SmoothPlastic, 45, "LSC_LaneArrow" .. i, 1, { canCollide = false, castShadow = false })
		for k, sgn in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			rbox(
				f,
				"LaneArrowWing" .. i .. "_" .. k,
				Vector3.new(1.4, 0.05, 6.6),
				CFrame.new(ax + sgn * 1.85, FC_TOP + 0.05, 99.4) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(sgn * 42), 0),
				C.YELLOW,
				M.SmoothPlastic,
				45,
				"LSC_LaneArrow" .. i,
				2,
				{ canCollide = false, castShadow = false }
			)
		end
	end

	-- Bãi đỗ khách phía Tây + Đông (vạch sơn trắng + gờ chặn bánh)
	for side, sx in ipairs({ { -296.0, -274.0, -1 }, { -163.0, -141.0, 1 } }) do
		local xA, xB, inward = sx[1], sx[2], sx[3]
		local grp = "LSC_ParkingSide" .. tostring(side)
		-- 3 vạch ô đỗ gọn gàng (bỏ mảng nhựa tối StallNumber cho đỡ rối mắt)
		for i = 0, 2 do
			local z = 60.0 + i * 24.0
			box(f, "StallLine" .. side .. "_" .. i, Vector3.new(xB - xA, 0.05, 0.4), Vector3.new((xA + xB) * 0.5, FC_TOP + 0.04, z), C.WHITE, M.SmoothPlastic, 45, grp .. "_Line" .. i, 1, { canCollide = false, castShadow = false })
		end
		-- 2 gờ chặn bánh mỗi bên
		for i = 0, 1 do
			local z = 72.0 + i * 24.0
			local wheelX = if inward < 0 then xB - 1.4 else xA + 1.4
			box(f, "WheelStop" .. side .. "_" .. i, Vector3.new(2.6, 0.7, 8.0), Vector3.new(wheelX, FC_TOP + 0.35, z), C.CONCRETE_DARK, M.Concrete, 90, grp .. "_WheelStop" .. i, 1)
		end
	end

	-- Cổng soát vé: 2 trụ gạch + thanh chắn dựng đứng + đèn neon
	for i, gx in ipairs({ -270.0, -206.0 }) do
		local grp = "LSC_GatePier" .. tostring(i)
		brickWall(f, "GatePier" .. i, "X", 120.6, gx - 1.8, gx + 1.8, FC_TOP, 11.0, 3.6, C.BRICK, 260, grp .. "_Brick")
		box(f, "GatePierCap" .. i, Vector3.new(4.6, 0.7, 4.6), Vector3.new(gx, FC_TOP + 11.35, 120.6), C.CONCRETE, M.Concrete, 180, grp .. "_Cap", 6)
		ball(f, "GatePierLamp" .. i, 1.2, Vector3.new(gx, FC_TOP + 12.4, 120.6), C.NEON_YELLOW, M.Neon, 25, grp .. "_Lamp", 1)
		box(f, "GatePierSign" .. i, Vector3.new(3.0, 1.4, 0.16), Vector3.new(gx, FC_TOP + 8.6, 122.3), C.LSC_BLUE, M.Metal, 40, grp .. "_Sign", 4)
		drawText(f, "GatePierText" .. i, "LSC", gx - 1.75, FC_TOP + 8.2, 122.5, 0.08, 0.2, C.NEON_WHITE, M.Neon, 15, grp .. "_Sign", 5)
	end
	-- Thanh chắn (đang mở dựng đứng) + hộp điều khiển
	local bg = "LSC_BoomBarrier"
	box(f, "BoomControlBox", Vector3.new(2.0, 3.0, 2.0), Vector3.new(-204.4, FC_TOP + 1.5, 119.6), C.YELLOW, M.Metal, 90, bg .. "_Box", 1)
	box(f, "BoomPivot", Vector3.new(1.6, 1.6, 1.6), Vector3.new(-204.4, FC_TOP + 3.6, 119.6), C.DARK_STEEL, M.Metal, 70, bg .. "_Pivot", 1)
	box(f, "BoomArm", Vector3.new(0.7, 11.4, 0.7), Vector3.new(-204.4, FC_TOP + 9.4, 119.6), C.WHITE, M.SmoothPlastic, 110, bg .. "_Arm", 2)
	for i = 1, 4 do
		box(f, "BoomStripe" .. i, Vector3.new(0.78, 1.05, 0.78), Vector3.new(-204.4, FC_TOP + 4.9 + i * 2.35, 119.6), C.RED, M.SmoothPlastic, 30, bg .. "_Arm", 3, { canCollide = false })
	end
	box(f, "BoomCounterweight", Vector3.new(1.8, 2.0, 1.8), Vector3.new(-204.4, FC_TOP + 4.2, 118.2), C.DARK_STEEL, M.Metal, 110, bg .. "_Counter", 1)

	-- 4 cột đèn pha sân trước
	for i, p in ipairs({ { -292.0, 116.0 }, { -146.0, 116.0 }, { -292.0, 56.0 }, { -146.0, 56.0 } }) do
		local grp = "LSC_FloodPole" .. tostring(i)
		box(f, "FloodBase" .. i, Vector3.new(3.2, 0.9, 3.2), Vector3.new(p[1], FC_TOP + 0.45, p[2]), C.CONCRETE, M.Concrete, 240, grp .. "_Base", 1)
		vcyl(f, "FloodPole" .. i, Vector3.new(19.0, 1.1, 1.1), Vector3.new(p[1], FC_TOP + 10.0, p[2]), C.GALV, M.Metal, 260, grp .. "_Pole", 2)
		box(f, "FloodArm" .. i, Vector3.new(3.4, 0.35, 0.35), Vector3.new(p[1] + (if p[1] < -218 then 1.6 else -1.6), FC_TOP + 19.2, p[2]), C.GALV, M.Metal, 90, grp .. "_Arm", 3)
		box(f, "FloodHead" .. i, Vector3.new(2.2, 0.9, 3.2), Vector3.new(p[1] + (if p[1] < -218 then 3.0 else -3.0), FC_TOP + 18.9, p[2]), C.DARK_STEEL, M.Metal, 80, grp .. "_Head", 3)
		box(f, "FloodLens" .. i, Vector3.new(1.8, 0.3, 2.8), Vector3.new(p[1] + (if p[1] < -218 then 3.0 else -3.0), FC_TOP + 18.4, p[2]), C.NEON_WHITE, M.Neon, 30, grp .. "_Lens", 4, { canCollide = false, castShadow = false })
	end

	-- Hàng rào lưới B40 quanh sân (chừa cổng xe 60 studs)
	local function fenceRun(name: string, axis: "X" | "Z", fixed: number, c0: number, c1: number)
		local grp = "LSC_Fence_" .. name
		local cursor = c0
		local idx = 1
		while cursor < c1 - 0.5 do
			local seg = math.min(c1, cursor + 8.0)
			local len = seg - cursor
			local mid = (cursor + seg) * 0.5
			local pos = if axis == "X" then Vector3.new(mid, FC_TOP + 2.0, fixed) else Vector3.new(fixed, FC_TOP + 2.0, mid)
			local size = if axis == "X" then Vector3.new(len - 0.3, 3.8, 0.12) else Vector3.new(0.12, 3.8, len - 0.3)
			box(f, name .. "_Mesh" .. idx, size, pos, Color3.fromRGB(150, 156, 162), M.DiamondPlate, 70, grp .. "_Mesh" .. idx, 1, { transparency = 0.35 })
			local pp = if axis == "X" then Vector3.new(seg, FC_TOP + 2.0, fixed) else Vector3.new(fixed, FC_TOP + 2.0, seg)
			box(f, name .. "_Post" .. idx, Vector3.new(0.28, 4.2, 0.28), pp, C.GALV, M.Metal, 110, grp .. "_Post" .. idx, 1)
			cursor = seg
			idx += 1
		end
		-- thanh giằng trên
		local rp = if axis == "X" then Vector3.new((c0 + c1) * 0.5, FC_TOP + 4.1, fixed) else Vector3.new(fixed, FC_TOP + 4.1, (c0 + c1) * 0.5)
		local rs = if axis == "X" then Vector3.new(c1 - c0, 0.22, 0.22) else Vector3.new(0.22, 0.22, c1 - c0)
		box(f, name .. "_TopRail", rs, rp, C.GALV, M.Metal, 90, grp .. "_TopRail", 2, { canCollide = false })
	end
	fenceRun("WestFence", "Z", FC_X0 + 0.3, 54.0, 119.5)
	fenceRun("EastFence", "Z", FC_X1 - 0.3, 54.0, 119.5)
	fenceRun("SouthWestFence", "X", 119.5, FC_X0 + 0.3, -270.5)
	fenceRun("SouthEastFence", "X", 119.5, -205.5, FC_X1 - 0.3)

	-- Cọc chắn bảo vệ mặt tiền (húc bay được)
	PartBuilder.bollardLine({
		name = "FacadeBollards",
		parent = f,
		startPos = Vector3.new(-220.0, FC_TOP, 58.5),
		endPos = Vector3.new(-176.0, FC_TOP, 58.5),
		count = 8,
		fractureGroup = "LSC_FacadeBollard",
	})

	-- Đồ nghề ngoài sân: lốp, phuy, pallet, cọc nón, băng ghế khách
	-- Góc đồ nghề ngoài sân gọn gàng: 1 chồng lốp + 2 phuy dầu (bớt 60% vật dụng lặt vặt)
	tireStack(f, "ForecourtTireStack1", Vector3.new(-283.0, FC_TOP + 0.5, 110.0), 4, "LSC_OutdoorTires1", 70)
	for i, dp in ipairs({ { -287.6, 104.0 }, { -284.2, 104.0 } }) do
		oilDrum(f, "OutdoorDrum" .. i, Vector3.new(dp[1], FC_TOP + 1.7, dp[2]), if i == 2 then C.BLUE_DRUM else C.GREEN_DRUM, "LSC_OutdoorDrum" .. tostring(i), 110)
	end
	-- 3 cọc tiêu đặt thẳng hàng trước 3 trụ nhà (không còn cọc nằm giữa làn xe)
	local conePositions = { { -266.0, 108.0 }, { -243.5, 108.0 }, { -218.0, 108.0 } }
	for i, cp in ipairs(conePositions) do
		trafficCone(f, "Cone" .. i, Vector3.new(cp[1], FC_TOP, cp[2]), "LSC_Cone" .. tostring(i))
	end
	-- 1 băng ghế khách ngoài trời đặt chính giữa dưới mái hiên kính
	for i, bx in ipairs({ -190.0 }) do
		local grp = "LSC_OutdoorBench" .. tostring(i)
		box(f, "BenchSeat" .. i, Vector3.new(9.0, 0.4, 2.2), Vector3.new(bx, FC_TOP + 2.0, 59.6), C.WOOD, M.WoodPlanks, 80, grp .. "_Seat", 1)
		box(f, "BenchBack" .. i, Vector3.new(9.0, 2.0, 0.3), Vector3.new(bx, FC_TOP + 3.1, 58.6), C.WOOD, M.WoodPlanks, 70, grp .. "_Back", 2)
		for _, lx in ipairs({ -3.6, 3.6 }) do
			box(f, "BenchLeg" .. i .. tostring(lx), Vector3.new(0.35, 2.0, 2.0), Vector3.new(bx + lx, FC_TOP + 1.0, 59.6), C.DARK_STEEL, M.Metal, 70, grp .. "_Leg" .. tostring(lx), 1)
		end
	end
	-- 2 chậu cây đối xứng 2 bên cửa đi bộ (bỏ chậu lẻ ở góc Đông cho gọn mắt)
	for i, p in ipairs({ { -213.5, 56.5 }, { -199.5, 56.5 } }) do
		vcyl(f, "OutdoorPlanter" .. i, Vector3.new(3.2, 3.4, 3.4), Vector3.new(p[1], FC_TOP + 1.6, p[2]), C.CONCRETE, M.Concrete, 150, "LSC_OutdoorPlanter" .. i, 1)
		ball(f, "OutdoorBush" .. i, 4.4, Vector3.new(p[1], FC_TOP + 4.4, p[2]), Color3.fromRGB(58, 112, 64), M.Grass, 60, "LSC_OutdoorPlanter" .. i, 2)
	end
	-- 1 thùng rác duy nhất sát trụ Đông
	for i, p in ipairs({ { -218.0, 56.0 } }) do
		vcyl(f, "TrashBin" .. i, Vector3.new(3.4, 2.6, 2.6), Vector3.new(p[1], FC_TOP + 1.7, p[2]), C.STEEL, M.Metal, 90, "LSC_TrashBin" .. i, 1)
		vcyl(f, "TrashLid" .. i, Vector3.new(0.4, 2.9, 2.9), Vector3.new(p[1], FC_TOP + 3.6, p[2]), C.DARK_STEEL, M.Metal, 50, "LSC_TrashBin" .. i, 2)
	end
	-- Camera an ninh + đèn gắn tường 2 góc mặt tiền
	for i, cx in ipairs({ BX0 + 3.0, BX1 - 3.0 }) do
		local grp = "LSC_SecurityCam" .. tostring(i)
		box(f, "CamArm" .. i, Vector3.new(0.25, 0.25, 1.8), Vector3.new(cx, 20.0, BZ1 + 0.6), C.GALV, M.Metal, 40, grp .. "_Arm", 1, { canCollide = false })
		box(f, "CamBody" .. i, Vector3.new(0.8, 0.8, 1.6), Vector3.new(cx, 19.6, BZ1 + 1.4), C.WHITE, M.SmoothPlastic, 40, grp .. "_Body", 2)
		box(f, "CamLens" .. i, Vector3.new(0.55, 0.55, 0.2), Vector3.new(cx, 19.6, BZ1 + 2.2), C.BLACK, M.Glass, 25, grp .. "_Lens", 3, { canCollide = false })
		box(f, "WallPack" .. i, Vector3.new(1.2, 0.7, 1.2), Vector3.new(cx, 14.6, BZ1 + 0.6), C.DARK_STEEL, M.Metal, 40, grp .. "_WallPack", 1)
		box(f, "WallPackLens" .. i, Vector3.new(1.0, 0.2, 1.0), Vector3.new(cx, 14.2, BZ1 + 0.6), C.NEON_WHITE, M.Neon, 20, grp .. "_WallPack", 2, { canCollide = false, castShadow = false })
	end
	-- Vòi nước + ống tưới rửa sân
	box(f, "HoseBib", Vector3.new(0.6, 0.6, 1.2), Vector3.new(-176.0, FC_TOP + 1.6, BZ1 + 0.7), C.CHROME, M.Metal, 25, "LSC_HoseBib", 1, { canCollide = false })

	-- =========================================================================
	-- [CHỨC NĂNG THẬT] 2 KHOANG ĐỘ XE: VÙNG KÍCH HOẠT + ĐÈN BÁO TRẠNG THÁI
	-- LSCustomsService (server) sẽ dùng các part này để biết xe nào đang nằm

type Opts = { [string]: any }

local function folder(parent: Instance, name: string): Folder
	local f = Instance.new("Folder")
	f.Name = name
	f.Parent = parent
	return f
end

local function merge(into: Opts, from: Opts?): Opts
	if from then
		for k, v in pairs(from) do
			into[k] = v
		end
	end
	return into
end

-- Áp quy tắc hiệu năng cho MỌI BasePart của công trình (kể cả khối gạch do masonryWall sinh ra)
local function applyPerfPass(root: Instance)
	local count = 0
	for _, obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			count += 1
			obj.CanTouch = false
			obj.EnableFluidForces = false
			local p = obj :: BasePart
			local sz = p.Size
			local maxDim = math.max(sz.X, sz.Y, sz.Z)
			local thinWide = sz.Y <= 1.3 and sz.X >= 4 and sz.Z >= 4 -- sàn / mái mỏng rộng
			if not thinWide and maxDim < 1.6 then
				p.CanCollide = false
			end
			if maxDim < 2.6 or p.Transparency > 0.2 or p.Material == M.Neon then
				p.CastShadow = false
			end
		end
	end
	root:SetAttribute("PartCount", count)
	return count
end

				spec[k] = v
			end
		end
	end
	return PartBuilder.part(spec :: any)

-- brickWall: mảng gạch/đá ghép so le (mỗi viên độc lập có máu ẩn)
local function brickWall(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	axis: "X" | "Z",
	fixed: number,
	c0: number,
	c1: number,
	baseY: number,
	height: number,
	thickness: number,
	color: Color3,
	hp: number,
	group: string,
	material: Enum.Material?
)
	if c1 - c0 < 0.5 or height < 0.4 then
		return
	end
	local courses = math.max(1, math.round(height / 2.75))
	local ch = height / courses
	PartBuilder.masonryWall({
		name = name,
		parent = parent,
		axis = axis,
		fixedCoord = fixed,
		minCoord = c0,
		maxCoord = c1,
		baseY = baseY,
		thickness = thickness,
		courses = courses,
		courseHeight = ch,
		blockLength = if height >= 12 then 6.4 elseif height >= 5 then 5.6 else 4.4,
		mortarGap = 0.09,
		baseColor = color,
		material = material or M.Brick,
		colorJitter = 7,
		integrity = hp,
		fractureGroup = group,
	})
end

-- Tường có khoét lỗ (cửa/cửa sổ) → chia dải ngang + dải đứng, chỉ dùng viên gạch rời
local function wallWithOpenings(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	axis: "X" | "Z",
	fixed: number,
	c0: number,
	c1: number,
	baseY: number,
	topY: number,
	thickness: number,
	color: Color3,
	hp: number,
	group: string,
	openings: { { a: number, b: number, y0: number, y1: number } },
	material: Enum.Material?
)
	local ys: { number } = { baseY, topY }
	for _, o in ipairs(openings) do
		table.insert(ys, math.clamp(o.y0, baseY, topY))
		table.insert(ys, math.clamp(o.y1, baseY, topY))
	end
	table.sort(ys)
	local bands: { { number } } = {}
	for i = 1, #ys - 1 do
		if ys[i + 1] - ys[i] > 0.12 then
			table.insert(bands, { ys[i], ys[i + 1] })
		end
	end
	for bi, band in ipairs(bands) do
		local cuts: { number } = { c0, c1 }
		local active: { { a: number, b: number, y0: number, y1: number } } = {}
		for _, o in ipairs(openings) do
			if o.y0 <= band[1] + 0.02 and o.y1 >= band[2] - 0.02 then
				table.insert(cuts, math.clamp(o.a, c0, c1))
				table.insert(cuts, math.clamp(o.b, c0, c1))
				table.insert(active, o)
			end
		end
		table.sort(cuts)
		for i = 1, #cuts - 1 do
			local a, b = cuts[i], cuts[i + 1]
			local isHole = false
			for _, o in ipairs(active) do
				if a >= o.a - 0.02 and b <= o.b + 0.02 then
					isHole = true
					break
				end
			end
			if not isHole and b - a > 0.45 then
				brickWall(
					parent,
					string.format("%s_b%d_s%d", name, bi, i),
					axis,
					fixed,
					a,
					b,
					band[1],
					band[2] - band[1],
					thickness,
					color,
					hp,
					group,
					material
				)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Vách ngăn nội thất: tường thạch cao đúc khối (1 khối/dải, ít part) + len chân tường
local function panelWall(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	axis: "X" | "Z",
	fixed: number,
	c0: number,
	c1: number,
	baseY: number,
	topY: number,
	thickness: number,
	color: Color3,
	hp: number,
	group: string,
	openings: { { a: number, b: number, y0: number, y1: number } },
	material: Enum.Material?
)
	local ys: { number } = { baseY, topY }
	for _, o in ipairs(openings) do
		table.insert(ys, math.clamp(o.y0, baseY, topY))
		table.insert(ys, math.clamp(o.y1, baseY, topY))
	end
	table.sort(ys)
	local bands: { { number } } = {}
	for i = 1, #ys - 1 do
		if ys[i + 1] - ys[i] > 0.12 then
			table.insert(bands, { ys[i], ys[i + 1] })
		end
	end
	local mat = material or M.Concrete
	for bi, band in ipairs(bands) do
		local cuts: { number } = { c0, c1 }
		local active: { { a: number, b: number, y0: number, y1: number } } = {}
		for _, o in ipairs(openings) do
			if o.y0 <= band[1] + 0.02 and o.y1 >= band[2] - 0.02 then
				table.insert(cuts, math.clamp(o.a, c0, c1))
				table.insert(cuts, math.clamp(o.b, c0, c1))
				table.insert(active, o)
			end
		end
		table.sort(cuts)
		for i = 1, #cuts - 1 do
			local a, b = cuts[i], cuts[i + 1]
			local isHole = false
			for _, o in ipairs(active) do
				if a >= o.a - 0.02 and b <= o.b + 0.02 then
					isHole = true
					break
				end
			end
			if not isHole and b - a > 0.2 then
				local mid = (a + b) * 0.5
				local cy = (band[1] + band[2]) * 0.5
				local size = if axis == "X" then V(b - a, band[2] - band[1], thickness) else V(thickness, band[2] - band[1], b - a)
				local pos = if axis == "X" then V(mid, cy, fixed) else V(fixed, cy, mid)
				box(parent, string.format("%s_b%d_s%d", name, bi, i), size, pos, color, mat, hp, group, bi)
				-- len chân tường cho dải thấp nhất
				if bi == 1 then
					local skSize = if axis == "X" then V(b - a, 0.55, thickness + 0.14) else V(thickness + 0.14, 0.55, b - a)
					local skPos = if axis == "X" then V(mid, baseY + 0.28, fixed) else V(fixed, baseY + 0.28, mid)
					box(parent, string.format("%s_sk%d", name, i), skSize, skPos, C.NAVY_DK, M.SmoothPlastic, math.max(60, hp * 0.4), group .. "_Skirt" .. tostring(i), bi + 1)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Dãy khối rời dùng chung fracture group (nan cửa cuốn, vách kính, sọc mái hiên)
local function segmentedRow(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	axis: "X" | "Z",
	fixed: number,
	c0: number,
	c1: number,
	centerY: number,
	height: number,
	thickness: number,
	segLen: number,
	color: Color3,
	material: Enum.Material?,
	hp: number,
	group: string,
	row: number,
	opts: Opts?
)
	local cursor = c0
	local idx = 1
	while cursor < c1 - 0.05 do
		local segEnd = math.min(c1, cursor + segLen)
		local ln = segEnd - cursor - 0.08
		if ln > 0.1 then
			local mid = (cursor + segEnd) * 0.5
			local pos = if axis == "X" then V(mid, centerY, fixed) else V(fixed, centerY, mid)
			local size = if axis == "X" then V(ln, height, thickness) else V(thickness, height, ln)
			box(parent, string.format("%s_%d", name, idx), size, pos, color, material, hp, group, row, opts)
		end
		cursor = segEnd
		idx += 1
	end
end

-- Ô kính có máu ẩn riêng (bắn vỡ từng tấm)
local function glassPane(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	axis: "X" | "Z",
	fixed: number,
	c0: number,
	c1: number,
	y0: number,
	y1: number,
	hp: number,
	group: string,
	row: number,
	tint: Color3?
)
	local size = if axis == "X" then V(c1 - c0, y1 - y0, 0.20) else V(0.20, y1 - y0, c1 - c0)
	local pos = if axis == "X"
		then V((c0 + c1) * 0.5, (y0 + y1) * 0.5, fixed)
		else V(fixed, (y0 + y1) * 0.5, (c0 + c1) * 0.5)
	box(parent, name, size, pos, tint or C.GLASS, M.Glass, hp, group, row, {
		transparency = 0.55,
		reflectance = 0.18,
		castShadow = false,
		canCollide = false,
	})
end

-- Thanh nối 2 điểm bất kỳ (ty giằng, lan can, ống, dây, tay vịn)
local function strut(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	a: Vector3,
	b: Vector3,
	thick: number,
	color: Color3,
	material: Enum.Material?,
	hp: number?,
	group: string?,
	row: number?,
	opts: Opts?
): Part
	local d = b - a
	local len = d.Magnitude
	local mid = (a + b) * 0.5
	local yaw = math.atan2(d.X, d.Z)
	local flat = math.sqrt(d.X * d.X + d.Z * d.Z)
	local pitch = math.atan2(flat, d.Y)
	local cf = CFrame.new(mid) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, 0, 0)
	return rbox(parent, name, V(thick, len, thick), cf, color, material, hp, group, row, opts)
end

local function jitter(base: Color3, seed: number, amount: number): Color3
	local n = ((seed * 37) % 11) - 5
	local d = (n / 5) * (amount / 255)
	return Color3.new(math.clamp(base.R + d, 0, 1), math.clamp(base.G + d, 0, 1), math.clamp(base.B + d * 0.9, 0, 1))
end

local ADVANCE = 7 -- 5 cột glyph + 2 cột khoảng cách

local function textWidth(text: string, px: number): number
	return math.max(0, #text * ADVANCE * px - 2 * px)
end

-- Chữ nổi trên mặt phẳng Z (nhìn từ +Z). leftX = mép trái, bottomY = mép dưới.
local function drawText(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	text: string,
	leftX: number,
	bottomY: number,
	planeZ: number,
	depth: number,
	px: number,
	color: Color3,
	material: Enum.Material?,
	hp: number?,
	group: string?,
	row: number?,
	opts: Opts?
): number
	local upper = string.upper(text)
	local cursor = 0
	for i = 1, #upper do
		local ch = string.sub(upper, i, i)
		local glyph = FONT5X7[ch]
		if glyph then
			for r = 1, 7 do
				local line = glyph[r]
				local col = 1
				while col <= 5 do
					if string.sub(line, col, col) == "1" then
						local runStart = col
						while col <= 5 and string.sub(line, col, col) == "1" do
							col += 1
						end
						local runLen = col - runStart
						box(
							parent,
							string.format("%s_%s_%d_%d", name, ch, r, runStart),
							V(runLen * px - 0.1, px - 0.1, depth),
							V(leftX + (cursor + runStart - 1) * px + runLen * px * 0.5, bottomY + (7 - r) * px + px * 0.5, planeZ),
							color,
							material or M.Neon,
							hp,
							group,
							row,
							merge({ canCollide = false, castShadow = false }, opts)
						)
					else
						col += 1
					end
				end
			end
			cursor += ADVANCE
		else
			cursor += ADVANCE
		end
	end
	return cursor * px - 2 * px
end

-- Chữ nổi nằm phẳng trên mặt sàn (mặt phẳng XZ) — cho chữ "H" sân đáp & vạch sơn chữ

): number
	local upper = string.upper(text)
	local totalW = textWidth(upper, px)
	local leftX = centerX - totalW * 0.5
	local cursor = 0
	for i = 1, #upper do
		local ch = string.sub(upper, i, i)
		local glyph = FONT5X7[ch]
		if glyph then
			for r = 1, 7 do
				local line = glyph[r]
				local col = 1
				while col <= 5 do
					if string.sub(line, col, col) == "1" then
						local runStart = col
						while col <= 5 and string.sub(line, col, col) == "1" do
							col += 1
						end
						local runLen = col - runStart
						box(
							parent,
							string.format("%s_%s_%d_%d", name, ch, r, runStart),
							V(runLen * px - 0.12, 0.04, px - 0.12),
							V(leftX + (cursor + runStart - 1) * px + runLen * px * 0.5, topY, topZ + (r - 0.5) * px),
							color,
							material or M.SmoothPlastic,
							hp,
							group,
							row,
							{ canCollide = false, castShadow = false }
						)
					else
						col += 1
					end
				end
			end
			cursor += ADVANCE

			cursor += ADVANCE

	end
	return totalW
end

							{ canCollide = false, castShadow = false }
						)
					else
						col += 1
					end
				end
			end
			cursor += ADVANCE
		else
			cursor += ADVANCE
		end
	end
	return cursor * px - 2 * px
end

-- Lan can: trụ đứng + tay vịn trên + thanh giữa + con tiện
local function railingRun(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	axis: "X" | "Z",
	fixed: number,
	c0: number,
	c1: number,
	yBase: number,
	height: number,
	color: Color3,
	group: string,
	row: number,
	opts: Opts?
)
	local len = c1 - c0
	if len < 0.5 then
		return
	end
	local thick = 0.30
	local function put(nm: string, size: Vector3, mid: number, y: number, col: Color3, mat: Enum.Material?, hp: number?, o: Opts?)
		local pos = if axis == "X" then V(mid, y, fixed) else V(fixed, y, mid)
		local sz = if axis == "X" then V(size.X, size.Y, size.Z) else V(size.Z, size.Y, size.X)
		box(parent, nm, sz, pos, col, mat, hp, group, row, o)
	end
	local posts = math.max(2, math.ceil(len / 2.6) + 1)
	for i = 0, posts - 1 do
		local mid = c0 + (len / (posts - 1)) * i
		put(string.format("%s_Post%d", name, i + 1), V(0.26, height, 0.26), mid, yBase + height * 0.5, color, M.Metal, 90, { canCollide = false })
	end
	put(name .. "_TopRail", V(len, 0.24, thick), (c0 + c1) * 0.5, yBase + height - 0.12, color, M.Metal, 130, nil)
	put(name .. "_MidRail", V(len, 0.16, thick * 0.7), (c0 + c1) * 0.5, yBase + height * 0.52, color, M.Metal, 90, { canCollide = false })
	local balusters = math.max(2, math.floor(len / 0.85))
	for i = 1, balusters - 1 do
		local mid = c0 + (len / balusters) * i
		put(string.format("%s_Bal%d", name, i), V(0.11, height - 0.3, 0.11), mid, yBase + height * 0.5, color, M.Metal, 40, { canCollide = false })
	end
	if opts and opts.kick then
		put(name .. "_Kick", V(len, 0.35, 0.14), (c0 + c1) * 0.5, yBase + 0.18, color, M.Metal, 80, { canCollide = false })
	end
end

-- Khung cửa: 2 trụ + thanh đà trên, dày hơn tường để nổi khối
local function doorFrame(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	axis: "X" | "Z",
	fixed: number,
	c0: number,
	c1: number,
	y0: number,
	y1: number,
	depth: number,
	color: Color3,
	group: string,
	row: number
)
	for i, cx in ipairs({ c0 + 0.20, c1 - 0.20 }) do
		local size = if axis == "X" then V(0.40, y1 - y0, depth) else V(depth, y1 - y0, 0.40)
		local pos = if axis == "X" then V(cx, (y0 + y1) * 0.5, fixed) else V(fixed, (y0 + y1) * 0.5, cx)
		box(parent, string.format("%s_Jamb%d", name, i), size, pos, color, M.Metal, 160, group, row)
	end
	local headSize = if axis == "X" then V(c1 - c0, 0.44, depth) else V(depth, 0.44, c1 - c0)
	box(parent, name .. "_Head", headSize, if axis == "X" then V((c0 + c1) * 0.5, y1 + 0.08, fixed) else V(fixed, y1 + 0.08, (c0 + c1) * 0.5), color, M.Metal, 170, group, row)
end

-- Song sắt buồng giam (thanh dọc + 3 thanh ngang + khung)
local function barredPanel(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	axis: "X" | "Z",
	fixed: number,
	c0: number,
	c1: number,
	y0: number,
	y1: number,
	color: Color3,
	group: string,
	row: number
)
	local len = c1 - c0
	local h = y1 - y0
	local bars = math.max(2, math.floor(len / 0.82))
	for i = 0, bars do
		local mid = c0 + (len / bars) * i
		local size = if axis == "X" then V(0.15, h, 0.15) else V(0.15, h, 0.15)
		local pos = if axis == "X" then V(mid, (y0 + y1) * 0.5, fixed) else V(fixed, (y0 + y1) * 0.5, mid)
		box(parent, string.format("%s_Bar%d", name, i), size, pos, color, M.Metal, 120, group, row, { canCollide = false })
	end
	for i, ry in ipairs({ 0.25, 0.55, 0.85 }) do
		local size = if axis == "X" then V(len + 0.1, 0.16, 0.16) else V(0.16, 0.16, len + 0.1)
		local pos = if axis == "X" then V((c0 + c1) * 0.5, y0 + h * ry, fixed) else V(fixed, y0 + h * ry, (c0 + c1) * 0.5)
		box(parent, string.format("%s_Cross%d", name, i), size, pos, color, M.Metal, 110, group, row, { canCollide = false })
	end
end

-- Vách kính chia ô (mỗi ô 1 tấm có máu riêng) + khung nhôm
local function glassWall(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	axis: "X" | "Z",
	fixed: number,
	c0: number,
	c1: number,
	y0: number,
	y1: number,
	paneMax: number,
	group: string,
	rowStart: number
)
	local len = c1 - c0
	local panes = math.max(1, math.ceil(len / paneMax))
	local step = len / panes
	box(parent, name .. "_Sill", if axis == "X" then V(len, 0.16, 0.42) else V(0.42, 0.16, len), if axis == "X" then V((c0 + c1) * 0.5, y0 + 0.08, fixed) else V(fixed, y0 + 0.08, (c0 + c1) * 0.5), C.STEEL_LT, M.Metal, 90, group, rowStart)
	for i = 0, panes do
		local mid = c0 + step * i
		local size = if axis == "X" then V(0.16, y1 - y0, 0.34) else V(0.34, y1 - y0, 0.16)
		local pos = if axis == "X" then V(mid, (y0 + y1) * 0.5, fixed) else V(fixed, (y0 + y1) * 0.5, mid)
		box(parent, string.format("%s_Mullion%d", name, i), size, pos, C.STEEL_LT, M.Metal, 110, group, rowStart + 1, { canCollide = false })
	end
	for i = 1, panes do
		glassPane(
			parent,
			string.format("%s_Pane%d", name, i),
			axis,
			fixed,
			c0 + step * (i - 1) + 0.12,
			c0 + step * i - 0.12,
			y0 + 0.16,
			y1 - 0.08,
			70,
			group,
			rowStart + 2
		)
	end
end

-- Cầu thang bộ dựng tay (bậc khít, không chồng mặt phẳng) + 2 dầm nghiêng
local function stairRun(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	origin: Vector3,
	dir: Vector3,
	width: number,
	steps: number,
	totalRise: number,
	totalRun: number,
	color: Color3,
	group: string,
	rowStart: number,
	material: Enum.Material?
)
	local rise = totalRise / steps
	local run = totalRun / steps
	local isZ = math.abs(dir.Z) > 0.5
	for s = 1, steps do
		local topH = s * rise
		local off = (s - 0.5) * run
		local pos = V(origin.X + dir.X * off, origin.Y + topH * 0.5, origin.Z + dir.Z * off)
		local size = if isZ then V(width, topH, run) else V(run, topH, width)
		box(parent, string.format("%s_Step%d", name, s), size, pos, if s % 2 == 0 then color else jitter(color, s, 6), material or M.Marble, 170, string.format("%s_Step%d", name, s), rowStart + (s % 3))
	end
	local half = if isZ then V(width * 0.5 + 0.35, 0, 0) else V(0, 0, width * 0.5 + 0.35)
	local a = V(origin.X + dir.X * 0.4 + half.X, origin.Y + 1.2, origin.Z + dir.Z * 0.4 + half.Z)
	local b = V(origin.X + dir.X * (totalRun - 0.4) + half.X, origin.Y + totalRise + 1.2, origin.Z + dir.Z * (totalRun - 0.4) + half.Z)
	for _, sgn in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		local off = if isZ then V(0, 0, sgn * (width * 0.5 + 0.35)) else V(sgn * (width * 0.5 + 0.35), 0, 0)
		strut(
			parent,
			string.format("%s_Stringer%d", name, sgn < 0 and 1 or 2),
			a + off,
			b + off,
			0.55,
			C.STEEL_DK,
			M.Metal,
			140,
			string.format("%s_Stringer%d", name, sgn < 0 and 1 or 2),
			rowStart
		)
	end
end

-- Cụm cửa sổ: khung đá + đố nhôm + từng ô kính có máu riêng
local function windowUnit(
	parent: Instance,
	axis: "X" | "Z",
	fixed: number,
	a: number,
	b: number,
	y0: number,
	y1: number,
	cols: number,
	rows: number,
	tag: string,
	group: string,
	rowBase: number
)
	local len = b - a
	local h = y1 - y0
	-- trụ khung 2 bên
	for i, c in ipairs({ a + 0.15, b - 0.15 }) do
		local size = if axis == "X" then V(0.30, h + 0.3, 1.75) else V(1.75, h + 0.3, 0.30)
		local pos = if axis == "X" then V(c, (y0 + y1) * 0.5, fixed) else V(fixed, (y0 + y1) * 0.5, c)
		box(parent, string.format("%s_Jamb%d", tag, i), size, pos, C.STONE_LT, M.Concrete, 170, group, rowBase + 1)
	end
	-- bệ đá + thanh đà trên
	local sillSize = if axis == "X" then V(len + 0.8, 0.32, 2.15) else V(2.15, 0.32, len + 0.8)
	local sillPos = if axis == "X" then V((a + b) * 0.5, y0 - 0.10, fixed) else V(fixed, y0 - 0.10, (a + b) * 0.5)
	box(parent, tag .. "_Sill", sillSize, sillPos, C.STONE_LT, M.Marble, 190, group, rowBase + 1)
	local headSize = if axis == "X" then V(len + 0.9, 0.42, 1.9) else V(1.9, 0.42, len + 0.9)
	local headPos = if axis == "X" then V((a + b) * 0.5, y1 + 0.16, fixed) else V(fixed, y1 + 0.16, (a + b) * 0.5)
	box(parent, tag .. "_Head", headSize, headPos, C.STONE_LT, M.Marble, 190, group, rowBase + 2)
	-- đố dọc
	local step = len / cols
	for i = 1, cols - 1 do
		local c = a + step * i
		local size = if axis == "X" then V(0.16, h, 0.30) else V(0.30, h, 0.16)
		local pos = if axis == "X" then V(c, (y0 + y1) * 0.5, fixed) else V(fixed, (y0 + y1) * 0.5, c)
		box(parent, string.format("%s_Mull%d", tag, i), size, pos, C.STEEL_LT, M.Metal, 110, group, rowBase + 2, { canCollide = false })
	end
	-- đố ngang (transom)
	local rowH = h / rows
	for i = 1, rows - 1 do
		local cy = y0 + rowH * i
		local size = if axis == "X" then V(len, 0.14, 0.30) else V(0.30, 0.14, len)
		local pos = if axis == "X" then V((a + b) * 0.5, cy, fixed) else V(fixed, cy, (a + b) * 0.5)
		box(parent, string.format("%s_Trans%d", tag, i), size, pos, C.STEEL_LT, M.Metal, 110, group, rowBase + 3, { canCollide = false })
	end
	-- từng ô kính (máu riêng theo ô)
	for ci = 1, cols do
		for ri = 1, rows do
			local pa = a + step * (ci - 1) + 0.12
			local pb = a + step * ci - 0.12
			local py0 = y0 + rowH * (ri - 1) + 0.10
			local py1 = y0 + rowH * ri - 0.10
			glassPane(parent, string.format("%s_G%d_%d", tag, ci, ri), axis, fixed, pa, pb, py0, py1, 55, group .. "_Pane", rowBase + 4)
		end
	end
end

-- Ghế văn phòng xoay (đế 5 chân + trụ + tựa)
local function officeChair(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	cx: number,
	cz: number,
	yaw: number,
	group: string,
	row: number,
	col: Color3?,
	baseY: number?
)
	local y0 = baseY or FLR
	local c = col or C.LEATHER
	local cfSeat = CFrame.new(V(cx, y0 + 1.35, cz)) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
	rbox(parent, name .. "_Seat", V(1.9, 0.28, 1.9), cfSeat, c, M.Fabric, 70, group .. "_Seat", row)
	rbox(parent, name .. "_Back", V(1.9, 2.0, 0.30), cfSeat * CFrame.new(0, 1.0, 0.82) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-8), 0, 0), c, M.Fabric, 70, group .. "_Back", row + 1)
	vcyl(parent, name .. "_Post", V(1.5, 0.32, 0.32), V(cx, y0 + 0.72, cz), C.STEEL_DK, M.Metal, 60, group .. "_Post", row)
	for i = 0, 4 do
		local a = i * math.pi * 0.4
		rbox(
			parent,
			string.format("%s_Leg%d", name, i),
			V(1.55, 0.16, 0.24),
			CFrame.new(V(cx + math.cos(a) * 0.78, y0 + 0.30, cz + math.sin(a) * 0.78)) * CFrame.Angles(0, -a, 0),
			C.STEEL_DK,
			M.Metal,
			40,
			group .. "_Leg" .. tostring(i),
			row,
			{ canCollide = false }
		)
	end
end

-- Tủ hồ sơ / tủ locker (2 cánh, có tay nắm)
local function lockerBank(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	axis: "X" | "Z",
	fixed: number,
	c0: number,
	c1: number,
	y0: number,
	height: number,
	depth: number,
	doors: number,
	color: Color3,
	group: string,
	row: number
)
	local len = c1 - c0
	local bodySize = if axis == "X" then V(len, height, depth) else V(depth, height, len)
	local bodyPos = if axis == "X" then V((c0 + c1) * 0.5, y0 + height * 0.5, fixed) else V(fixed, y0 + height * 0.5, (c0 + c1) * 0.5)
	box(parent, name .. "_Body", bodySize, bodyPos, color, M.Metal, 200, group .. "_Body", row)
	local step = len / doors
	for i = 1, doors do
		local mid = c0 + step * (i - 0.5)
		local faceOff = depth * 0.5 + 0.06
		local dSize = if axis == "X" then V(step - 0.12, height - 0.30, 0.12) else V(0.12, height - 0.30, step - 0.12)
		local dPos = if axis == "X"
			then V(mid, y0 + height * 0.5, fixed + faceOff)
			else V(fixed + faceOff, y0 + height * 0.5, mid)
		box(parent, string.format("%s_Door%d", name, i), dSize, dPos, color, M.Metal, 70, string.format("%s_Door%d", name, i), row + 1, { canCollide = false })
		local hSize = if axis == "X" then V(0.5, 0.10, 0.16) else V(0.16, 0.10, 0.5)
		local hPos = if axis == "X"
			then V(mid + step * 0.22, y0 + height * 0.62, fixed + faceOff + 0.06)
			else V(fixed + faceOff + 0.06, y0 + height * 0.62, mid + step * 0.22)
		box(parent, string.format("%s_Handle%d", name, i), hSize, hPos, C.CHROME, M.Metal, 25, string.format("%s_Handle%d", name, i), row + 1, { canCollide = false })
		-- khe thông gió
		local vSize = if axis == "X" then V(step - 0.7, 0.16, 0.06) else V(0.06, 0.16, step - 0.7)
		for k = 1, 3 do
			local vPos = if axis == "X"
				then V(mid, y0 + height - 0.55 - k * 0.28, fixed + faceOff + 0.04)
				else V(fixed + faceOff + 0.04, y0 + height - 0.55 - k * 0.28, mid)
			box(parent, string.format("%s_Vent%d_%d", name, i, k), vSize, vPos, C.STEEL_DK, M.Metal, 15, string.format("%s_Vent%d_%d", name, i, k), row + 1, { canCollide = false, castShadow = false })
		end
	end
end

-- Đèn trần tuýp (khung + tấm phát sáng) treo dưới trần
local function ceilingLight(parent: Instance, name: string, cx: number, cz: number, ceilY: number, len: number, alongX: boolean, group: string)
	local w = if alongX then V(len, 0.35, 1.5) else V(1.5, 0.35, len)
	box(parent, name .. "_Frame", w, V(cx, ceilY - 0.125, cz), C.STEEL_LT, M.Metal, 70, group .. "_Frame", 2, { canCollide = false })
	local lens = if alongX then V(len - 0.5, 0.16, 1.1) else V(1.1, 0.16, len - 0.5)
	box(parent, name .. "_Lens", lens, V(cx, ceilY - 0.36, cz), C.NEON_W, M.Neon, 30, group .. "_Lens", 2, { canCollide = false, castShadow = false })
end

-- Cửa kính đơn (cánh + khung + tay nắm) cho vách ngăn nội bộ
local function glassDoorLeaf(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	axis: "X" | "Z",
	fixed: number,
	c0: number,
	c1: number,
	y0: number,
	y1: number,
	group: string,
	row: number
)
	local len = c1 - c0
	box(parent, name .. "_RailTop", if axis == "X" then V(len, 0.32, 0.20) else V(0.20, 0.32, len), if axis == "X" then V((c0 + c1) * 0.5, y1 - 0.2, fixed) else V(fixed, y1 - 0.2, (c0 + c1) * 0.5), C.STEEL_LT, M.Metal, 110, group .. "_RailT", row)
	box(parent, name .. "_RailBot", if axis == "X" then V(len, 0.42, 0.20) else V(0.20, 0.42, len), if axis == "X" then V((c0 + c1) * 0.5, y0 + 0.25, fixed) else V(fixed, y0 + 0.25, (c0 + c1) * 0.5), C.STEEL_LT, M.Metal, 110, group .. "_RailB", row)
	glassPane(parent, name .. "_Glass", axis, fixed, c0 + 0.14, c1 - 0.14, y0 + 0.48, y1 - 0.38, 80, group .. "_Pane", row + 1)
	local hx = if axis == "X" then c1 - 0.42 else fixed + 0.25
	local hz = if axis == "X" then fixed + 0.25 else c1 - 0.42
	box(parent, name .. "_Handle", V(0.14, 1.1, 0.14), V(hx, y0 + 3.4, hz), C.CHROME, M.Metal, 30, group .. "_Handle", row + 1, { canCollide = false })
end

-- Kệ hồ sơ treo tường (khung + 4 tầng + hộp hồ sơ)
local function recordShelves(parent: Instance, name: string, axis: "X" | "Z", fixed: number, c0: number, c1: number, y0: number, height: number, group: string, row: number)
	local len = c1 - c0
	local d = 1.6
	local bodySize = if axis == "X" then V(len, height, d) else V(d, height, len)
	local bodyPos = if axis == "X" then V((c0 + c1) * 0.5, y0 + height * 0.5, fixed) else V(fixed, y0 + height * 0.5, (c0 + c1) * 0.5)
	box(parent, name .. "_Back", bodySize, bodyPos, C.STEEL_DK, M.Metal, 180, group .. "_Back", row)
	local levels = 3
	for i = 1, levels do
		local ly = y0 + (height / levels) * i
		local sz = if axis == "X" then V(len - 0.2, 0.16, d + 0.2) else V(d + 0.2, 0.16, len - 0.2)
		local pos = if axis == "X" then V((c0 + c1) * 0.5, ly, fixed) else V(fixed, ly, (c0 + c1) * 0.5)
		box(parent, string.format("%s_Level%d", name, i), sz, pos, C.STEEL_LT, M.Metal, 70, string.format("%s_Lvl%d", name, i), row + 1)
		-- hộp hồ sơ trên mỗi tầng
		local boxes = math.max(2, math.floor(len / 1.9))
		for b = 1, boxes do
			local mid = c0 + (len / boxes) * (b - 0.5)
			local bs = if axis == "X" then V(len / boxes - 0.35, 0.9, 1.2) else V(1.2, 0.9, len / boxes - 0.35)
			local bp = if axis == "X" then V(mid, ly + 0.55, fixed) else V(fixed, ly + 0.55, mid)
			box(parent, string.format("%s_Box%d_%d", name, i, b), bs, bp, if (b + i) % 2 == 0 then C.WOOD_DK else C.STEEL, M.Cardboard, 30, string.format("%s_BoxG%d_%d", name, i, b), row + 2, { canCollide = false })
		end
	end
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 12. ĐIỂM VÀO MODULE — Master gọi Module.build(container)
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function Module.build(container: Instance): Folder
	local root = folder(container, "LSPD_MissionRow")
	buildSite(root)
	buildShell(root)
	buildFacade(root)
	buildGroundFloor(root)
	buildLobbyAndGarage(root)
	buildUpperFloor(root)
	buildRoof(root)
	local count = applyPerfPass(root)
	root:SetAttribute("ModuleId", Module.Id)
	root:SetAttribute("PlotId", Module.PlotId)
	root:SetAttribute("PartCount", count)
	root:SetAttribute("GroundY", GROUND)
	root:SetAttribute("MainGateX", 255.0)
	root:SetAttribute("MainGateZ", 69.4)
	root:SetAttribute("SallyPortZ", 29.0)
	root:SetAttribute("PoliceParkingX0", PARK_X0)
	root:SetAttribute("PoliceParkingX1", PARK_X1)
	root:SetAttribute("PoliceParkingZ0", PARK_Z0)
	root:SetAttribute("PoliceParkingZ1", PARK_Z1)
	return root
end

return Module

--!strict
--[[
	Plot_C3_Supermarket247.luau  —  SIÊU THỊ TIỆN LỢI 24/7 (MISSION ROW - NỬA TÂY)
	Tác giả : Agent Phụ (nhánh arena/bc783dbc-robloxstudio-connecting)
	Ô đất   : Plot_C3_West  |  Buildable Bounds: X 137..212, Z 20..123, groundY = 1.15
	Hướng   : Mặt tiền chính quay Nam (+Z ra Vespucci Blvd) & Tây (-X ra Alta St).

	KIẾN TRÚC & NỘI THẤT (tất cả ghép khối có máu ẩn `integrity` → xe tông / súng bắn tự vỡ):
	  • Mặt tiền vách kính lớn chia từng ô (integrity = 45 bắn vỡ), cửa đôi kính cao 9.0 studs.
	  • Mái hiên sọc XANH LÁ - TRẮNG - CAM phát sáng kiểu 24/7 GTA V + biển hiệu Neon "24/7".
	  • Cửa cuốn kho hàng (loading bay) rộng 16 × cao 12 studs ở mặt Tây (>= 15 x 11 cho xe tải).
	  • Bãi đậu xe có vạch kẻ + gờ chặn bánh + cọc chắn vàng + cột đèn + biển pylon trên nóc.
	  • FULL nội thất: 3 dãy kệ gondola đầy sản phẩm, quầy thu ngân 3 làn + máy tính tiền,
	    máy ATM 24h, quầy cà phê / máy Slushie, đảo trái cây, tủ lạnh nước ngọt cửa kính phát sáng
	    dọc tường sau + biển "COLD DRINKS", văn phòng quản lý vách kính, đèn tuýp trần, camera.

	GHI CHÚ KỸ THUẬT: `PartBuilder` thực tế cung cấp part / masonryWall (running-bond).
	Các hàm tiện ích `box`, `brickWall`, `segmentedRow` bên dưới là lớp bọc (wrapper) cục bộ
	gọi thẳng vào PartBuilder.part / PartBuilder.masonryWall và LUÔN truyền `integrity`
	=> từng viên gạch / ô kính / món đồ đều có thuộc tính máu ẩn Destructible/PartHealth.
	Chỉ có MÓNG SÀN chịu lực là để `structural` (Destructible = false) để không sập cả sàn.
]]

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local PartBuilder = require(Shared:WaitForChild("World"):WaitForChild("PartBuilder"))

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- HẰNG SỐ TOẠ ĐỘ & BẢNG MÀU
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local V = Vector3.new
local RGB = Color3.fromRGB

local FY = 1.6                 -- Cao độ mặt sàn hoàn thiện (top) của công trình (>= 1.20, không Z-fight 1.15)
local WT = 15.0               -- Chiều cao tường (trần 15 studs > 14 studs quy chuẩn R15)
local WALL_TOP = FY + WT      -- 16.6
local L, R = 143, 207         -- Biên Tây / Đông của khối nhà (X)
local K, F = 28, 92           -- Biên Bắc(sau) / Nam(trước) của khối nhà (Z)
local CX, CZ = (L + R) / 2, (K + F) / 2   -- 175, 60

local C_WALL    = RGB(228, 220, 200)   -- kem be
local C_WALL2   = RGB(208, 198, 176)   -- kem đậm
local C_BRICK   = RGB(178, 96, 64)     -- gạch nung
local C_FRAME   = RGB(64, 72, 82)      -- khung nhôm đen
local C_FRAME2  = RGB(126, 134, 144)   -- nhôm sáng
local C_GLASS   = RGB(150, 205, 226)   -- kính xanh nhạt
local C_GLASS2  = RGB(186, 224, 236)   -- kính cửa (trong hơn)
local C_GREEN   = RGB(42, 168, 82)     -- xanh lá thương hiệu
local C_DGREEN  = RGB(24, 74, 46)      -- xanh lá đậm (nền biển)
local C_WHITE   = RGB(242, 244, 240)
local C_ORANGE  = RGB(240, 122, 40)
local C_RED     = RGB(214, 56, 48)
local C_DARK    = RGB(22, 28, 36)
local C_NEON    = RGB(96, 244, 124)     -- neon xanh
local C_NEONW   = RGB(226, 255, 236)    -- neon trắng
local C_ASPHALT = RGB(50, 52, 58)
local C_TILE    = RGB(210, 210, 202)
local C_YELLOW  = RGB(244, 202, 58)
local C_BLUE    = RGB(40, 74, 140)

	RGB(214, 56, 48), RGB(240, 122, 40), RGB(244, 202, 58),
	RGB(64, 168, 96), RGB(46, 118, 206), RGB(150, 78, 190),
	RGB(230, 96, 150), RGB(228, 224, 210),
}

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- MODULE SPEC
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local Module = {
	Id = "Plot_C3_Supermarket247",
	PlotId = "Plot_C3_West",
	Order = 30,
	Enabled = true,
}

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- TIỆN ÍCH GHÉP KHỐI (tất cả truyền integrity -> Destructible = true, PartHealth = integrity)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
type BoxOpts = {
	material: any?,
	transparency: number?,
	reflectance: number?,
	shape: any?,
	canCollide: boolean?,
	castShadow: boolean?,
	group: string?,
	row: number?,
	structural: boolean?,
}

type SignText = {
	text: string,
	color: Color3?,
	sw: number?,
	sh: number?,
	px: number?,
	py: number?,
}

local function folder(parent: Instance, name: string): Instance
	local f = Instance.new("Folder")
	f.Name = name
	f.Parent = parent
	return f
end

-- box: 1 khối PartBuilder.part có máu ẩn. `structural = true` -> móng chịu lực (không phá huỷ).
local function box(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	pos: Vector3,
	size: Vector3,
	color: Color3,
	integrity: number?,
	opts: BoxOpts?
): Instance
	local o: BoxOpts = opts or {}
	local structural = o.structural == true
	local hp = integrity
	if not structural and hp == nil then
		hp = 120
	end
	return PartBuilder.part({
		name = name,
		parent = parent,
		pos = pos,
		size = size,
		color = color,
		material = o.material,
		transparency = o.transparency,
		reflectance = o.reflectance,
		shape = o.shape,
		canCollide = o.canCollide,
		castShadow = o.castShadow,
		destructible = (not structural),
		integrity = hp,
		fractureGroup = o.group or "Super247",
		structuralRow = o.row,
	})
end

-- brickWall: bọc PartBuilder.masonryWall (tường gạch xếp so le từng viên, mỗi viên có integrity)
local function brickWall(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	axis: "X" | "Z",
	fixed: number,
	minC: number,
	maxC: number,
	baseY: number,
	thickness: number,
	courses: number,
	courseH: number,
	color: Color3,
	integrity: number,
	group: string
): Instance
	return PartBuilder.masonryWall({
		name = name,
		parent = parent,
		axis = axis,
		fixedCoord = fixed,
		minCoord = minC,
		maxCoord = maxC,
		baseY = baseY,
		thickness = thickness,
		courses = courses,
		courseHeight = courseH,
		blockLength = 6.0,
		mortarGap = 0.08,
		baseColor = color,
		material = Enum.Material.Brick,
		colorJitter = 7,
		integrity = integrity,
		fractureGroup = group,
		addCoping = false,
	})
end

-- segmentedRow: dãy `count` khối bằng nhau (vách kính, nan cửa cuốn, sọc mái hiên, sản phẩm...)
local function segmentedRow(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	count: number,
	posFn: (number) -> Vector3,
	sizeFn: (number) -> Vector3,
	colorFn: (number) -> Color3,
	integrity: number?,
	opts: BoxOpts?
): ()
	for i = 1, count do
		box(parent, name .. "_" .. i, posFn(i), sizeFn(i), colorFn(i), integrity, opts)
	end
end

-- surfaceText: gắn SurfaceGui + các TextLabel lên 1 mặt của tấm biển (cho Roblox thật).
local function surfaceText(panel: Instance, face: any, entries: { SignText }): Instance
	local sgui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
	sgui.Face = face
	sgui.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud
	sgui.PixelsPerStud = 40
	sgui.LightInfluence = 0.1
	sgui.Parent = panel
	for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
		local tl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		tl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		tl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(e.sw or 0.92, e.sh or 0.5)
		tl.Position = UDim2.fromScale(e.px or 0.04, e.py or 0.1)
		tl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		tl.TextScaled = true
		tl.TextColor3 = e.color or C_WHITE
		tl.Text = e.text
		tl.Parent = sgui
	end
	return sgui
end

-- signBoard: tấm biển nền + chữ trên nhiều mặt. `faces` là danh sách Enum.NormalId.
local function signBoard(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	pos: Vector3,
	size: Vector3,
	bg: Color3,
	faces: { any },
	entries: { SignText }
): Instance
	local panel = box(parent, name, pos, size, bg, 160, { material = Enum.Material.Metal, group = "Signs" })
	for _, face in ipairs(faces) do
		surfaceText(panel, face, entries)
	end
	return panel
end

local Z_FACES = { Enum.NormalId.Front, Enum.NormalId.Back }
local X_FACES = { Enum.NormalId.Left, Enum.NormalId.Right }

-- 1. MÓNG / SÀN / BÃI ĐẬU XE
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function buildFoundation(fExt: Instance, fPark: Instance): ()

		{ material = Enum.Material.Concrete, structural = true })

	box(fExt, "Skirt_N", V(CX, FY + 0.35, K), V(64, 0.7, 1.4), C_WALL2, 260, { material = Enum.Material.Concrete })
	box(fExt, "Skirt_E", V(R, FY + 0.35, CZ), V(1.4, 0.7, 64), C_WALL2, 260, { material = Enum.Material.Concrete })

local function column(parent: Instance, name: string, x: number, z: number): ()
	box(parent, name, V(x, FY + WT / 2, z), V(1.7, WT, 1.7), C_FRAME, 280,
		{ material = Enum.Material.Metal, group = "Columns" })
	-- Đế & đầu cột bê tông
	box(parent, name .. "_Base", V(x, FY + 0.5, z), V(2.1, 1.0, 2.1), C_WALL2, 300, { material = Enum.Material.Concrete })
	box(parent, name .. "_Cap", V(x, FY + WT - 0.4, z), V(2.1, 0.8, 2.1), C_WALL2, 300, { material = Enum.Material.Concrete })
end

local function buildStructure(fExt: Instance): ()
	-- Cột góc + cột giữa mặt tiền
	column(fExt, "Col_SW", L, F)
	column(fExt, "Col_SE", R, F)
	column(fExt, "Col_NW", L, K)
	column(fExt, "Col_NE", R, K)
	column(fExt, "Col_S_Mid1", 160, F)
	column(fExt, "Col_S_Mid2", 190, F)

	-- Tường Đông (X = R) — brickWall chạy dọc Z, 12 hàng so le
	brickWall(fExt, "EastSolidWall", "Z", R, K, F, FY, 1.2, 12, 1.25, C_WALL, 200, "EastWall")
	-- Tường Bắc / sau (Z = K) — brickWall chạy dọc X
	brickWall(fExt, "NorthSolidWall", "X", K, L, R, FY, 1.2, 12, 1.25, C_WALL, 200, "NorthWall")

	-- MÁI: bản sàn bê tông + lan can chu vi (parapet)
	box(fExt, "RoofSlab", V(CX, WALL_TOP + 0.3, CZ), V(66, 0.6, 66), C_WALL2, 320,
		{ material = Enum.Material.Concrete, group = "Roof" })
	local ph = 1.6
	local pcy = WALL_TOP + 0.6 + ph / 2
	box(fExt, "Parapet_N", V(CX, pcy, K - 0.6), V(66, ph, 0.8), C_WALL, 180, { material = Enum.Material.Concrete })
	box(fExt, "Parapet_S", V(CX, pcy, F + 0.6), V(66, ph, 0.8), C_WALL, 180, { material = Enum.Material.Concrete })
	box(fExt, "Parapet_W", V(L - 0.6, pcy, CZ), V(0.8, ph, 64.4), C_WALL, 180, { material = Enum.Material.Concrete })
	box(fExt, "Parapet_E", V(R + 0.6, pcy, CZ), V(0.8, ph, 64.4), C_WALL, 180, { material = Enum.Material.Concrete })
	-- Nẹp neon dọc mép lan can mặt tiền (nổi bật ban đêm)
	box(fExt, "ParapetNeon_S", V(CX, WALL_TOP + 0.62, F + 1.02), V(64, 0.18, 0.18), C_NEON, 60,
		{ material = Enum.Material.Neon, canCollide = false, castShadow = false })

	-- Cụm máy điều hoà (HVAC) trên nóc + ống gió
	for i, hx in ipairs({ 160, 182, 201 }) do
		box(fExt, "HVAC_" .. i, V(hx, WALL_TOP + 2.1, 40), V(7, 3.0, 6), C_FRAME2, 130,
			{ material = Enum.Material.Metal, group = "Roof" })
		box(fExt, "HVAC_Fan_" .. i, V(hx, WALL_TOP + 3.7, 40), V(4.6, 0.3, 4.6), C_FRAME, 60,
			{ material = Enum.Material.Metal })
		box(fExt, "HVAC_Duct_" .. i, V(hx, WALL_TOP + 1.0, 46), V(2.2, 1.4, 8), C_FRAME2, 120,
			{ material = Enum.Material.Metal })
	end
end

local function buildStorefront(fExt: Instance): ()
	local GY = FY + 4.5            -- tâm kính (cao 9.0 -> Y 1.6..10.6)
	local BAY = (R - L) / 10       -- 6.4 mỗi ô kính mặt Nam

	-- === MẶT NAM (Z = F): vách kính 10 ô, ô 5 & 6 là cửa đôi kính ===
	for i = 1, 10 do
		local xc = L + (i - 0.5) * BAY
		if i == 5 or i == 6 then
			-- 2 cánh cửa kính (cao 9.0 >= 8.5), trong suốt để nhìn vào nội thất
			box(fExt, "DoorGlass_" .. i, V(xc, GY, F + 0.05), V(BAY - 0.5, 8.9, 0.22), C_GLASS2, 45,
				{ transparency = 0.15, material = Enum.Material.Glass, group = "Doors" })
			-- Khung cửa (2 đứng + 1 ngang) + tay đẩy inox
			box(fExt, "DoorStileL_" .. i, V(xc - BAY / 2 + 0.25, GY, F + 0.18), V(0.22, 8.9, 0.28), C_FRAME2, 90, { material = Enum.Material.Metal })
			box(fExt, "DoorStileR_" .. i, V(xc + BAY / 2 - 0.25, GY, F + 0.18), V(0.22, 8.9, 0.28), C_FRAME2, 90, { material = Enum.Material.Metal })
			box(fExt, "DoorRail_" .. i, V(xc, FY + 8.8, F + 0.18), V(BAY - 0.4, 0.28, 0.28), C_FRAME2, 90, { material = Enum.Material.Metal })
			box(fExt, "DoorPushBar_" .. i, V(xc, FY + 4.2, F + 0.32), V(BAY - 1.8, 0.16, 0.16), C_FRAME, 60, { material = Enum.Material.Metal })
		else
			box(fExt, "FrontGlass_" .. i, V(xc, GY, F), V(BAY - 0.35, 9.0, 0.3), C_GLASS, 45,
				{ transparency = 0.32, material = Enum.Material.Glass, group = "FrontGlass" })
			-- Bậu kính thấp (kick plate)
			box(fExt, "FrontKick_" .. i, V(xc, FY + 0.35, F), V(BAY - 0.62, 0.7, 0.62), C_FRAME2, 120, { material = Enum.Material.Metal })
		end
	end
	-- Trụ nhôm đứng (mullion) giữa các ô
	for i = 0, 10 do
		local x = L + i * BAY
		box(fExt, "Mullion_S_" .. i, V(x, GY + 0.2, F), V(0.36, 9.5, 0.6), C_FRAME, 170,
			{ material = Enum.Material.Metal, group = "FrontFrame" })
	end
	-- Thanh ngang đỉnh (transom)
	box(fExt, "Transom_S", V(CX, FY + 9.55, F), V(64, 0.5, 0.7), C_FRAME, 170, { material = Enum.Material.Metal })

	-- === MẶT TÂY (X = L): vách kính Z 48..92 + CỬA CUỐN KHO HÀNG Z 30..46 ===
	local wBays = 7
	local wBay = (F - 48) / wBays
	for i = 1, wBays do
		local zc = 48 + (i - 0.5) * wBay
		box(fExt, "WestGlass_" .. i, V(L, GY, zc), V(0.3, 9.0, wBay - 0.35), C_GLASS, 45,
			{ transparency = 0.32, material = Enum.Material.Glass, group = "WestGlass" })
		box(fExt, "WestKick_" .. i, V(L, FY + 0.35, zc), V(0.62, 0.7, wBay - 0.62), C_FRAME2, 120, { material = Enum.Material.Metal })
	end
	for i = 0, wBays do
		local z = 48 + i * wBay
		box(fExt, "Mullion_W_" .. i, V(L, GY + 0.2, z), V(0.6, 9.5, 0.36), C_FRAME, 170,
			{ material = Enum.Material.Metal, group = "WestFrame" })
	end
	box(fExt, "Transom_W", V(L, FY + 9.55, 70), V(0.7, 0.5, 44), C_FRAME, 170, { material = Enum.Material.Metal })
	-- Dải tường đặc trên phần kính phía Tây (Y 10.6..16.6)
	box(fExt, "WestUpperFascia", V(L, 13.6, 70), V(0.9, 6.0, 44), C_WALL, 190, { material = Enum.Material.Concrete })

	-- === CỬA CUỐN KHO HÀNG (loading bay) rộng 16 × cao 12 trên tường Tây, tâm Z = 38 ===
	local doorZ0, doorZ1 = 30, 46
	local doorCZ = (doorZ0 + doorZ1) / 2   -- 38
	local slats = 12
	segmentedRow(fExt, "RollupShutter", slats,
		function(i) return V(L, FY + (i - 0.5) * 1.0, doorCZ) end,
		function(i) return V((i % 2 == 0) and 0.62 or 0.45, 1.0, 15.8) end,
		function(i) return (i % 2 == 0) and C_FRAME2 or C_FRAME end, 55,
		{ material = Enum.Material.Metal, group = "RollupDoor" })
	-- Khung cửa cuốn: 2 trụ đứng + lintel + motor housing
	for i, dz in ipairs({ doorZ0, doorZ1 }) do
		box(fExt, "RollupJamb_" .. i, V(L, FY + 6.2, dz), V(0.7, 12.4, 0.7), C_FRAME, 200, { material = Enum.Material.Metal })
	end
	box(fExt, "RollupLintel", V(L, FY + 12.3, doorCZ), V(0.7, 0.8, 16.8), C_FRAME, 200, { material = Enum.Material.Metal })
	box(fExt, "RollupMotor", V(L - 0.3, FY + 12.9, doorZ0 + 1), V(1.4, 1.2, 3.0), C_DARK, 130, { material = Enum.Material.Metal })
	-- Mảng tường đặc 2 bên & phía trên cửa cuốn
	box(fExt, "RollupPierL", V(L, FY + WT / 2, 29), V(1.2, WT, 2.0), C_BRICK, 200, { material = Enum.Material.Brick })
	box(fExt, "RollupPierR", V(L, FY + WT / 2, 47), V(1.2, WT, 2.0), C_BRICK, 200, { material = Enum.Material.Brick })
	box(fExt, "RollupHeader", V(L, 15.1, doorCZ), V(1.2, 3.0, 16.0), C_WALL, 200, { material = Enum.Material.Concrete })

	-- Bến bốc dỡ (loading dock) ngoài cửa cuốn, sát mặt Tây (X 138..143, trong bounds)
	box(fExt, "LoadingDock", V(140.5, 1.4, doorCZ), V(5, 0.5, 18), C_WALL2, 320, { material = Enum.Material.Concrete })
	box(fExt, "LoadingDockEdge", V(138.2, 1.68, doorCZ), V(0.3, 0.1, 18), C_YELLOW, 60, { canCollide = false })
	-- Biển "RECEIVING / DELIVERIES" phía trên cửa cuốn
	signBoard(fExt, "ReceivingSign", V(L - 0.7, 14.6, doorCZ), V(0.5, 1.6, 12), C_DARK, X_FACES,
		{ { text = "DELIVERIES · RECEIVING", color = C_YELLOW, sw = 0.94, sh = 0.6, px = 0.03, py = 0.2 } })
end

	-- Các sọc trên mặt mái
	segmentedRow(fSign, "AwningTopStripe", stripeN,
		function(i) return V(144 + (i - 0.5) * stripeW, 11.13, awningZ) end,
		function(i) return V(stripeW - 0.06, 0.08, 7.4) end,
		function(i) return awningColors[(i - 1) % 3 + 1] end, 90, { material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic })
	-- Diềm rủ xuống (valance) mép trước mái hiên, cũng sọc

	-- Biển hiệu góc Tây trên dải tường (quay -X ra Alta St)

local function buildGondola(fInt: Instance, x: number, idx: number, label: string, sub: string): ()
	local g = folder(fInt, "Gondola_" .. idx)
	local gz, gLen = 58, 30           -- chạy Z 43..73
	-- Đế + xương sống
	box(g, "Plinth", V(x, FY + 0.25, gz), V(5.6, 0.5, gLen + 1), C_FRAME2, 130, { material = Enum.Material.Metal })
	box(g, "Spine", V(x, FY + 2.7, gz), V(0.7, 4.9, gLen), C_FRAME, 140, { material = Enum.Material.Metal })
	-- 2 đầu hồi (end caps)
	for i, ez in ipairs({ gz - gLen / 2, gz + gLen / 2 }) do
		box(g, "EndCap_" .. i, V(x, FY + 2.6, ez), V(5.6, 5.0, 0.5), C_BLUE, 120, { material = Enum.Material.Metal })
	end
	-- 3 tầng kệ 2 bên + sản phẩm nhiều màu (mỗi hộp có integrity = 22 -> bắn vỡ)
	local levels = { 1.5, 3.0, 4.5 }
	for li, ly in ipairs(levels) do
		for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			local shelfX = x + side * 1.45
			box(g, "Shelf_L" .. li .. "_S" .. side, V(shelfX, FY + ly, gz), V(2.4, 0.14, gLen - 0.6), C_FRAME2, 90,
				{ material = Enum.Material.Metal })
			segmentedRow(g, "Prod_L" .. li .. "_S" .. side, 7,
				function(i) return V(shelfX, FY + ly + 0.62, gz - 13 + (i - 1) * 4.3) end,
				function(i) return V(2.0, 1.1, 3.5) end,
				function(i) return PRODUCT_COLORS[(i + li + (side + 1) + idx) % #PRODUCT_COLORS + 1] end, 22,
				{ material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic })
		end
	end
	-- Biển treo lối đi (aisle sign) phía trên, quay ra cửa (+Z)

	end
end

local function buildCooler(fInt: Instance, x: number, idx: number): ()

function Module.build(modulesContainer: Instance): Instance
	local root = folder(modulesContainer, Module.Id)

	local fExt = folder(root, "01_Exterior")

	local fPark = folder(root, "03_Parking")

	buildFoundation(fExt, fPark)
	buildStructure(fExt)
	buildStorefront(fExt)
	buildSignage(fSign)
	buildParkingProps(fPark)
	buildInterior(fInt)

	-- Attribute báo cáo số máu ẩn trung bình để Agent Chính tiện nghiệm thu
	root:SetAttribute("DestructibleStore", true)
	root:SetAttribute("MainEntrance", "X=175, Z=92 (mặt Nam ra Vespucci Blvd)")
	root:SetAttribute("VehicleRollupDoor", "X=143, Z=38 (mặt Tây ra Alta St), rộng 16 x cao 12")

	return root
end

return Module

--!strict
--[[
	Plot_D2_MazeBankTower.luau
	THÁP TÀI CHÍNH MAZE BANK PLAZA & TOWER — ô Plot_D2 (PILLBOX HILL)

	Vùng xây: X −83..83 · Z −199..−63 · mặt nền Y = 1.15 (theo WorldGrid.luau).
	Mặt tiền hướng Nam (+Z) nhìn ra Olympic Fwy và Quảng trường Legion Square.

	KIẾN TRÚC
	  • Plaza 2 bậc thang, đài phun nước bán nguyệt, 4 chậu cây, cột cờ, ghế đá, đèn sân.
	  • Sảnh giao dịch thông tầng 19.0 studs: sàn cẩm thạch khảm, quầy lễ tân chữ L,
	    4 thang máy kính + bảng tầng, cổng dò kim loại + turnstile, sofa da, gác lửng có
	    lan can kính, đèn chùm, biển vàng "MAZE BANK", cầu thang đôi.
	  • Thân tháp thu dần 6 tầng kính, mỗi tầng nhỏ hơn 3 studs mỗi cạnh, có trụ góc bậc thang,
	    diềm ngang (spandrel), lam đứng; MỖI Ô KÍNH có máu ẩn riêng (bắn vỡ từng tấm).
	  • Tầng kỹ thuật + sân thượng: bãi đáp trực thăng TRÒN "MAZE BANK" đỏ/trắng, chữ H,
	    đèn hiệu nhấp nháy, cột ăng-ten, lan can an toàn.
	  • 2 cánh đế Đông/Tây: hầm đỗ xe, cửa cuốn ô tô 18 × 12 studs, vạch đỗ + gờ chặn bánh.

	HIỆU NĂNG (docs/PERFORMANCE.md)
	  Mọi part CanTouch = false và EnableFluidForces = false; part < 1.6 stud tắt CanCollide;
	  kính / neon / part nhỏ tắt CastShadow; sàn & mái mỏng rộng LUÔN CanCollide = true;
	  SurfaceGui đặt MaxDistance = 340 với PixelsPerStud giới hạn canvas ≤ 1100 px;
	  KHÔNG dùng TextScaled (dùng TextSize cố định).

	GHI CHÚ: PartBuilder thực tế cung cấp part / wedge / masonryWall / staircase …
	Các tiện ích box / brickWall / segmentedRow bên dưới là lớp bọc cục bộ gọi thẳng
	vào PartBuilder và LUÔN truyền `integrity` → mọi khối đều có máu ẩn phá huỷ được.
]]

-- 3. TIỆN ÍCH GHÉP KHỐI + TỰ ĐỘNG ÁP LUẬT HIỆU NĂNG
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
type BoxOpts = {
	material: Enum.Material?,
	transparency: number?,
	reflectance: number?,
	canCollide: boolean?,
	castShadow: boolean?,
	group: string?,
	row: number?,
	structural: boolean?,
	walkable: boolean?,
	query: boolean?,
	shape: Enum.PartType?,
}

type SignText = {
	text: string,
	color: Color3?,
	font: Enum.Font?,
	ths: number?,
	sw: number?,
	sh: number?,
	px: number?,
	py: number?,
}

local function folder(parent: any, name: string): any
	local f = Instance.new("Folder")
	f.Name = name
	f.Parent = parent
	return f
end

local function maxDim(size: Vector3): number
	return math.max(size.X, math.max(size.Y, size.Z))
end

-- Áp đúng 5 quy tắc PerfOptimizer ngay trong module (không chờ lớp tối ưu toàn cục).
local function resolvePerf(size: Vector3, o: BoxOpts): (boolean, boolean, boolean)
	local md: number = maxDim(size)
	local isThin: boolean = size.X <= 1.3 or size.Y <= 1.3 or size.Z <= 1.3
	local isWide: boolean = size.X >= 4.0 and size.Z >= 4.0
	-- Sàn / mái mỏng rộng → LUÔN va chạm để người chơi không rơi xuyên
	local walkable: boolean = (o.walkable == true) or (isThin and isWide and size.Y <= 1.3)
	local isGlass: boolean = o.material == Enum.Material.Glass
	local isNeon: boolean = o.material == Enum.Material.Neon
	local seeThrough: boolean = (o.transparency or 0) > 0.05

	local collide: boolean
	if o.canCollide ~= nil then
		collide = o.canCollide :: boolean
	elseif walkable then
		collide = true
	elseif md < 1.6 then
		collide = false
	elseif isGlass or isNeon then
		collide = false
	else
		collide = true
	end

	local shadow: boolean
	if o.castShadow ~= nil then
		shadow = o.castShadow :: boolean
	else
		shadow = not (md < 3.0 or isGlass or isNeon or seeThrough)
	end

	return collide, shadow, walkable
end

-- box: 1 khối PartBuilder.part CÓ MÁU ẨN. structural = true → móng/kết cấu không phá huỷ.
local function box(
	parent: any,
	name: string,
	pos: Vector3,
	size: Vector3,
	color: Color3,
	integrity: number?,
	opts: BoxOpts?
): any
	local o: BoxOpts = opts or {}
	local structural: boolean = o.structural == true
	local hp: number? = integrity
	if not structural and hp == nil then
		hp = 120
	end

	local collide: boolean, shadow: boolean, walkable: boolean = resolvePerf(size, o)
	if walkable then
		collide = true
	end

	local part = PartBuilder.part({
		name = name,
		parent = parent,
		pos = pos,
		size = size,
		color = color,
		material = o.material,
		transparency = o.transparency,
		reflectance = o.reflectance,
		shape = o.shape,
		canCollide = collide,
		castShadow = shadow,
		destructible = (not structural),
		integrity = hp,
		fractureGroup = o.group or "MazeBank",
		structuralRow = o.row,
	})

	-- Luật cứng: mọi part CanTouch = false; khối phá huỷ luôn CanQuery = true (đạn + quét xe)
	if part then
		part.CanTouch = false
		part.EnableFluidForces = false
		if o.query ~= nil then
			part.CanQuery = o.query
		else
			part.CanQuery = (not structural)
		end
	end
	return part
end

-- brickWall: tường gạch xếp so le từng viên (mỗi viên một bể máu riêng)
local function brickWall(
	parent: any,
	name: string,
	axis: "X" | "Z",
	fixed: number,
	minC: number,
	maxC: number,
	baseY: number,
	thickness: number,
	courses: number,
	courseH: number,
	color: Color3,
	integrity: number,
	group: string,
	blockLen: number?
): any
	local wall = PartBuilder.masonryWall({
		name = name,
		parent = parent,
		axis = axis,
		fixedCoord = fixed,
		minCoord = minC,
		maxCoord = maxC,
		baseY = baseY,
		thickness = thickness,
		courses = courses,
		courseHeight = courseH,
		blockLength = blockLen or 6.0,
		mortarGap = 0.08,
		baseColor = color,
		material = Enum.Material.Brick,
		colorJitter = 5,
		integrity = integrity,
		fractureGroup = group,
		addCoping = false,
	})
	-- Luật hiệu năng: mọi viên gạch CanTouch = false, CanQuery = true, không đổ bóng
	for _, ch in ipairs(wall:GetChildren()) do
		if ch.ClassName == "Part" then
			ch.Name = name .. "_" .. ch.Name
			ch.CanTouch = false
			ch.EnableFluidForces = false
			ch.CanQuery = true
			ch.CastShadow = false
		end
	end
	return wall
end

-- segmentedRow: dãy khối lặp (ô kính, lam, nan cửa cuốn, sản phẩm…)
local function segmentedRow(
	parent: any,
	name: string,
	count: number,
	posFn: (number) -> Vector3,
	sizeFn: (number) -> Vector3,
	colorFn: (number) -> Color3,
	integrity: number?,
	opts: BoxOpts?
): ()
	for i = 1, count do
		box(parent, name .. "_" .. i, posFn(i), sizeFn(i), colorFn(i), integrity, opts)
	end
end

-- signText: SurfaceGui trên 1 mặt tấm biển. Canvas ≤ 1100 px, MaxDistance = 340, KHÔNG TextScaled.
local function signText(panel: any, face: Enum.NormalId, entries: { SignText }): any
	local w: number, h: number
	if face == Enum.NormalId.Front or face == Enum.NormalId.Back then
		w, h = panel.Size.X, panel.Size.Y
	elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Left or face == Enum.NormalId.Right then
		w, h = panel.Size.Z, panel.Size.Y
	else
		w, h = panel.Size.X, panel.Size.Z
	end

	-- PixelsPerStud giới hạn để canvas không vượt 1100 px (docs/PERFORMANCE.md)
	local pps: number = math.min(1100 / math.max(w, 0.1), 1100 / math.max(h, 0.1), 32)
	pps = math.max(4, math.floor(pps * 100) / 100)

	local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
	gui.Face = face
	gui.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud
	gui.PixelsPerStud = pps
	gui.MaxDistance = 340
	gui.LightInfluence = 0.12
	gui.Parent = panel

	for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
		local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		lbl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(e.sw or 0.92, e.sh or 0.5)
		lbl.Position = UDim2.fromScale(e.px or 0.04, e.py or 0.1)
		lbl.Font = e.font or Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		lbl.TextScaled = false
		lbl.TextSize = math.max(8, math.floor((e.ths or 2.0) * pps))
		lbl.TextColor3 = e.color or C_WHITE
		lbl.Text = e.text
		lbl.Parent = gui
	end
	return gui
end

-- signBoard: tấm biển nền + chữ trên nhiều mặt
local function signBoard(
	parent: any,
	name: string,
	pos: Vector3,
	size: Vector3,
	bg: Color3,
	faces: { Enum.NormalId },
	entries: { SignText },
	integrity: number?
): any
	local panel = box(parent, name, pos, size, bg, integrity or 160, {
		material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		group = "Signs",
	})
	for _, face in ipairs(faces) do
		signText(panel, face, entries)
	end
	return panel
end

-- stairs: bậc thang chính xác do mình kiểm soát (không sinh tường má ngoài ý muốn)
local function stairs(
	parent: any,
	name: string,
	cx: number,
	zLow: number,
	width: number,
	baseY: number,
	rise: number,
	run: number,
	steps: number,
	color: Color3
): ()
	local stepRise: number = rise / steps
	local stepRun: number = run / steps
	for s = 1, steps do
		local h: number = stepRise * s
		local zc: number = zLow - (s - 0.5) * stepRun
		box(parent, name .. "_Step" .. s, V(cx, baseY + h * 0.5, zc), V(width, h, stepRun + 0.12), color, 240, {
			material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
			group = "Stairs",
		})
	end
end
