-- 11. SINH NPC DÂN PHỐ (danh sách điểm vỉa hè nằm ở mục 8.5)
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

-- Tỉ lệ tính cách xuất hiện trên đường phố
local ARCHETYPE_ROLL = {
	{ id = "CIVILIAN", upTo = 0.34 },
	{ id = "TOURIST", upTo = 0.50 },
	{ id = "BUSINESS", upTo = 0.62 },
	{ id = "COP", upTo = 0.73 },
	{ id = "GANGSTER", upTo = 0.86 },
	{ id = "BRAWLER", upTo = 1.00 },
}

local function rollArchetype(): string
	local r = math.random()
	for _, entry in ipairs(ARCHETYPE_ROLL) do
		if r <= entry.upTo then
			return entry.id
		end
	end
	return "CIVILIAN"
end

function NPCManager.spawnAmbient(count: number?): number
	local target = count or AMBIENT_COUNT
	local points = buildSidewalkPoints()
	if #points == 0 then
		return 0
	end

	local made = 0
	local tries = 0
	local maxTries = target * 9

	while made < target and tries < maxTries do
		tries += 1
		local pt = points[math.random(1, #points)]
		local g = findGround(pt.X, pt.Z)
		if g then
			-- Không dồn cục: cách NPC khác tối thiểu 9 stud
			local tooClose = false
			for _, other in pairs(states) do
				if other.state ~= "DEAD" and (other.hrp.Position - g).Magnitude < 9 then
					tooClose = true
					break
				end
			end
			if not tooClose and NPCManager.spawn(rollArchetype(), g) then
				made += 1
			end
		end
	end

	ambientSpawned = true
	return made
end

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 12. GIAO THÔNG — NPC LÁI XE CHẠY VÒNG QUANH THÀNH PHỐ
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

-- Toạ độ đã canh ĐÚNG LÀN BÊN PHẢI của từng đại lộ trong WorldGrid:
--   Olympic Fwy (Z=-36) · Vespucci Blvd (Z=148) · San Andreas (X=-110) · Alta St (X=110)
--   Vinewood Blvd (Z=-224) · Del Perro (X=-324) · Elgin Ave (X=324)
local TRAFFIC_ROUTES = {
	{
		-- vòng trung tâm
		Vector3.new(-98, 0, -27),
		Vector3.new(98, 0, -27),
		Vector3.new(98, 0, 138),
		Vector3.new(-98, 0, 138),
	},
	{
		-- vòng vành đai giữa
		Vector3.new(330, 0, 154),
		Vector3.new(330, 0, -230),
		Vector3.new(-330, 0, -230),
		Vector3.new(-330, 0, 154),
	},
	{
		-- vòng vành đai ngoài cùng (2 đại lộ mới X = ±540)
		Vector3.new(-548, 0, 154),
		Vector3.new(-548, 0, -230),
		Vector3.new(548, 0, -230),
		Vector3.new(548, 0, 154),
	},
}

local TRAFFIC_TRIMS = {
	VehicleBuilder.PRESETS.CrimsonBanshee,
	VehicleBuilder.PRESETS.MidnightBanshee,
	VehicleBuilder.PRESETS.ObsidianGauntlet,
	VehicleBuilder.PRESETS.SunsetComet,
}

local function spawnTrafficCar(routeIdx: number, startIdx: number?)
	if not trafficFolder then
		return nil
	end
	local route = TRAFFIC_ROUTES[routeIdx]
	if not route then
		return nil
	end

	-- startIdx giúp 2 xe cùng tuyến xuất phát lệch nhau, không chồng khít
	local idx = ((startIdx or math.random(1, #route)) - 1) % #route + 1
	local from = route[idx]
	local to = route[(idx % #route) + 1]
	local ground = findGround(from.X, from.Z)
	if not ground then
		return nil
	end

	local pos = Vector3.new(from.X, ground.Y, from.Z)
	local dir = Vector3.new(to.X, 0, to.Z) - Vector3.new(from.X, 0, from.Z)
	if dir.Magnitude < 1 then
		return nil
	end
	dir = dir.Unit

	local cf = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + dir)
	local trim = TRAFFIC_TRIMS[math.random(1, #TRAFFIC_TRIMS)]
	local car = VehicleBuilder.spawn(trafficFolder, cf, trim)
	local chassis = car.PrimaryPart
	if not chassis then
		car:Destroy()
		return nil
	end

	-- Gắn cứng toàn bộ xe vào khung sườn, neo khung sườn lại
	-- -> mỗi nhịp chỉ cần đổi ĐÚNG 1 CFrame, không tốn CPU cho 150 part
	chassis.Anchored = true
	chassis.CanCollide = false
	chassis.CanTouch = false
	for _, d in ipairs(car:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d ~= chassis then
			d.Anchored = false
			d.CanCollide = false
			d.CanTouch = false
			-- VehicleBuilder đã hàn sẵn phần lớn chi tiết vào khung sườn rồi;
			-- chỉ hàn thêm chi tiết còn rời (nếu có) để tránh 2 mối hàn chồng nhau.
			if not d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("WeldConstraint") then
				local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
				w.Part0 = chassis
				w.Part1 = d
				w.Parent = d
			end
		end
	end

	-- TÀI XẾ NPC ngồi trong xe
	-- Rig R6: tâm HumanoidRootPart/Torso nằm trên mặt ghế 1,12 stud (nửa thân trên 1 stud
	-- + 0,12 độ dày ghế) -> đầu không đội mui, chân không xuyên sàn.
	local seat = car:FindFirstChild("DriverSeat", true)
	local seatCF: CFrame
	local seatPos: Vector3
	if seat and seat:IsA("BasePart") then
		seatCF = seat.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.12, 0)
		seatPos = seat.Position
	else
		seatCF = chassis.CFrame * CFrame.new(-1.68, 1.1, 0.48)
		seatPos = seatCF.Position
	end

	local driverId = if math.random() < 0.15 then "GANGSTER" else rollArchetype()
	local driver = NPCManager.spawn(driverId, seatPos, seatCF)
	if driver then
		driver.Parent = car -- nằm gọn trong xe, dọn xe là dọn luôn tài xế
		driver:SetAttribute("IsDriver", true)
		driver:SetAttribute("AnimState", "DRIVE")
		local st = states[driver]
		if st then
			st.animState = "DRIVE"
			st.folder = trafficFolder :: Folder
			if st.anims then
				NPCAppearance.stopAnim(st.anims)
			end
		end
		local hum = driver:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local hrp = driver:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hum then
			hum.WalkSpeed = 0
			hum.JumpPower = 0
			hum.AutoRotate = false
			hum.PlatformStand = true -- tắt máy trạng thái Humanoid, giữ nguyên tư thế ngồi
		end
		if hrp and hrp:IsA("BasePart") then
			local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
			w.Part0 = chassis
			w.Part1 = hrp
			w.Parent = chassis
		end
	end

	local sp = math.random(26, 34)
	table.insert(traffic, {
		car = car,
		chassis = chassis,
		driver = driver,
		route = route,
		idx = (idx % #route) + 1,
		pos = pos,
		heading = dir,
		speed = sp,
		baseSpeed = sp,
	})
	return car
end

local function stepTraffic(dt: number)
	for i = #traffic, 1, -1 do
		local t = traffic[i]
		local car = t.car
		local chassis = t.chassis
		if not car.Parent or not chassis.Parent then
			table.remove(traffic, i)
			continue
		end

		-- Tài xế chết -> xe dừng khựng lại; tài xế hoảng loạn -> tăng tốc bỏ chạy
		local st = if t.driver then states[t.driver] else nil
		if st and (st.state == "DEAD" or st.hum.Health <= 0) then
			t.speed = math.max(0, t.speed - dt * 45)
		elseif st and st.state == "REACT" and st.reaction == "FLEE" then
			t.speed = math.min(t.baseSpeed + 18, t.speed + dt * 24)
		else
			t.speed = math.min(t.baseSpeed, t.speed + dt * 8)
		end

		-- Tiến tới điểm mốc kế tiếp
		local target = Vector3.new(t.route[t.idx].X, t.pos.Y, t.route[t.idx].Z)
		local to = target - t.pos
		local dist = to.Magnitude
		local step = t.speed * dt
		if dist <= step or dist < 0.6 then
			t.pos = target
			t.idx = (t.idx % #t.route) + 1
		else
			t.pos = t.pos + to.Unit * step
		end

		-- Xoay mũi xe mượt về hướng mốc kế tiếp
		local nextPt = Vector3.new(t.route[t.idx].X, t.pos.Y, t.route[t.idx].Z)
		local desired = nextPt - t.pos
		if desired.Magnitude > 0.8 then
			t.heading = t.heading:Lerp(desired.Unit, math.clamp(dt * 2.6, 0, 1))
			if t.heading.Magnitude > 0.01 then
				t.heading = t.heading.Unit
			end
		end

		local basePos = t.pos + Vector3.new(0, 2.36, 0)
		if t.heading.Magnitude > 0.01 then
			chassis.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(basePos, basePos + t.heading)
		end
	end
end

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 12.5. NPC MANG SKIN CỦA NGƯỜI CHƠI ("bản sao" đi lại trong thành phố)
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

--- Dựng một NPC giống hệt avatar của `player`, đứng cách họ 40–160 stud.
function NPCManager.spawnPlayerTwin(player: Player): Model?
	if not npcFolder then
		return nil
	end
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
	if not hrp or not hrp:IsA("BasePart") then
		return nil
	end

	-- Tìm điểm vỉa hè cách người chơi 40–160 stud (không hiện ra ngay trước mặt)
	local pts = getSidewalkPoints()
	local origin = hrp.Position
	local chosen: Vector3? = nil
	for _ = 1, 24 do
		local p = pts[math.random(1, #pts)]
		local d = (Vector3.new(p.X, 0, p.Z) - Vector3.new(origin.X, 0, origin.Z)).Magnitude
		if d >= 40 and d <= 160 then
			local g = findGround(p.X, p.Z)
			if g then
				chosen = g
				break
			end
		end
	end
	if not chosen then
		chosen = origin + Vector3.new(math.random(-60, 60), 0, math.random(-60, 60))
	end

	local spot = chosen :: Vector3
	local cf = CFrame.new(spot.X, spot.Y + 3.06, spot.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.random() * math.pi * 2, 0)

	local built = NPCAppearance.fromPlayer(player, cf)
	if not built then
		return nil
	end
	local model, hum, h, head = built
	model.Parent = npcFolder
	model:SetAttribute("IsGTA_NPC", true)
	model:SetAttribute("Archetype", "CIVILIAN")

	local st: NPCState = {
		model = model,
		hum = hum,
		hrp = h,
		head = head :: any,
		arch = ARCHETYPES.CIVILIAN,
		folder = npcFolder :: Folder,
		state = "PATROL",
		reaction = nil,
		attacker = nil,
		reactUntil = 0,
		nextShot = 0,
		nextMelee = 0,
		patrolTarget = h.Position,
		nextPatrolAt = 0,
		gunModel = nil,
		phone = nil,
		bubble = nil,
		gunFlashAt = 0,
		lastGoal = nil,
		lastMoveAt = 0,
		animState = "IDLE",
		anims = nil,
		targetAt = 0,
		checkFrom = h.Position,
		pauseUntil = 0,
	}
	st.anims = NPCAppearance.loadAnimations(model, hum)
	if st.anims then
		NPCAppearance.tuneGait(st.anims, 14)
	end
	model:SetAttribute("UsesRealAnims", st.anims ~= nil)
	states[model] = st
	setBubble(st, nil)
	startLoop()
	print(string.format("[NPC] Đã thả bản sao của %s vào thành phố", player.Name))
	return model
end

local twinsHooked = false
local function hookPlayerTwins()
	if twinsHooked then
		return
	end
	twinsHooked = true

	local function tryTwin(player: Player)
		task.spawn(function()
			-- Chờ nhân vật + mẫu R15 sẵn sàng
			for _ = 1, 60 do
				if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					and NPCAppearance.templateCount() > 0 then
					break
				end
				task.wait(0.5)
			end
			task.wait(1)
			local ok, err = pcall(NPCManager.spawnPlayerTwin, player)
			if not ok then
				warn("[NPC] Không tạo được bản sao người chơi:", err)
			end
		end)
	end

	for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		tryTwin(pl)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(tryTwin)
end

function NPCManager.spawnTraffic(count: number?): number
	local target = count or TRAFFIC_COUNT
	if not trafficFolder then
		return 0
	end
	local made = 0
	for i = 1, target do
		local routeIdx = ((i - 1) % #TRAFFIC_ROUTES) + 1
		local lap = ((i - 1) // #TRAFFIC_ROUTES) -- xe thứ mấy trên tuyến này
		if spawnTrafficCar(routeIdx, lap * 2 + 1) then
			made += 1
			task.wait(0.15) -- rải đều, tránh dựng 4 xe trong cùng 1 frame
		end
	end
	return made
end

local trafficRunning = false
local function startTrafficLoop()
	if trafficRunning then
		return
	end
	trafficRunning = true
	task.spawn(function()
		local last = os.clock()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.05)
			local tNow = os.clock()
			local dt = math.min(0.25, tNow - last)
			last = tNow
			local ok, err = pcall(stepTraffic, dt)
			if not ok then
				warn("[NPC] lỗi vòng lặp giao thông:", err)
			end
		end
	end)
end

function NPCManager.init(hud: RemoteEvent?)
	hudRemote = hud

	-- Dọn các lần chạy trước
	for _, folderName in ipairs({ NPC_FOLDER_NAME, TRAFFIC_FOLDER_NAME }) do
		local old = Workspace:FindFirstChild(folderName)
		if old then
			old:Destroy()
		end
	end
	table.clear(states)
	table.clear(traffic)

	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = NPC_FOLDER_NAME
	folder.Parent = Workspace
	npcFolder = folder

	local tf = Instance.new("Folder")
	tf.Name = TRAFFIC_FOLDER_NAME
	tf.Parent = Workspace
	trafficFolder = tf

	startLoop()
	startTrafficLoop()

	hookPlayerTwins()

	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(2)

		-- Dựng mẫu nhân vật R15 của Roblox (chỉ 4 lần; các NPC sau chỉ clone)
		local t0 = os.clock()
		local templates = NPCAppearance.warmTemplates(4)
		if templates > 0 then
			print(string.format("[NPC] Đã dựng %d mẫu nhân vật R15 của Roblox (%.2fs)", templates, os.clock() - t0))
		else
			warn("[NPC] Không dựng được model R15 — tạm dùng rig R6 tự ghép")
		end

		local n = NPCManager.spawnAmbient(AMBIENT_COUNT)
		print(string.format("[NPC] Đã dựng %d NPC rải khắp vỉa hè thành phố", n))

		task.wait(1)
		local cars = NPCManager.spawnTraffic(TRAFFIC_COUNT)
		print(string.format("[NPC] Đã thả %d xe có TÀI XẾ NPC chạy vòng quanh phố", cars))
	end)

	return NPCManager
end

function NPCManager.getStats()
	local byReaction: { [string]: number } = {}
	local alive = 0
	local reacting = 0
	for _, st in pairs(states) do
		if st.state ~= "DEAD" then
			alive += 1
			if st.state == "REACT" and st.reaction then
				reacting += 1
				byReaction[st.reaction] = (byReaction[st.reaction] or 0) + 1
			end
		end
	end
	local r15 = 0
	for _, st in pairs(states) do
		if st.anims then
			r15 += 1
		end
	end
	return { alive = alive, reacting = reacting, byReaction = byReaction, max = MAX_NPCS, traffic = #traffic, r15 = r15 }
end

-- Xuất hàm chọn phản ứng để QA/kiểm thử tự động
NPCManager._debugChooseReaction = chooseReaction
NPCManager._debugPickWeighted = pickWeighted

return NPCManager

VehicleManager.source:
--!strict
--[[
	VehicleManager.luau
	Điều khiển vật lý lái xe GTA V mượt mà + Xử lý VA CHẠM TỐC ĐỘ CAO trừ máu ẩn (PartHealth):
	- Khi xe tông vào cọc tiêu, dải phân cách K-Rail, tường gạch, bờ kè hoặc xe khác:
	  + Khối bị tông mất máu ẩn theo động lượng -> hết máu tự vỡ tung thành mảnh rời!
	  + Chính cản trước / đèn pha / nắp capo / kính chắn gió của xe cũng mất máu ẩn -> hết máu bung rơi khỏi xe!
]]

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local VehicleBuilder = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Vehicles"):WaitForChild("VehicleBuilder"))
local DestructionManager = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("DestructionManager"))

local VehicleManager = {}

local trackedCars: { [Model]: boolean } = {}
local partHitCooldown: { [BasePart]: number } = {}
local carSelfHitCooldown: { [Model]: number } = {}

-- =====================================================================
-- BỘ NHỚ ĐỆM HIỆU NĂNG (tránh cấp phát mỗi frame -> giảm rác GC)
-- =====================================================================
local SWEEP_INTERVAL = 3 -- quét va chạm mỗi 3 Heartbeat (~20 Hz) thay vì 60 Hz
local frameTick = 0
local cachedDebris: Instance? = nil
local sweepParamsCache: { [Model]: OverlapParams } = {}
local brakeStateCache: { [Model]: boolean } = {}

local function getDebrisFolderCached(): Instance?
	if cachedDebris and cachedDebris.Parent then
		return cachedDebris
	end
	cachedDebris = Workspace:FindFirstChild("LosSantos_Debris")
	return cachedDebris
end

local function getSweepParams(car: Model): OverlapParams
	local cached = sweepParamsCache[car]
	if cached then
		return cached
	end
	local params = OverlapParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local debFolder = getDebrisFolderCached()
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = if debFolder then { car, debFolder } else { car }
	sweepParamsCache[car] = params
	return params
end

local PRESET_CYCLE = {
	VehicleBuilder.PRESETS.CrimsonBanshee,
	VehicleBuilder.PRESETS.ObsidianGauntlet,
	VehicleBuilder.PRESETS.MidnightBanshee,
	VehicleBuilder.PRESETS.SunsetComet,
}
local playerCarIndex = 0

local function pickVehicleZonePart(car: Model, zone: string): BasePart?
	local bodyFolder = car:FindFirstChild("DestructibleBodywork")
	if not bodyFolder then
		return nil
	end
	local candidates: { BasePart } = {}
	for _, ch in ipairs(bodyFolder:GetChildren()) do
		if ch:IsA("BasePart") and ch:GetAttribute("Destructible") == true then
			local z = tostring(ch:GetAttribute("DamageZone") or "")
			if z == zone or (zone == "Front" and z == "Glass") then
				table.insert(candidates, ch)
			end
		end
	end
	if #candidates == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	return candidates[math.random(1, #candidates)]
end

local function updateBrakeLights(car: Model, braking: boolean)
	local cached = brakeStateCache[car]
	if cached == nil then
		local bodyFolder0 = car:FindFirstChild("DestructibleBodywork")
		local tl0 = if bodyFolder0 then bodyFolder0:FindFirstChild("LeftTaillight") else nil
		if tl0 and tl0:IsA("BasePart") then
			local r = tl0.Color.R
			brakeStateCache[car] = r < 0.75
		else
			brakeStateCache[car] = false
		end
		cached = brakeStateCache[car]
	end
	if cached == braking then
		return
	end
	brakeStateCache[car] = braking

	local bodyFolder = car:FindFirstChild("DestructibleBodywork")
	if not bodyFolder then
		return
	end
	local col = if braking then Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65) else Color3.fromRGB(175, 22, 30)
	for _, nm in ipairs({ "LeftTaillight", "RightTaillight" }) do
		local tl = bodyFolder:FindFirstChild(nm)
		if tl and tl:IsA("BasePart") then
			tl.Color = col
		end
	end
end

local function setCabinLight(car: Model, active: boolean)
	local interior = car:FindFirstChild("InteriorDetails")
	local dome = if interior then interior:FindFirstChild("CabinDomeLight") else nil
	if dome and dome:IsA("BasePart") then
		dome.Material = if active then Enum.Material.Neon else Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		local pl = dome:FindFirstChildOfClass("PointLight")
		if pl then
			pl.Brightness = if active then 1.65 else 0
		end
	end
end

-- Diễn hoạt xoay mở / đóng cánh cửa quanh bản lề trước (LeftDoorHinge / RightDoorHinge)
function VehicleManager.animateDoor(
	car: Model,
	tag: "Left" | "Right",
	angleDeg: number,
	duration: number,
	easingStyle: Enum.EasingStyle?
)
	local bodyFolder = car:FindFirstChild("DestructibleBodywork")
	local doorPart = if bodyFolder then bodyFolder:FindFirstChild(tag .. "Door") else nil
	if not doorPart then
		return -- Cánh cửa đã bị đâm / bắn văng khỏi xe!
	end

	local hinge = car:FindFirstChild(tag .. "DoorHinge")
	local weld = if hinge then hinge:FindFirstChild("DoorHingeWeld") :: Weld? else nil
	if not hinge or not weld then
		return
	end

	local cx = tonumber(hinge:GetAttribute("ClosedX")) or 0
	local cy = tonumber(hinge:GetAttribute("ClosedY")) or 0
	local cz = tonumber(hinge:GetAttribute("ClosedZ")) or 0
	local sideSign = tonumber(hinge:GetAttribute("SideSign")) or -1

	local targetC0 = CFrame.new(cx, cy, cz) * CFrame.Angles(0, sideSign * math.rad(angleDeg), 0)
	setCabinLight(car, angleDeg > 4)

	TweenService:Create(
		weld,
		TweenInfo.new(duration, easingStyle or Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{ C0 = targetC0 }
	):Play()
end

local function wireDoorAndSeat(car: Model, chassis: BasePart, tag: "Left" | "Right", seatObj: BasePart)
	local sideSign = if tag == "Left" then -1 else 1
	local bodyFolder = car:FindFirstChild("DestructibleBodywork")
	local handle = if bodyFolder then bodyFolder:FindFirstChild(tag .. "OuterDoorHandle") else nil
	local prompt = if handle then handle:FindFirstChild("EnterDoorPrompt") :: ProximityPrompt? else nil

	local animToken = 0
	local enteringViaPrompt = false
	local lastOccupant: Humanoid? = nil

	local function getOccupant(): Humanoid?
		if seatObj:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
			return seatObj.Occupant
		elseif seatObj:IsA("Seat") then
			return seatObj.Occupant
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function sitHumanoid(hum: Humanoid)
		if seatObj:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
			seatObj:Sit(hum)
		elseif seatObj:IsA("Seat") then
			seatObj:Sit(hum)
		end
	end

	-- 1) Khi bấm phím [F] cạnh tay nắm cửa -> Mở rộng cửa 64° -> Bước vào ngồi -> Kéo đóng cửa!
	if prompt then
		prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
			if getOccupant() ~= nil or enteringViaPrompt then
				return
			end
			local char = player.Character
			local hum = if char then char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
			local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
			if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or hum.SeatPart ~= nil or not hrp or not hrp:IsA("BasePart") then
				return
			end

			enteringViaPrompt = true
			animToken += 1
			local myTok = animToken
			prompt.Enabled = false

			-- Bước 1: Tung cánh cửa mở rộng 64° + bật đèn trần ca-bin
			VehicleManager.animateDoor(car, tag, 64, 0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart)

			-- Đưa nhân vật đứng ngay sát bậc cửa đang mở, quay mặt vào khoang lái
			local standPos = (chassis.CFrame * CFrame.new(sideSign * 5.05, 0.55, 0.25)).Position
			local seatWorld = seatObj.Position
			hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(standPos, Vector3.new(seatWorld.X, standPos.Y, seatWorld.Z))

			-- Bước 2: Sau 0.22s khi cửa đã hé rộng, đặt nhân vật ngồi êm vào ghế đua
			task.delay(0.22, function()
				if animToken ~= myTok or not car.Parent then
					enteringViaPrompt = false
					return
				end
				if hum.Health > 0 and getOccupant() == nil then
					sitHumanoid(hum)
				end

				-- Bước 3: Ngồi yên trong ghế xong -> kéo cánh cửa sập đóng lại!
				task.delay(0.34, function()
					enteringViaPrompt = false
					if animToken == myTok and car.Parent then
						VehicleManager.animateDoor(car, tag, 0, 0.30, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
					end
				end)
			end)
		end)
	end

	-- Hạ nhẹ tư thế ngồi SeatWeld xuống đệm ghế đua âm sàn (-0.34 stud) để tóc cao R15 tuyệt đối không lòi qua mui xe!
	seatObj.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
		if ch.Name == "SeatWeld" and ch:IsA("Weld") then
			ch.C0 = CFrame.new(0, -0.34, 0.10) * ch.C0
		end
	end)

	-- 2) Theo dõi khi ngồi trực tiếp (chạm ghế) HOẶC khi nhảy ra khỏi xe (Space) -> Tự động mở & đóng cửa!
	seatObj:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Occupant"):Connect(function()
		pcall(function()
			chassis:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
		end)

		local occ = getOccupant()
		if occ ~= nil then
			lastOccupant = occ
			if prompt then
				prompt.Enabled = false
			end
			if not enteringViaPrompt then
				animToken += 1
				local myTok = animToken
				VehicleManager.animateDoor(car, tag, 56, 0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
				task.delay(0.26, function()
					if animToken == myTok and car.Parent then
						VehicleManager.animateDoor(car, tag, 0, 0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
					end
				end)
			end
		else
			-- Người chơi vừa bước xuống xe -> Mở bung cửa 62°, đặt nhân vật ra cạnh cửa thoáng đãng rồi khép cửa lại!
			if prompt and prompt.Parent then
				prompt.Enabled = true
			end
			animToken += 1
			local myTok = animToken
			VehicleManager.animateDoor(car, tag, 62, 0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart)

			local prevHum = lastOccupant
			lastOccupant = nil
			if prevHum and prevHum.Parent then
				local prevChar = prevHum.Parent
				local prevHrp = prevChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if prevHrp and prevHrp:IsA("BasePart") then
					task.defer(function()
						if prevHrp.Parent and chassis.Parent then
							local exitCF = chassis.CFrame * CFrame.new(sideSign * 5.75, 0.65, 0.30)
							prevHrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
								exitCF.Position,
								exitCF.Position + chassis.CFrame.LookVector
							)
						end
					end)
				end
			end

			task.delay(0.55, function()
				if animToken == myTok and car.Parent then
					VehicleManager.animateDoor(car, tag, 0, 0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
end

function VehicleManager.registerCar(car: Model)
	if trackedCars[car] then
		return
	end
	trackedCars[car] = true

	local chassis = car:FindFirstChild("Chassis") :: BasePart?
	local driverSeat = car:FindFirstChild("DriverSeat") :: VehicleSeat?
	local passSeat = car:FindFirstChild("PassengerSeat") :: Seat?
	if chassis then
		pcall(function()
			chassis:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
		end)
		if driverSeat then
			wireDoorAndSeat(car, chassis, "Left", driverSeat)
		end
		if passSeat then
			wireDoorAndSeat(car, chassis, "Right", passSeat)
		end
	end
end

function VehicleManager.spawnForPlayer(player: Player): Model?
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
	if not hrp or not hrp:IsA("BasePart") then
		return nil
	end

	local root = Workspace:FindFirstChild("LosSantos")
	local fleet = if root then root:FindFirstChild("Phase2_Vehicles") else nil
	local targetParent: Instance = fleet or Workspace

	-- Xoá xe cá nhân cũ của người chơi nếu còn để tránh rác map
	local oldTag = "PersonalCar_" .. tostring(player.UserId)
	for carModel in pairs(trackedCars) do
		if carModel.Parent and carModel:GetAttribute("OwnerTag") == oldTag then
			carModel:Destroy()
			trackedCars[carModel] = nil
		end
	end

	playerCarIndex = (playerCarIndex % #PRESET_CYCLE) + 1
	local preset = PRESET_CYCLE[playerCarIndex]

	local flatLook = Vector3.new(hrp.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, hrp.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
	if flatLook.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		flatLook = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	else
		flatLook = flatLook.Unit
	end

	local spawnPos = hrp.Position + flatLook * 13 + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
	local spawnCF = CFrame.lookAt(spawnPos, spawnPos + flatLook)
	local car = VehicleBuilder.spawn(targetParent, spawnCF, preset)
	car:SetAttribute("OwnerTag", oldTag)
	VehicleManager.registerCar(car)
	return car
end

function VehicleManager.init()
	local root = Workspace:FindFirstChild("LosSantos")
	if root then
		local fleet = root:FindFirstChild("Phase2_Vehicles")
		if not fleet then
			fleet = VehicleBuilder.spawnDefaultFleet(root)
		end
		for _, child in ipairs(fleet:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Model") and child:GetAttribute("IsGtaVehicle") == true then
				VehicleManager.registerCar(child)
			end
		end
	end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(_dt)
		local now = os.clock()
		frameTick += 1
		local doSweep = (frameTick % SWEEP_INTERVAL) == 0

		-- Dọn bảng cooldown cũ định kỳ
		for p, expTime in pairs(partHitCooldown) do
			if not p.Parent or now > expTime then
				partHitCooldown[p] = nil
			end
		end

		for car in pairs(trackedCars) do
			if not car.Parent or car:GetAttribute("_Exploded") == true then
				trackedCars[car] = nil
				sweepParamsCache[car] = nil
				brakeStateCache[car] = nil
				continue
			end

			local chassis = car:FindFirstChild("Chassis") :: BasePart?
			local seat = car:FindFirstChild("DriverSeat") :: VehicleSeat?
			local vf = if chassis then chassis:FindFirstChild("DriveVectorForce") :: VectorForce? else nil
			local av = if chassis then chassis:FindFirstChild("SteerAngularVelocity") :: AngularVelocity? else nil

			if not chassis or not seat or not vf or not av then
				continue
			end

			local vel = chassis.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local speed = vel.Magnitude
			car:SetAttribute("CurrentMPH", math.floor(speed * 1.15))

			local cf = chassis.CFrame
			local flatFwd = Vector3.new(cf.LookVector.X, 0, cf.LookVector.Z)
			if flatFwd.Magnitude < 0.01 then
				flatFwd = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
			else
				flatFwd = flatFwd.Unit
			end
			local flatRight = Vector3.new(cf.RightVector.X, 0, cf.RightVector.Z)
			if flatRight.Magnitude < 0.01 then
				flatRight = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
			else
				flatRight = flatRight.Unit
			end

			local fwdSpeed = vel:Dot(flatFwd)
			local latSpeed = vel:Dot(flatRight)
			local mass = chassis.AssemblyMass
			local maxSpeed = tonumber(car:GetAttribute("MaxSpeed")) or 92

			if seat.Occupant then
				local throttle = seat.ThrottleFloat
				local steer = seat.SteerFloat

				-- Lực kéo động cơ + Phanh + Lực bám ngang chống trượt bánh lố
				local driveF = Vector3.zero
				if math.abs(throttle) > 0.04 then
					local targetSpd = if throttle > 0 then (throttle * maxSpeed) else (throttle * maxSpeed * 0.45)
					local gain = if (throttle * fwdSpeed < -2) then 7.2 else 4.4 -- Phanh gấp ăn hơn!
					driveF = flatFwd * ((targetSpd - fwdSpeed) * mass * gain)
				else
					driveF = -flatFwd * (fwdSpeed * mass * 0.95)
				end

				local gripF = -flatRight * (latSpeed * mass * 8.2)
				vf.Force = driveF + gripF

				-- Đánh lái mượt tỉ lệ theo tốc độ lăn bánh
				local moveRatio = math.clamp(math.abs(fwdSpeed) / 9.0, 0, 1)
				local revSign = if fwdSpeed < -1.5 then -1 else 1
				av.MaxTorque = mass * 520
				av.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, -steer * 2.45 * moveRatio * revSign, 0)

				updateBrakeLights(car, throttle < -0.1)
			else
				-- Khi không có người lái: hãm trôi tự nhiên để xe đậu đằm trên dốc/lề đường
				vf.Force = -Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z) * (mass * 2.4)
				av.MaxTorque = 0
				updateBrakeLights(car, false)
			end

			-- QUÉT VA CHẠM TỐC ĐỘ CAO: Xe đụng khối có máu ẩn -> Trừ PartHealth -> Hết máu tự vỡ!
			if speed >= 13.5 and doSweep then
				local goingForward = fwdSpeed >= -1.0
				local zoneOffsetZ = if goingForward then -8.15 else 8.15
				local zoneName = if goingForward then "Front" else "Rear"
				local sweepCF = cf * CFrame.new(0, 0.55, zoneOffsetZ)

				-- OverlapParams được TÁI SỬ DỤNG (không cấp phát mới mỗi frame)
				local params = getSweepParams(car)

				local hits = Workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(sweepCF, Vector3.new(7.5, 2.5, 2.4), params)
				local hitSolidObstacle = false

				for _, hp in ipairs(hits) do
					if hp:IsA("BasePart") then
						if hp:GetAttribute("Destructible") == true then
							if not partHitCooldown[hp] then
								partHitCooldown[hp] = now + 0.16
								hitSolidObstacle = true
								local impactDmg = speed * 2.35
								local pushVec = vel * 1.15 + Vector3.new(0, 14, 0)
								DestructionManager.damagePart(hp, impactDmg, hp.Position, pushVec)
							end
						elseif hp.CanCollide and (hp.Position.Y + hp.Size.Y * 0.5) > (cf.Position.Y - 0.35) then
							-- Va vào vách núi / tường cứng cao hơn bậc vỉa hè
							hitSolidObstacle = true
						end
					end
				end

				-- Phản lực làm móp / vỡ đèn pha / cản xe / nắp capo của chính chiếc xe đang tông!
				if hitSolidObstacle and (now > (carSelfHitCooldown[car] or 0)) then
					carSelfHitCooldown[car] = now + 0.22
					local selfPanel = pickVehicleZonePart(car, zoneName)
					if selfPanel then
						DestructionManager.damagePart(
							selfPanel,
							speed * 0.58,
							selfPanel.Position,
							-flatFwd * (speed * 0.35) + Vector3.new(0, 12, 0)
						)
					else
						DestructionManager.damageVehicleEngine(car, speed * 0.65, vel)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return VehicleManager

type AmmoEntry = { mag: number, reserve: number }
type PlayerState = {
	ammo: { [string]: AmmoEntry },
	lastShotAt: number,
	lastReloadAt: number,
}

local stateByPlayer: { [Player]: PlayerState } = {}

local function freshAmmo(): { [string]: AmmoEntry }
	local ammo: { [string]: AmmoEntry } = {}
	for name, spec in pairs(SPECS) do
		if spec.mag > 0 then
			ammo[name] = { mag = spec.mag, reserve = spec.reserve }
		end
	end
	return ammo
end

local function getState(player: Player): PlayerState
	local st = stateByPlayer[player]
	if st then
		return st
	end
	local created: PlayerState = { ammo = freshAmmo(), lastShotAt = 0, lastReloadAt = 0 }
	stateByPlayer[player] = created
	return created
end

--=====================================================================
-- DỰNG TOOL 3D
--=====================================================================
local function weldTo(handle: BasePart, child: BasePart)
	child.CanCollide = false
	child.Massless = true
	child.Anchored = false
	local wc = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	wc.Part0 = handle
	wc.Part1 = child
	wc.Parent = child
end

local function buildWeaponTool(toolName: string, spec: Spec): Tool
	local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
	tool.Name = toolName
	tool.RequiresHandle = true
	tool.CanBeDropped = false
	tool.ToolTip = spec.display
	tool:SetAttribute("IsGtaWeapon", true)
	tool:SetAttribute("IsMelee", spec.melee)
	tool:SetAttribute("WeaponSlot", spec.slot)
	tool:SetAttribute("WeaponDisplay", spec.display)
	tool:SetAttribute("AutoFire", spec.auto)
	tool:SetAttribute("FireCooldown", spec.cooldown)
	tool:SetAttribute("Pellets", spec.pellets)
	tool:SetAttribute("IsExplosive", spec.explosive == true)

	local model = GUN_MODELS[toolName]
	if not model then
		return tool
	end

	local handle = Instance.new("Part")
	handle.Name = "Handle"
	handle.Size = model.handle.size
	handle.Color = model.handle.color
	handle.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
	handle.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	handle.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	handle.CanCollide = false
	handle.Massless = true
	handle.Parent = tool

	for _, pSpec in ipairs(model.parts) do
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = pSpec.name
		p.Size = pSpec.size
		p.Color = pSpec.color
		p.Material = if pSpec.name == "ScopeLens" then Enum.Material.Glass else Enum.Material.Metal
		p.CFrame = handle.CFrame * CFrame.new(pSpec.off)
		p.Parent = tool
		weldTo(handle, p)
	end

	return tool
end

local function giveLoadout(player: Player)
	local backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack", 5)
	if not backpack then
		return
	end
	for _, name in ipairs(WEAPON_ORDER) do
		local spec = SPECS[name]
		if spec and name ~= "Unarmed" and not backpack:FindFirstChild(name) then
			local t = buildWeaponTool(name, spec)
			t.Parent = backpack
		end
	end
end

--=====================================================================
-- ĐỒNG BỘ ĐẠN VỀ CLIENT
--=====================================================================
local function makeWeaponList(st: PlayerState)
	local list = {}
	for _, name in ipairs(WEAPON_ORDER) do
		local spec = SPECS[name]
		if spec then
			local ammo = st.ammo[name]
			table.insert(list, {
				name = name,
				display = spec.display,
				icon = spec.icon,
				slot = spec.slot,
				category = spec.category,
				auto = spec.auto,
				melee = spec.melee,
				mag = if ammo then ammo.mag else 0,
				magSize = spec.mag,
				reserve = if ammo then ammo.reserve else 0,
				accent = spec.accent,
			})
		end
	end
	return list
end

function WeaponManager.init(remotesFolder: Instance)
	local fireRemote = remotesFolder:FindFirstChild("WeaponFire") :: RemoteEvent?
	if not fireRemote then
		local created = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		created.Name = "WeaponFire"
		created.Parent = remotesFolder
		fireRemote = created
	end
	local activeFireRemote = fireRemote :: RemoteEvent

	local reloadRemote = remotesFolder:FindFirstChild("WeaponReload") :: RemoteEvent?
	if not reloadRemote then
		local created = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		created.Name = "WeaponReload"
		created.Parent = remotesFolder
		reloadRemote = created
	end
	local activeReloadRemote = reloadRemote :: RemoteEvent

	local syncRemote = remotesFolder:FindFirstChild("WeaponSync") :: RemoteEvent?
	if not syncRemote then
		local created = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		created.Name = "WeaponSync"
		created.Parent = remotesFolder
		syncRemote = created
	end
	local activeSyncRemote = syncRemote :: RemoteEvent

	local function pushState(player: Player)
		local st = getState(player)
		local equipped = ""
		local char = player.Character
		if char then
			local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
			if tool and tool:GetAttribute("IsGtaWeapon") == true then
				equipped = tool.Name
			end
		end
		activeSyncRemote:FireClient(player, {
			type = "state",
			weapons = makeWeaponList(st),
			equipped = equipped,
		})
	end

	local function pushAmmo(player: Player, name: string, empty: boolean?)
		local st = getState(player)
		local ammo = st.ammo[name]
		if not ammo then
			return
		end
		activeSyncRemote:FireClient(player, {
			type = "ammo",
			name = name,
			mag = ammo.mag,
			reserve = ammo.reserve,
			magSize = SPECS[name].mag,
			empty = empty == true,
		})
	end

	local function hookPlayer(player: Player)
		local function onChar()
			task.wait(0.15)
			-- Hồi đầy đạn khi hồi sinh
			local st = getState(player)
			st.lastShotAt = 0
			st.lastReloadAt = 0
			for name, spec in pairs(SPECS) do
				if spec.mag > 0 then
					st.ammo[name] = { mag = spec.mag, reserve = spec.reserve }
				end
			end
			giveLoadout(player)
			pushState(player)
		end
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onChar)
		if player.Character then
			task.spawn(onChar)
		end
	end

	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		hookPlayer(p)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hookPlayer)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
		stateByPlayer[p] = nil
	end)

	--=================================================================
	-- NẠP ĐẠN
	--=================================================================
	activeReloadRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
		local char = player.Character
		if not char then
			return
		end
		local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
		if not tool or tool:GetAttribute("IsGtaWeapon") ~= true then
			return
		end
		local spec = SPECS[tool.Name]
		if not spec or spec.mag <= 0 then
			return
		end
		local st = getState(player)
		local ammo = st.ammo[tool.Name]
		if not ammo then
			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - st.lastReloadAt < spec.reloadTime then
			return
		end
		if ammo.mag >= spec.mag or ammo.reserve <= 0 then
			return
		end
		st.lastReloadAt = now

		task.delay(spec.reloadTime, function()
			local cur = st.ammo[tool.Name]
			if not cur then
				return
			end
			local need = spec.mag - cur.mag
			local take = math.min(need, cur.reserve)
			cur.mag += take
			cur.reserve -= take
			pushAmmo(player, tool.Name, false)
		end)
	end)

	--=================================================================
	-- BẮN / CHÉM
	--=================================================================
	-- ==========================================================================
	-- RPG: phóng rocket + nổ sát thương diện rộng
	-- ==========================================================================
	local function explodeAt(center: Vector3, spec: any, player: Player)
		local radius: number = spec.blastRadius or 22
		local dmg: number = spec.blastDamage or 260

		-- 1. Phá huỷ kết cấu trong bán kính
		local broken = 0
		local okDmg, res = pcall(function()
			return DestructionManager.damageRadius(center, radius, dmg, spec.impulse or 120, player.Character)
		end)
		if okDmg and type(res) == "number" then
			broken = res
		end

		-- 2. Sát thương nhân vật (người chơi + NPC)
		local params = OverlapParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { player.Character }
		local parts = Workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(center, radius, params)
		local hitModels: { [Model]: boolean } = {}
		local victimCount = 0
		for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
			local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			if model and not hitModels[model] then
				hitModels[model] = true
				local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
					local d = (part.Position - center).Magnitude
					if d <= radius then
						local falloff = 1 - (d / radius) * 0.6
						hum:TakeDamage(dmg * 0.35 * falloff)
						victimCount += 1
					end
				end
			end
		end

		-- 3. Hiệu ứng nổ: cầu lửa + vòng xung kích + mảnh văng
		local debris = Workspace:FindFirstChild("LosSantos_Debris")
		local host = debris or Workspace
		local boom = Instance.new("Part")
		boom.Name = "RPG_Fireball"
		boom.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		boom.Size = Vector3.new(radius * 0.9, radius * 0.9, radius * 0.9)
		boom.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 176, 72)
		boom.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		boom.CanCollide = false
		boom.CanTouch = false
		boom.CanQuery = false
		boom.Transparency = 0.15
		boom.CFrame = CFrame.new(center)
		boom.Parent = host

		local ring = Instance.new("Part")
		ring.Name = "RPG_Shockwave"
		ring.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		ring.Size = Vector3.new(1.2, 6, 6)
		ring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 236, 190)
		ring.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		ring.CanCollide = false
		ring.CanTouch = false
		ring.CanQuery = false
		ring.Transparency = 0.35
		ring.CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, 1.0, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
		ring.Parent = host

		-- giãn nở rồi tan
		task.spawn(function()
			local steps = 18
			for i = 1, steps do
				local a = i / steps
				if boom.Parent then
					boom.Size = Vector3.new(radius * (0.9 + a * 0.5), radius * (0.9 + a * 0.5), radius * (0.9 + a * 0.5))
					boom.Transparency = 0.15 + a * 0.8
				end
				if ring.Parent then
					ring.Size = Vector3.new(1.2, 6 + a * radius * 2.4, 6 + a * radius * 2.4)
					ring.Transparency = 0.35 + a * 0.6
				end
				task.wait(0.028)
			end
			if boom.Parent then
				boom:Destroy()
			end
			if ring.Parent then
				ring:Destroy()
			end
		end)

		-- mảnh văng
		for i = 1, 10 do
			local chunk = Instance.new("Part")
			chunk.Name = "RPG_Shard"
			chunk.Size = Vector3.new(math.random(4, 10) / 10, math.random(4, 10) / 10, math.random(4, 10) / 10)
			chunk.Color = Color3.fromRGB(52, 50, 46)
			chunk.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
			chunk.CanCollide = false
			chunk.CanTouch = false
			chunk.CanQuery = false
			chunk.CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
			chunk.Parent = host
			local dir = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() * 0.9 + 0.2, math.random() - 0.5).Unit
			chunk.AssemblyLinearVelocity = dir * math.random(40, 90)
			Debris:AddItem(chunk, 1.6)
		end

		-- 4. NPC hoảng loạn dây chuyền
		if NPCManager and type(NPCManager.notifyExplosion) == "function" then
			pcall(function()
				NPCManager.notifyExplosion(center, radius, player)
			end)
		end

		print(string.format("[RPG] 💥 Nổ tại (%.0f, %.0f, %.0f) — phá %d khối, %d nạn nhân", center.X, center.Y, center.Z, broken, victimCount))
	end

	local function launchRocket(player: Player, origin: Vector3, dirVec: Vector3, spec: any, tool: Tool)
		local debris = Workspace:FindFirstChild("LosSantos_Debris")
		local host = debris or Workspace

		local rocket = Instance.new("Part")
		rocket.Name = "RPG_Rocket"
		rocket.Size = Vector3.new(0.42, 0.42, 1.75)

		rocket.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
		rocket.CanCollide = false

		rocket.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(origin, origin + dirVec)
		rocket.Parent = host

		local flame = Instance.new("Part")
		flame.Name = "RPG_Trail"
		flame.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		flame.Size = Vector3.new(1.15, 1.15, 1.15)

		-- tiếng "phóng" trước khi bay

		task.spawn(function()
			local pos = origin
			local maxTime = 6.0
			local t = 0
			while t < maxTime do
				local dt = 1 / 60
				t += dt
				if not rocket.Parent then
					break
				end
				local step = dirVec * speed * dt
				local hit = Workspace:Raycast(pos, step, params)
				if hit then
					local center = hit.Position
					if hit.Instance and hit.Instance:IsA("BasePart") then
						center = hit.Position + hit.Normal * 0.35
					end
					rocket:Destroy()
					flame:Destroy()
					explodeAt(center, spec, player)
					return
				end
				pos += step
				rocket.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + dirVec)
				flame.CFrame = rocket.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 1.0)
				task.wait(dt)
			end
			if rocket.Parent then
				rocket:Destroy()
			end
			if flame.Parent then
				flame:Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end

	activeFireRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, originPos, aimPos)
		if typeof(originPos) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(aimPos) ~= "Vector3" then
			return
		end

		local char = player.Character
		if not char then
			return
		end
		local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
		if not tool or tool:GetAttribute("IsGtaWeapon") ~= true then
			return
		end
		local spec = SPECS[tool.Name]
		if not spec then
			return
		end

		local st = getState(player)
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - st.lastShotAt < spec.cooldown * 0.75 then
			return
		end

		-- Kiểm tra đạn
		local ammo = st.ammo[tool.Name]
		if ammo then
			if ammo.mag <= 0 then
				pushAmmo(player, tool.Name, true)
				return
			end
		end

		local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
		if not hrp or (originPos - hrp.Position).Magnitude > 26 then
			return
		end

		local dirVec = aimPos - originPos
		if dirVec.Magnitude < 0.05 then
			return
		end

		st.lastShotAt = now

		-- ── VŨ KHÍ NỔ (RPG): phóng rocket, không raycast tức thời ──────────
		if spec.explosive then
			local hrpNow = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local muzzle = if hrpNow then hrpNow.Position + dirVec.Unit * 2.6 + Vector3.new(0, 0.2, 0) else originPos
			if ammo then
				ammo.mag = math.max(0, ammo.mag - 1)
				pushAmmo(player, tool.Name, ammo.mag <= 0)
			end
			launchRocket(player, muzzle, dirVec.Unit, spec, tool)
			return
		end

		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		local deb = Workspace:FindFirstChild("LosSantos_Debris")
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = if deb then { char, deb } else { char }

		local hitSomething = false
		local shatteredAny = false
		local pellets = math.max(1, spec.pellets)

		for i = 1, pellets do
			local shotDir = dirVec.Unit
			if pellets > 1 or spec.spread > 0 then
				local spreadRad = math.rad(spec.spread)
				shotDir = (dirVec.Unit + Vector3.new(
					(math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * spreadRad,
					(math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * spreadRad,
					(math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * spreadRad
				)).Unit
			end

			local result = Workspace:Raycast(originPos, shotDir * spec.range, params)
			if result and result.Instance and result.Instance:IsA("BasePart") then
				local hitPart = result.Instance
				local hitModel = hitPart:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
				local hitHum = if hitModel then hitModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil

				if hitHum and hitModel ~= char then
					hitHum:TakeDamage(spec.damage * 0.7)
					-- NPC phản ứng: bắn trả / bỏ chạy / quay video gọi cảnh sát / đánh tay
					if NPCManager and hitModel:GetAttribute("IsGTA_NPC") == true then
						local kind = if spec.melee then "MELEE" else "BULLET"
						pcall(function()
							NPCManager.notifyAttacked(hitModel, player, kind)
						end)
					end
					hitSomething = true
				else
					local shattered = DestructionManager.damagePart(
						hitPart,
						spec.damage,
						result.Position,
						shotDir * spec.impulse + Vector3.new(0, 8, 0)
					)
					if shattered then
						shatteredAny = true
					end
					if hitPart:GetAttribute("Destructible") == true or shattered or (hitModel and hitModel:GetAttribute("IsGtaVehicle") == true) then
						hitSomething = true
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if ammo then
			ammo.mag = math.max(0, ammo.mag - 1)
			pushAmmo(player, tool.Name, ammo.mag <= 0)
		end

		if hitSomething then
			activeFireRemote:FireClient(player, "hit", shatteredAny)
		end
	end)
end

WeaponManager.SPECS = SPECS
WeaponManager.WEAPON_ORDER = WEAPON_ORDER

return WeaponManager

--!strict

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local CityFoundation = require(Shared:WaitForChild("World"):WaitForChild("CityFoundation"))
local DistrictRegistry = require(Shared:WaitForChild("World"):WaitForChild("DistrictRegistry"))
local PerfOptimizer = require(Shared:WaitForChild("World"):WaitForChild("PerfOptimizer"))
local VehicleManager = require(script:WaitForChild("VehicleManager"))
local WeaponManager = require(script:WaitForChild("WeaponManager"))
local NPCManager = require(script:WaitForChild("NPCManager"))
local LSCustomsService = require(script:WaitForChild("LSCustomsService"))

-- Tạo thư mục RemoteEvents phục vụ HUD, Xe & Vũ khí GTA V
local remotesFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GtaRemotes")
if not remotesFolder then
	local createdFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	createdFolder.Name = "GtaRemotes"
	createdFolder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	remotesFolder = createdFolder
end
local activeRemotes = remotesFolder :: Instance

local hudRemote = activeRemotes:FindFirstChild("HudAction") :: RemoteEvent?
if not hudRemote then
	local created = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	created.Name = "HudAction"
	created.Parent = activeRemotes
	hudRemote = created
end
local activeHudRemote = hudRemote :: RemoteEvent

if not activeRemotes:FindFirstChild("WeaponFire") then
	local wf = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	wf.Name = "WeaponFire"
	wf.Parent = activeRemotes
end

-- 1. Dựng Nền Thành Phố ghép khối có máu ẩn + Tự động nạp mọi Công Trình Đa-Agent trong World/Modules
local losSantosRoot = CityFoundation.build(false)
DistrictRegistry.buildAll(losSantosRoot)

-- 1.1. TỐI ƯU HIỆU NĂNG: cắt CanCollide/CanTouch/CanQuery/CastShadow cho part trang trí,
-- giảm ~9.000 attribute trùng lặp, giới hạn SurfaceGui. Chạy 1 lần duy nhất sau khi dựng xong.
PerfOptimizer.optimize(losSantosRoot)

-- 2. Khởi chạy Đội Xe Hơi GTA V (vật lý lái + đụng xe trừ máu ẩn PartHealth) & Vũ Khí bắn vỡ khối
VehicleManager.init()
WeaponManager.init(activeRemotes)
NPCManager.init(activeHudRemote)

-- 3. Kích hoạt dịch vụ ĐỘ XE THẬT của Los Santos Customs (Plot_C1): 2 khoang + sửa/sơn/turbo
LSCustomsService.init(activeRemotes, activeHudRemote, losSantosRoot)

local STARTING_CASH = 5000

local function setupPlayer(player: Player)
	player:SetAttribute("Cash", STARTING_CASH)
	player:SetAttribute("Armor", 65)
	player:SetAttribute("WantedLevel", 0)

	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local cashStat = Instance.new("IntValue")
	cashStat.Name = "Cash"
	cashStat.Value = STARTING_CASH
	cashStat.Parent = leaderstats
end

for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(setupPlayer, p)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)

-- Xử lý lệnh từ Menu Kiểm Thử [H]
activeHudRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, cmd)
	if cmd == "spawn_car" then
		local car = VehicleManager.spawnForPlayer(player)
		if car then
			activeHudRemote:FireClient(player, {
				message = string.format("Legendary Motorsport: Đã giao siêu xe %s ngay trước mặt bạn!", car.Name),
				color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248),
			})
		end
	elseif cmd == "add_star" then
		local cur = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("WantedLevel")) or 0
		local nxt = math.min(5, cur + 1)
		player:SetAttribute("WantedLevel", nxt)
		activeHudRemote:FireClient(player, {
			message = string.format("LSPD ALERT: Mức truy nã hiện tại là %d Sao!", nxt),
			color = Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68),
		})
	elseif cmd == "clear_stars" then
		player:SetAttribute("WantedLevel", 0)
		activeHudRemote:FireClient(player, {
			message = "LSPD đã ngừng truy đuổi. Bạn đã thoát truy nã!",
			color = Color3.fromRGB(86, 186, 86),
		})
	elseif cmd == "add_cash" then
		local nextCash = (tonumber(player:GetAttribute("Cash")) or 0) + 500
		player:SetAttribute("Cash", nextCash)
		local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		local cs = if ls then ls:FindFirstChild("Cash") else nil
		if cs and cs:IsA("IntValue") then
			cs.Value = nextCash
		end
		activeHudRemote:FireClient(player, {
			message = "Maze Bank: Đã nhận +$500 vào tài khoản tiền mặt.",
			color = Color3.fromRGB(114, 204, 114),
		})
	elseif cmd == "add_armor" then
		local curA = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("Armor")) or 0
		local nxtA = if curA >= 100 then 0 else math.min(100, curA + 50)
		player:SetAttribute("Armor", nxtA)
		activeHudRemote:FireClient(player, {
			message = string.format("Ammu-Nation: Áo giáp chống đạn hiện tại %d%%.", nxtA),
			color = Color3.fromRGB(59, 155, 232),
		})
	elseif cmd == "test_hp" then
		local char = player.Character
		local hum = if char then char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		if hum then
			if hum.Health <= 30 then
				hum.Health = hum.MaxHealth
				activeHudRemote:FireClient(player, {
					message = "Los Santos Medical: Đã hồi phục 100% máu!",
					color = Color3.fromRGB(86, 186, 86),
				})
			else
				hum.Health = math.max(20, hum.Health - 30)
				activeHudRemote:FireClient(player, {
					message = "Cảnh báo sát thương! Nhấn lần nữa khi <30% để hồi đầy máu.",
					color = Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68),
				})
			end
		end
	end
end)

NPCAnimator.source:
--!nonstrict
--[[
	NPCAnimator.luau  —  LỚP ANIMATION DỰ PHÒNG CHẠY Ở CLIENT
	================================================================================
	Kiến trúc 2 lớp (từ Sync v21):

	  LỚP 1 — ANIMATION THẬT CỦA ROBLOX  (ưu tiên)
	    Server gọi `Animator:LoadAnimation` với animation gốc của Roblox
	    (idle / walk / run) và tự Play/Stop theo tốc độ đi. Không cần file này.
	    Khi đó NPC có thuộc tính `UsesRealAnims = true`.

	  LỚP 2 — VẼ BẰNG MOTOR6D  (dự phòng, chính là file này)
	    Nếu Roblox không nạp được animation (mất mạng / asset bị chặn / rig tự ghép),
	    `UsesRealAnims = false` và client tự xoay khớp ở 24 Hz.
	    → NPC **luôn** có dáng đi, không bao giờ "trượt băng" như tượng.

	Hỗ trợ CẢ HAI loại rig:
	  • R15 (model Roblox thật): Waist / Neck / *Shoulder / *Elbow / *Hip / *Knee
	  • R6  (rig tự ghép dự phòng): RootJoint / Neck / "Right Shoulder" / "Right Hip"

	Ghi vào `Motor6D.Transform` (thuộc tính CỤC BỘ, không replicate) nên không tốn
	băng thông và không giành `C0` với server.

	Tư thế: IDLE · WALK · RUN · SHOOT · PUNCH · PHONE · DRIVE · DEAD
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local NPCAnimator = {}

local UPDATE_HZ = 24
local CULL_DISTANCE = 300

type Joints = {
	rigType: string,
	root: Motor6D?,
	waist: Motor6D?,
	neck: Motor6D?,
	shoulderR: Motor6D?,
	shoulderL: Motor6D?,
	elbowR: Motor6D?,
	elbowL: Motor6D?,
	hipR: Motor6D?,
	hipL: Motor6D?,
	kneeR: Motor6D?,
	kneeL: Motor6D?,
}

type Rig = {
	model: Model,
	j: Joints,
	phase: number,
	lastState: string,
}

local rigs: { [Model]: Rig } = {}

local function motor(model: Model, ...: string): Motor6D?
	for i = 1, select("#", ...) do
		local name = select(i, ...)
		local inst = model:FindFirstChild(name, true)
		if inst and inst:IsA("Motor6D") then
			return inst
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function collectJoints(model: Model): Joints?
	local r15ShoulderR = motor(model, "RightShoulder")
	local r15HipR = motor(model, "RightHip")

	if r15ShoulderR and r15HipR then
		return {
			rigType = "R15",
			root = motor(model, "Root"),
			waist = motor(model, "Waist"),
			neck = motor(model, "Neck"),
			shoulderR = r15ShoulderR,
			shoulderL = motor(model, "LeftShoulder"),
			elbowR = motor(model, "RightElbow"),
			elbowL = motor(model, "LeftElbow"),
			hipR = r15HipR,
			hipL = motor(model, "LeftHip"),
			kneeR = motor(model, "RightKnee"),
			kneeL = motor(model, "LeftKnee"),
		}
	end

	local r6ShoulderR = motor(model, "Right Shoulder")
	local r6HipR = motor(model, "Right Hip")
	if r6ShoulderR and r6HipR then
		return {
			rigType = "R6",
			root = motor(model, "RootJoint"),
			waist = nil,
			neck = motor(model, "Neck"),
			shoulderR = r6ShoulderR,
			shoulderL = motor(model, "Left Shoulder"),
			elbowR = nil,
			elbowL = nil,
			hipR = r6HipR,
			hipL = motor(model, "Left Hip"),
			kneeR = nil,
			kneeL = nil,
		}
	end

	return nil
end

local function register(model: Instance)
	if not model:IsA("Model") then
		return
	end
	if rigs[model] then
		return
	end
	if model:GetAttribute("IsGTA_NPC") ~= true then
		return
	end

	local joints = collectJoints(model)
	if not joints then
		return
	end

	rigs[model] = {
		model = model,
		j = joints,
		phase = math.random() * math.pi * 2,
		lastState = "IDLE",
	}
end

local function unregister(model: Instance)
	rigs[model] = nil
end

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Áp tư thế
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

local function applyPose(rig: Rig, state: string, dt: number, clock: number)
	local j = rig.j

	-- Giá trị mặc định = đứng yên
	local rootOff = Vector3.zero
	local waistRot = Vector3.zero
	local neckRot = Vector3.zero
	local sR = Vector3.zero
	local sL = Vector3.zero
	local eR = Vector3.zero
	local eL = Vector3.zero
	local hR = 0
	local hL = 0
	local kR = 0
	local kL = 0

	if state == "WALK" then
		rig.phase += dt * 7.5
		local s = math.sin(rig.phase)
		local amp = 0.55
		hR = s * amp
		hL = -s * amp
		sR = Vector3.new(-s * amp * 0.85, 0, 0)
		sL = Vector3.new(s * amp * 0.85, 0, 0)
		kR = math.max(0, -s) * 0.75
		kL = math.max(0, s) * 0.75
		rootOff = Vector3.new(0, math.abs(math.cos(rig.phase)) * 0.09, 0)
		neckRot = Vector3.new(0, math.sin(rig.phase * 0.5) * 0.16, 0)
	elseif state == "RUN" then
		rig.phase += dt * 11.5
		local s = math.sin(rig.phase)
		local amp = 0.95
		hR = s * amp
		hL = -s * amp
		sR = Vector3.new(-s * amp * 0.95, 0, 0)
		sL = Vector3.new(s * amp * 0.95, 0, 0)
		kR = math.max(0, -s) * 1.15
		kL = math.max(0, s) * 1.15
		rootOff = Vector3.new(0, math.abs(math.cos(rig.phase)) * 0.16, 0)
		waistRot = Vector3.new(0.14, 0, 0)
		neckRot = Vector3.new(-0.1, 0, 0)
	elseif state == "SHOOT" then
		local recoil = math.abs(math.sin(clock * 6)) * 0.08
		sR = Vector3.new(-1.45 - recoil, -0.18, 0)
		sL = Vector3.new(-1.25, 0.55, 0)
		eR = Vector3.new(0, 0, -0.5)
		neckRot = Vector3.new(-0.06, 0, 0)
	elseif state == "PUNCH" then
		local punch = (math.sin(clock * 9) + 1) * 0.5
		sR = Vector3.new(-0.55 - punch * 1.35, -0.1 * punch, 0)
		sL = Vector3.new(-0.35, 0.3, 0)
		waistRot = Vector3.new(0.06, -0.12 + punch * 0.24, 0)
	elseif state == "PHONE" then
		sR = Vector3.new(-2.05, 0, 0.55)
		sL = Vector3.new(-0.15, 0, 0)
		neckRot = Vector3.new(-0.08, -0.22, 0)
		rootOff = Vector3.new(0, math.sin(clock * 1.6) * 0.02, 0)
	elseif state == "DRIVE" then
		hR = -1.35
		hL = -1.35
		kR = 1.3
		kL = 1.3
		sR = Vector3.new(-1.15, -0.12, 0)
		sL = Vector3.new(-1.15, 0.12, 0)
		eR = Vector3.new(0, 0, -0.35)
		eL = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0.35)
		rootOff = Vector3.new(0, math.sin(clock * 5.5) * 0.02, 0)
		neckRot = Vector3.new(0, math.sin(clock * 0.6) * 0.12, 0)
	elseif state == "DEAD" then
		sR = Vector3.new(2.1, 0, 0.5)
		sL = Vector3.new(1.9, 0, -0.5)
		hR = -0.9
		hL = 0.5
		kR = 0.6
		kL = 0.3
		waistRot = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1.45)
		neckRot = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0.45)
	else -- IDLE
		rig.phase += dt * 1.6
		local breathe = math.sin(rig.phase) * 0.045
		sR = Vector3.new(breathe, 0, 0.04)
		sL = Vector3.new(-breathe, 0, -0.04)
		rootOff = Vector3.new(0, breathe * 0.6, 0)
		neckRot = Vector3.new(0, math.sin(rig.phase * 0.45) * 0.3, 0)
	end

	if j.root then
		j.root.Transform = CFrame.new(rootOff)
	end
	if j.waist then
		j.waist.Transform = CFrame.Angles(waistRot.X, waistRot.Y, waistRot.Z)
	end
	if j.neck then
		j.neck.Transform = CFrame.Angles(neckRot.X, neckRot.Y, neckRot.Z)
	end
	if j.shoulderR then
		j.shoulderR.Transform = CFrame.Angles(sR.X, sR.Y, sR.Z)
	end
	if j.shoulderL then
		j.shoulderL.Transform = CFrame.Angles(sL.X, sL.Y, sL.Z)
	end
	if j.elbowR then
		j.elbowR.Transform = CFrame.Angles(eR.X, eR.Y, eR.Z)
	end
	if j.elbowL then
		j.elbowL.Transform = CFrame.Angles(eL.X, eL.Y, eL.Z)
	end
	if j.hipR then
		j.hipR.Transform = CFrame.Angles(hR, 0, 0)
	end
	if j.hipL then
		j.hipL.Transform = CFrame.Angles(hL, 0, 0)
	end
	if j.kneeR then
		j.kneeR.Transform = CFrame.Angles(kR, 0, 0)
	end
	if j.kneeL then
		j.kneeL.Transform = CFrame.Angles(kL, 0, 0)
	end
end

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Theo dõi thư mục (NPC đi bộ nằm phẳng, tài xế nằm sâu trong xe)
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

local function watchFolder(folder: Instance, recursive: boolean)
	local function tryAdd(inst: Instance)
		if inst:IsA("Model") and inst:GetAttribute("IsGTA_NPC") == true then
			task.defer(register, inst)
		end
	end

	if recursive then
		for _, d in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
			tryAdd(d)
		end
		folder.DescendantAdded:Connect(tryAdd)
	else
		for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
			register(child)
		end
		folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
			task.defer(register, child)
		end)
	end

	folder.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(inst)
		if inst:IsA("Model") then
			unregister(inst)
		end
	end)
end

function NPCAnimator.mount()
	local folder = Workspace:WaitForChild("LosSantos_NPCs", 60)
	if folder then
		watchFolder(folder, false)
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		local trafficFolder = Workspace:WaitForChild("LosSantos_Traffic", 200)
		if trafficFolder then
			watchFolder(trafficFolder, true)
		end
	end)

	local accum = 0
	local step = 1 / UPDATE_HZ

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		accum += dt
		if accum < step then
			return
		end
		local frameDt = accum
		accum = 0

		local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
		local camPos = if cam then cam.CFrame.Position else Vector3.zero
		local clock = os.clock()

		for model, rig in pairs(rigs) do
			if not model.Parent then
				rigs[model] = nil
				continue
			end

			local pivot = model:GetPivot().Position
			if (pivot - camPos).Magnitude > CULL_DISTANCE then
				continue
			end

			local state = model:GetAttribute("AnimState")
			if type(state) ~= "string" then
				state = "IDLE"
			end
			rig.lastState = state

			-- LỚP 1: Roblox đang tự phát animation thật -> không vẽ đè.
			-- Ngoại lệ DUY NHẤT là DRIVE: server đã dừng animation thật để
			-- nhân vật ngồi gọn trong ghế, nên client phải vẽ tư thế ngồi.
			local real = model:GetAttribute("UsesRealAnims") == true
			if real and state ~= "DRIVE" then
				continue
			end

			applyPose(rig, state, frameDt, clock)
		end
	end)
end

return NPCAnimator

local function formatDollars(amount: number): string
	local negative = amount < 0
	local n = math.floor(math.abs(amount))
	local s = tostring(n)
	local formatted = s
	while true do
		local k
		formatted, k = string.gsub(formatted, "^(%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2")
		if k == 0 then
			break
		end
	end
	return (if negative then "-$" else "$") .. formatted
end

	local closeTag = Instance.new("TextButton")

	local ctCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

	local function toggleTestMenu()

		openHintBtn.Visible = not testBar.Visible

	openHintBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleTestMenu)

	local testButtonsSpec = {
		{ label = "▶  Gọi Siêu Xe Trước Mặt", right = "CAR", cmd = "spawn_car", accent = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248) },
		{ label = "★  Tăng +1 Sao Truy Nã", right = "LSPD", cmd = "add_star", accent = Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68) },
		{ label = "☆  Xoá Toàn Bộ Truy Nã", right = "0 ★", cmd = "clear_stars", accent = Color3.fromRGB(148, 163, 184) },
		{ label = "$  Nhận +$500 Tiền Mặt", right = "+$500", cmd = "add_cash", accent = Color3.fromRGB(114, 204, 114) },
		{ label = "◆  Nạp / Đổi Áo Giáp", right = "ARMOR", cmd = "add_armor", accent = Color3.fromRGB(59, 155, 232) },
		{ label = "✚  Thử Sát Thương / Hồi Máu", right = "HP", cmd = "test_hp", accent = Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11) },
	}
	for idx, bSpec in ipairs(testButtonsSpec) do
		local rowY = 46 + (idx - 1) * 35
		local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
		btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, rowY)
		btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 31)
		btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 27, 36)
		btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
		btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		btn.TextSize = 12
		btn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(241, 245, 249)
		btn.Text = "   " .. bSpec.label
		btn.AutoButtonColor = false
		btn.Parent = testBar
		local bCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		bCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
		bCorner.Parent = btn
		btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.1), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(34, 42, 56) }):Play()
		end)
		btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.1), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 27, 36) }):Play()
		end)

		local barLeft = Instance.new("Frame")
		barLeft.Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, 0)
		barLeft.BackgroundColor3 = bSpec.accent
		barLeft.BorderSizePixel = 0
		barLeft.Parent = btn

		local rightTag = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		rightTag.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		rightTag.Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0)
		rightTag.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 18)
		rightTag.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		rightTag.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		rightTag.TextSize = 10
		rightTag.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
		rightTag.TextColor3 = bSpec.accent
		rightTag.Text = bSpec.right
		rightTag.Parent = btn

		btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			hudRemote:FireServer(bSpec.cmd)
		end)
	end

	-- ========================================================================
	-- 6. LOGIC ĐỒNG BỘ DỮ LIỆU THỜI GIAN THỰC (SPRINT, CASH, WANTED, RADAR)
	-- ========================================================================
	local stamina = 100
	local isSprinting = false
	local lastCash = tonumber(localPlayer:GetAttribute("Cash")) or 5000
	local deltaToken = 0
	local lastLocationKey = ""

	cashLabel.Text = formatDollars(lastCash)

	localPlayer:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Cash"):Connect(function()
		local current = tonumber(localPlayer:GetAttribute("Cash")) or 0
		local diff = current - lastCash
		lastCash = current
		cashLabel.Text = formatDollars(current)

		if diff ~= 0 then
			deltaToken += 1
			local myD = deltaToken
			cashDeltaLabel.Text = (if diff > 0 then "+" else "") .. formatDollars(diff)
			cashDeltaLabel.TextColor3 = if diff > 0
				then Color3.fromRGB(240, 253, 244)
				else Color3.fromRGB(248, 113, 113)
			task.delay(2.4, function()
				if deltaToken == myD then
					cashDeltaLabel.Text = ""
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	local function refreshArmor()
		local armor = math.clamp(tonumber(localPlayer:GetAttribute("Armor")) or 0, 0, 100)
		TweenService:Create(armorFill, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(armor / 100, 1),
		}):Play()
	end
	localPlayer:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Armor"):Connect(refreshArmor)
	refreshArmor()

	hudRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
		if type(payload) == "table" and type(payload.message) == "string" then
			showFeed(payload.message, payload.color)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
		if gp then
			return
		end
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
			isSprinting = true
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.H then
			toggleTestMenu()
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
			isSprinting = false
		end
	end)

	-- Đồng hồ tốc độ xe hơi góc dưới phải (tự hiện khi lên xe, tự ẩn khi xuống xe)
	local speedoCluster = Instance.new("Frame")
	speedoCluster.Name = "VehicleSpeedometer"
	speedoCluster.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
	speedoCluster.Position = UDim2.new(1, -26, 1, -84)
	speedoCluster.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(196, 52)
	speedoCluster.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(6, 9, 13)
	speedoCluster.BackgroundTransparency = 0.42
	speedoCluster.BorderSizePixel = 0
	speedoCluster.Visible = false
	speedoCluster.Parent = screen
	local sCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	sCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
	sCorner.Parent = speedoCluster
	local sStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	sStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	sStroke.Transparency = 0.6
	sStroke.Thickness = 1
	sStroke.Parent = speedoCluster
	local sAccent = Instance.new("Frame")
	sAccent.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
	sAccent.Position = UDim2.new(1, -5, 0.5, 0)
	sAccent.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 30)
	sAccent.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
	sAccent.BorderSizePixel = 0
	sAccent.Parent = speedoCluster
	local saCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	saCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	saCorner.Parent = sAccent

	local carNameTag = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	carNameTag.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	carNameTag.Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 15)
	carNameTag.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 6)
	carNameTag.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	carNameTag.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	carNameTag.TextSize = 12
	carNameTag.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	carNameTag.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
	carNameTag.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
	carNameTag.Text = "BANSHEE GT"
	carNameTag.Parent = speedoCluster

	local mphLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	mphLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 21)
	mphLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 26)
	mphLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	mphLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	mphLabel.TextSize = 26
	mphLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	mphLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252)
	mphLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 10, 14)
	mphLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.14
	mphLabel.Text = "0 MPH"
	mphLabel.Parent = speedoCluster

	showFeed(
		"Los Santos sẵn sàng! Giữ [TAB] mở VÒNG CHỌN SÚNG • [F] lên xe • [R] nạp đạn • [H] Menu Test.",
		Color3.fromRGB(86, 186, 86)
	)

	local lastCarName = ""
	local lastMphText = ""

	-- =====================================================================
	-- TỐI ƯU HIỆU NĂNG: tách nhịp cập nhật HUD
	--   • 60 FPS : chỉ radar xoay/dịch + thanh máu/thể lực (phép tính rẻ, mượt)
	--   •  10 FPS : chữ đồng hồ, sao truy nã, tên xe, số MPH (string.format rất tốn)
	--   •   3 FPS : getLocationInfo() (dò khu vực/tên đường nặng nhất)
	-- Trước đây TOÀN BỘ chạy 60 FPS -> ~180 string.format + 240 FindFirstChild mỗi giây.
	-- =====================================================================
	local TEXT_INTERVAL = 0.1
	local LOCATION_INTERVAL = 0.34
	local textAccum = TEXT_INTERVAL
	local locationAccum = LOCATION_INTERVAL

	-- Cache nhân vật: tránh gọi FindFirstChild/FindFirstChildOfClass mỗi frame
	local cachedChar: Model? = nil
	local cachedHrp: BasePart? = nil
	local cachedHum: Humanoid? = nil

	local function refreshCharacterCache()
		local char = localPlayer.Character
		if char ~= cachedChar then
			cachedChar = char
			cachedHrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? else nil
			cachedHum = if char then char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		end
		if cachedHrp and not cachedHrp.Parent then
			cachedChar = nil
			cachedHrp = nil
			cachedHum = nil
		end
	end

	local function updateTextLayer(dt: number, hum: Humanoid, hrp: BasePart)
		-- Đồng hồ giờ game
		local ct = Lighting.ClockTime
		local hh = math.floor(ct)
		local mm = math.floor((ct - hh) * 60)
		clockChip.Text = string.format("LOS SANTOS • %02d:%02d", hh, mm)

		-- Sao truy nã + chớp Xanh-Đỏ
		local wanted = math.clamp(tonumber(localPlayer:GetAttribute("WantedLevel")) or 0, 0, 5)
		starsRow.Visible = wanted > 0
		if wanted > 0 then
			local pulsePhase = math.floor(os.clock() * 4.2) % 2 == 0
			wantedFlash.BackgroundColor3 = if pulsePhase
				then Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68)
				else Color3.fromRGB(59, 130, 246)
			wantedFlash.BackgroundTransparency = 0.84
			for i = 1, 5 do
				local st = starLabels[i]
				if i <= wanted then
					st.TextTransparency = 0
					st.TextColor3 = if pulsePhase
						then Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
						else Color3.fromRGB(191, 219, 254)
				else
					st.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 36, 46)
					st.TextTransparency = 0.42
				end
			end
		else
			wantedFlash.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		end

		-- Đồng hồ tốc độ MPH
		local seatPart = hum.SeatPart
		local activeCar = if seatPart then seatPart:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") else nil
		if activeCar and activeCar:GetAttribute("IsGtaVehicle") == true then
			local mph = tonumber(activeCar:GetAttribute("CurrentMPH")) or 0
			local cname = tostring(activeCar:GetAttribute("VehicleDisplayName") or activeCar.Name)
			if cname ~= lastCarName then
				lastCarName = cname
				carNameTag.Text = string.upper(cname)
			end
			local mphText = string.format("%d MPH", mph)
			if mphText ~= lastMphText then
				lastMphText = mphText
				mphLabel.Text = mphText
			end
			speedoCluster.Visible = true
		else
			speedoCluster.Visible = false
			lastMphText = ""
		end
	end

	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		textAccum += dt
		locationAccum += dt
		local doText = textAccum >= TEXT_INTERVAL
		local doLocation = locationAccum >= LOCATION_INTERVAL
		if doText then
			textAccum = 0
		end
		if doLocation then
			locationAccum = 0
		end

		refreshCharacterCache()
		local hrp = cachedHrp
		local hum = cachedHum
		if not hrp or not hum then
			return
		end

		-- Máu (Health) — mượt mỗi frame
		local hpRatio = math.clamp(hum.Health / math.max(1, hum.MaxHealth), 0, 1)
		healthFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(hpRatio, 1)
		healthFill.BackgroundColor3 = if hpRatio < 0.3
			then Color3.fromRGB(220, 56, 56)
			else Color3.fromRGB(86, 186, 86)

		-- Thể lực chạy nhanh (Stamina) — mượt mỗi frame
		local moving = hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05
		if isSprinting and moving and stamina > 1 then
			stamina = math.max(0, stamina - 22 * dt)
			hum.WalkSpeed = 24
		else
			stamina = math.min(100, stamina + 16 * dt)
			hum.WalkSpeed = 16
		end
		staminaFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(stamina / 100, 1)

		-- Radar xoay/dịch theo Camera — mượt mỗi frame
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local camLook = if cam then cam.CFrame.LookVector else Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
		local camHeadingRad = math.atan2(camLook.X, -camLook.Z)
		local mapRotDeg = -math.deg(camHeadingRad)

		local pos = hrp.Position
		mapPivot.Rotation = mapRotDeg
		mapContent.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-pos.X * RADAR_SCALE, -pos.Z * RADAR_SCALE)

		local charLook = hrp.CFrame.LookVector
		local charHeadingRad = math.atan2(charLook.X, -charLook.Z)
		playerBlip.Rotation = math.deg(charHeadingRad - camHeadingRad) + 45

		local northAngle = -camHeadingRad - math.pi / 2
		local nx = math.clamp(0.5 + math.cos(northAngle) * 0.46, 0.06, 0.94)
		local ny = math.clamp(0.5 + math.sin(northAngle) * 0.46, 0.07, 0.93)
		northBadge.Position = UDim2.new(nx, 0, 0, ny * RADAR_H)

		-- Tầng chữ: 10 lần/giây
		if doText then
			updateTextLayer(dt, hum, hrp)
		end

		-- Khu vực & tên đường: 3 lần/giây (nặng nhất)
		if doLocation then
			local distName, stName = WorldGrid.getLocationInfo(pos)
			local locKey = distName .. "|" .. stName
			if locKey ~= lastLocationKey then
				lastLocationKey = locKey
				districtLabel.Text = distName
				streetLabel.Text = stName
			end
		end

	end)

	return screen
end

return GtaHud

GtaWeaponWheel.source:
--!strict
--[[
	GtaWeaponWheel.luau
	================================================================================
	VÒNG CHỌN SÚNG CHUẨN GTA V  (giữ TAB để mở, thả TAB để trang bị)
	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	• 8 ô vũ khí xếp vòng tròn, ô TRÊN CÙNG = ô số 1, đi theo chiều kim đồng hồ.
	• Rê chuột ra khỏi tâm -> ô theo hướng chuột sáng lên, tâm hiện tên + đạn.
	• Chết giữa vùng tâm -> giữ nguyên ô đang chọn (giống hệt GTA V).
	• Phím 1..8 đổi súng nhanh khi KHÔNG mở vòng.
	• Thẻ vũ khí góc dưới phải: tên súng + ĐẠN TRONG BĂNG / DỰ TRỮ + nhắc [R].
	• Icon súng được vẽ 100% bằng Frame (không cần asset ngoài, không tốn texture).
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local GtaWeaponWheel = {}

--============================================================================
-- BẢNG MÀU DÙNG CHUNG (khớp GtaHud)
--============================================================================
local C = {
	panel = Color3.fromRGB(10, 12, 16),
	panelLight = Color3.fromRGB(18, 23, 31),
	line = Color3.fromRGB(38, 48, 64),
	text = Color3.fromRGB(241, 245, 249),
	dim = Color3.fromRGB(148, 163, 184),
	white = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
	danger = Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68),
}

local SLOT_COUNT = 9 -- 9 ô (8 khẩu + RPG)
local SLOT_GAP = (math.pi * 2) / SLOT_COUNT -- tự giãn: 9 ô = 40°
local RING_RADIUS = 196
local SLOT_SIZE = 108

local FALLBACK_WEAPONS = {
	{ name = "Unarmed", display = "TAY KHÔNG", icon = "fist", slot = 1, category = "KHÔNG VŨ KHÍ", magSize = 0, accent = { 148, 163, 184 } },
	{ name = "Baseball Bat", display = "GẬY BÓNG CHÀY", icon = "bat", slot = 2, category = "CẬN CHIẾN", magSize = 0, accent = { 245, 158, 11 } },
	{ name = "Pistol 9mm", display = "PISTOL 9MM", icon = "pistol", slot = 3, category = "SÚNG NGẮN", magSize = 12, accent = { 96, 165, 250 } },
	{ name = "AP Pistol", display = "AP PISTOL", icon = "appistol", slot = 4, category = "SÚNG NGẮN TỰ ĐỘNG", magSize = 18, accent = { 56, 189, 248 } },
	{ name = "Micro SMG", display = "MICRO SMG", icon = "smg", slot = 5, category = "TIỂU LIÊN", magSize = 30, accent = { 45, 212, 191 } },
	{ name = "Carbine Rifle", display = "CARBINE RIFLE", icon = "rifle", slot = 6, category = "SÚNG TRƯỜNG", magSize = 30, accent = { 74, 222, 128 } },
	{ name = "Assault Shotgun", display = "ASSAULT SHOTGUN", icon = "shotgun", slot = 7, category = "SÚNG SHOTGUN", magSize = 8, accent = { 251, 146, 60 } },
	{ name = "Sniper Rifle", display = "SNIPER RIFLE", icon = "sniper", slot = 8, category = "SÚNG BẮN TỈA", magSize = 5, accent = { 192, 132, 252 } },
	{ name = "RPG", display = "RPG-7", icon = "rpg", slot = 9, category = "VŨ KHÍ HẠNG NẶNG", magSize = 1, accent = { 239, 68, 68 } },
}

local function accentOf(list: { number }?): Color3
	if list and #list >= 3 then
		return Color3.fromRGB(list[1], list[2], list[3])
	end
	return Color3.fromRGB(148, 163, 184)
end

--============================================================================
-- BỘ VẼ ICON BẰNG FRAME
--============================================================================
local function newRect(parent: Instance, w: number, h: number, x: number, y: number, rot: number?, col: Color3?): Frame
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
	f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
	f.BackgroundColor3 = col or C.text
	f.BorderSizePixel = 0
	f.Rotation = rot or 0
	f.Parent = parent
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.min(w, h) * 0.24)
	c.Parent = f
	return f
end

-- Mỗi icon vẽ trong khung 64 × 64 (tâm 32,32)
local function buildIcon(kind: string, parent: Instance, scale: number?): Frame
	local box = Instance.new("Frame")
	box.Name = "Icon_" .. kind
	box.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	box.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.44)
	box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 64) -- luôn vẽ trên lưới 64×64 rồi thu nhỏ bằng UIScale
	box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	box.Parent = parent
	if scale and scale ~= 1 then
		local s = Instance.new("UIScale")
		s.Scale = scale
		s.Parent = box
	end

		btn.BorderSizePixel = 0

		keyBadge.TextSize = 10
		keyBadge.TextColor3 = C.white
		keyBadge.Text = tostring(i)
		keyBadge.BorderSizePixel = 0
		keyBadge.Parent = btn

		kbCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

		label.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -8)

		label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		label.TextSize = 9
		label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
