	--=======================================================================
	-- C. DỮ LIỆU VŨ KHÍ
	--=======================================================================
	local weapons: { any } = table.clone(FALLBACK_WEAPONS)
	local bySlot: { [number]: any } = {}
	local ammoBySlot: { [number]: { mag: number, reserve: number, magSize: number } } = {}
	local selectedSlot = 3
	local wheelOpen = false
	local equippedName = ""

	local function rebuildIndex()
		bySlot = {}
		for _, w in ipairs(weapons) do
			bySlot[w.slot] = w
		end
	end
	rebuildIndex()

	local function updateCard()
		local active = bySlot[selectedSlot]
		if not active then
			return
		end
		nameLabel.Text = tostring(active.display)
		local accent = accentOf(active.accent)
		cardAccent.BackgroundColor3 = accent
		iconBox.BackgroundColor3 = C.panelLight
		local ammo = ammoBySlot[active.slot]
		if ammo and ammo.magSize > 0 then
			magLabel.Text = tostring(ammo.mag)
			reserveLabel.Text = "/ " .. tostring(ammo.reserve)
			magLabel.TextColor3 = if ammo.mag == 0 then C.danger else C.white
			reloadHint.Visible = ammo.mag == 0
		else
			magLabel.Text = ""
			reserveLabel.Text = if active.slot <= 2 then "CẬN CHIẾN" else ""
			reloadHint.Visible = false
		end
	end

	local function refreshSlotVisuals()
		for slotIdx, view in ipairs(slots) do
			local w = bySlot[slotIdx]
			if w then
				view.label.Text = string.upper(tostring(w.display))
				local ammo = ammoBySlot[slotIdx]
				if ammo and ammo.magSize > 0 then
					view.ammoTag.Text = tostring(ammo.mag) .. "/" .. tostring(ammo.reserve)
					view.ammoTag.TextColor3 = if ammo.mag == 0 then C.danger else C.dim
				else
					view.ammoTag.Text = if slotIdx <= 2 then "∞" else ""
					view.ammoTag.TextColor3 = C.dim
				end
				view.accent = accentOf(w.accent)
				-- Vẽ lại icon theo đúng loại súng (xoá hẳn khung cũ để không rò rỉ Frame)
				if view.icon.Parent then
					view.icon:Destroy()
				end
				local rebuilt = buildIcon(tostring(w.icon), view.button, 0.8)
				rebuilt.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.40)
				view.icon = rebuilt
			end
		end
	end

	--========================================================================
	-- D. CHỌN Ô
	--========================================================================
	local function setSelected(index: number)
		selectedSlot = index
		for i, view in ipairs(slots) do
			local on = i == index
			local w = bySlot[i]
			local accent = if w then accentOf(w.accent) else C.dim
			view.stroke.Color = if on then accent else Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			view.stroke.Transparency = if on then 0 else 0.72
			view.stroke.Thickness = if on then 3 else 1.5
			view.button.BackgroundColor3 = if on then accent:Lerp(C.panel, 0.72) else C.panelLight
			view.button.BackgroundTransparency = if on then 0.02 else 0.18
			TweenService:Create(view.scale, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
				Scale = if on then 1.09 else 1,
			}):Play()
			view.label.TextColor3 = if on then C.white else C.dim
		end
		local w = bySlot[index]
		if w then
			hubCategory.Text = string.upper(tostring(w.category or ""))
			hubName.Text = string.upper(tostring(w.display))
			local accent = accentOf(w.accent)
			hubAmmo.TextColor3 = accent
			hubStroke.Color = accent
			hubStroke.Transparency = 0.55
			local ammo = ammoBySlot[index]
			if ammo and ammo.magSize > 0 then
				hubAmmo.Text = tostring(ammo.mag) .. " / " .. tostring(ammo.reserve)
			else
				hubAmmo.Text = if index <= 2 then "∞" else "—"
			end
		end
		updateCard()
	end

	--========================================================================
	-- E. TRANG BỊ
	--========================================================================
	local function equipSlot(index: number)
		local w = bySlot[index]
		if not w then
			return
		end
		local char = localPlayer.Character
		local hum = if char then char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		if not hum then
			return
		end
		if w.name == "Unarmed" then
			hum:UnequipTools()
			equippedName = "Unarmed"
		else
			local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
			local tool = (char and char:FindFirstChild(w.name)) or (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(w.name))
			if tool and tool:IsA("Tool") then
				hum:EquipTool(tool)
				equippedName = w.name
			end
		end
		updateCard()
	end

	--========================================================================
	-- F. MỞ / ĐÓNG
	--========================================================================
	local function openWheel()
		if wheelOpen then
			return
		end
		wheelOpen = true
		overlay.Visible = true
		overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		rootScale.Scale = 0.9
		TweenService:Create(overlay, TweenInfo.new(0.16), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 }):Play()
		TweenService:Create(rootScale, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Scale = 1,
		}):Play()
		-- Bắt đầu từ súng đang cầm
		local char = localPlayer.Character
		local tool = if char then char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") else nil
		local startSlot = selectedSlot
		if tool and tool:GetAttribute("IsGtaWeapon") == true then
			local slotNum = tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("WeaponSlot"))
			if slotNum then
				startSlot = slotNum
			end
		end
		setSelected(startSlot)
		localPlayer:SetAttribute("WeaponWheelOpen", true)
	end

	local function closeWheel(equip: boolean)
		if not wheelOpen then
			return
		end
		wheelOpen = false
		localPlayer:SetAttribute("WeaponWheelOpen", false)
		TweenService:Create(overlay, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
		TweenService:Create(rootScale, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { Scale = 0.92 }):Play()
		task.delay(0.13, function()
			if not wheelOpen then
				overlay.Visible = false
			end
		end)
		if equip then
			equipSlot(selectedSlot)
		end
	end

	GtaWeaponWheel._select = setSelected
	GtaWeaponWheel._equip = equipSlot
	GtaWeaponWheel._close = closeWheel

	--========================================================================
	-- G. ĐỒNG BỘ TỪ SERVER
	--========================================================================
	local function applyState(payload: any)
		if type(payload) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		if payload.type == "state" then
			if type(payload.weapons) == "table" and #payload.weapons > 0 then
				weapons = payload.weapons
				rebuildIndex()
				ammoBySlot = {}
				for _, w in ipairs(weapons) do
					if type(w.magSize) == "number" and w.magSize > 0 then
						ammoBySlot[w.slot] = {
							mag = tonumber(w.mag) or 0,
							reserve = tonumber(w.reserve) or 0,
							magSize = w.magSize,
						}
					end
				end
				refreshSlotVisuals()
				setSelected(selectedSlot)
			end
			equippedName = tostring(payload.equipped or "")
		elseif payload.type == "ammo" then
			for _, w in ipairs(weapons) do
				if w.name == payload.name then
					ammoBySlot[w.slot] = {
						mag = tonumber(payload.mag) or 0,
						reserve = tonumber(payload.reserve) or 0,
						magSize = tonumber(payload.magSize) or w.magSize or 0,
					}
					break
				end
			end
			refreshSlotVisuals()
			updateCard()
		end
	end

	syncRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(applyState)

	--========================================================================
	-- H. PHÍM TẮT
	--========================================================================
	local function otherUiOpen(): boolean
		return localPlayer:GetAttribute("UIMenuOpen") == true
	end

	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
		if gp then
			return
		end
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Tab then
			if not otherUiOpen() then
				openWheel()
			end
			return
		end
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.R then
			reloadRemote:FireServer()
			return
		end
		if wheelOpen then
			if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
				closeWheel(false)
			end
			return
		end
		if otherUiOpen() then
			return
		end
		local keySlots: { [Enum.KeyCode]: number } = {
			[Enum.KeyCode.One] = 1,
			[Enum.KeyCode.Two] = 2,
			[Enum.KeyCode.Three] = 3,
			[Enum.KeyCode.Four] = 4,
			[Enum.KeyCode.Five] = 5,
			[Enum.KeyCode.Six] = 6,
			[Enum.KeyCode.Seven] = 7,
			[Enum.KeyCode.Eight] = 8,
			[Enum.KeyCode.Nine] = 9,
		}
		local slot = keySlots[input.KeyCode]
		if slot then
			setSelected(slot)
			equipSlot(slot)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Tab and wheelOpen then
			closeWheel(true)
		end
	end)

	--========================================================================
	-- I. CHỌN THEO HƯỚNG CHUỘT (mỗi frame khi mở)
	--========================================================================
	local function updateSelectionFromMouse()
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not cam then
			return
		end
		local vp = cam.ViewportSize
		local center = Vector2.new(vp.X * 0.5, vp.Y * 0.5)
		local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
		local delta = mouse - center
		local dist = delta.Magnitude
		if dist < 54 then
			return -- vùng chết ở tâm: giữ nguyên ô đang chọn
		end
		local deg = math.deg(math.atan2(delta.Y, delta.X))
		local normalized = (deg + 90 + 22.5) % 360
		local idx = math.floor(normalized / 45) + 1
		idx = math.clamp(idx, 1, 8)
		if idx ~= selectedSlot then
			setSelected(idx)
		end
	end

	--========================================================================
	-- J. THẺ VŨ KHÍ: ẨN KHI LÁI XE / KHI TAY KHÔNG
	--========================================================================
	local cardAccum = 0
	local lastEquippedKey = ""

	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		if wheelOpen then
			updateSelectionFromMouse()
			return
		end

		cardAccum += dt
		if cardAccum < 0.12 then
			return
		end
		cardAccum = 0

		local char = localPlayer.Character
		local hum = if char then char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		local tool = if char then char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") else nil
		local armed = tool ~= nil and tool:GetAttribute("IsGtaWeapon") == true and tool.Name ~= "Baseball Bat"
		local inVehicle = hum ~= nil and hum.SeatPart ~= nil

		if not armed or inVehicle then
			card.Visible = false
			return
		end
		card.Visible = true

		local slotNum = tonumber(tool and tool:GetAttribute("WeaponSlot")) or selectedSlot
		local key = tostring(tool and tool.Name) .. "|" .. tostring(slotNum)
		if key ~= lastEquippedKey then
			lastEquippedKey = key
			selectedSlot = slotNum
			updateCard()
		end
	end)

	-- Khởi tạo hiển thị
	refreshSlotVisuals()
	setSelected(3)

	return screen
end

return GtaWeaponWheel

LSCustomsUI.source:
--!strict
--[[
	LSCustomsUI.luau
	================================================================================
	GIAO DIỆN ĐỘ XE LOS SANTOS CUSTOMS (chuẩn GTA V — gọn, không che màn hình)
	================================================================================
	• Chip "[E] ĐỘ XE" nhỏ nằm sát đáy màn hình chỉ hiện khi xe đang nằm trong khoang.
	• Bấm [E] (hoặc chạm chip) mở bảng độ xe: SỬA CHỮA / SƠN LẠI / TURBO kèm giá tiền,
	  phím tắt [1] [2] [3], đóng bằng [ESC] hoặc nút X.
	• Mọi thao tác đều do server xác thực (tiền, khoang trống, cấp Turbo) rồi trả kết quả về.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LSCustomsUI = {}

local ACCENT = Color3.fromRGB(247, 214, 58)
local PANEL_BG = Color3.fromRGB(12, 16, 23)
local ROW_BG = Color3.fromRGB(24, 31, 42)

local function formatDollars(n: number): string
	local s = tostring(math.floor(n))
	local out = s
	while true do
		local formatted, k = string.gsub(out, "^(%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2")
		out = formatted
		if k == 0 then
			break
		end
	end
	return "$" .. out
end

function LSCustomsUI.mount(localPlayer: Player)
	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GtaRemotes")
	local remote = remotes:WaitForChild("LSCustoms") :: RemoteEvent
	local playerGui = localPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") :: PlayerGui

	local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild("GtaLSCustomsGui")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end

	local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screen.Name = "GtaLSCustomsGui"
	screen.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	screen.ResetOnSpawn = false
	screen.DisplayOrder = 21
	screen.Parent = playerGui

	-- ===========================================================
	-- 1. CHIP GỢI Ý [E] (sát đáy, nằm trên chip lên xe)
	-- ===========================================================
	local chip = Instance.new("TextButton")
	chip.Name = "LSCustomsChip"
	chip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	chip.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -56)
	chip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(268, 32)
	chip.BackgroundColor3 = PANEL_BG
	chip.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
	chip.BorderSizePixel = 0
	chip.AutoButtonColor = true
	chip.Text = ""
	chip.Visible = false
	chip.Parent = screen

	local chipCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

	chipCorner.Parent = chip

	local chipStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	chipStroke.Color = ACCENT
	chipStroke.Transparency = 0.25
	chipStroke.Thickness = 1.4
	chipStroke.Parent = chip

	local keyBadge = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	keyBadge.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)

	keyBadge.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 20, 26)
	keyBadge.Parent = chip

	local badgeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	badgeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

	local chipLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

	chipLabel.Parent = chip

	-- ===========================================================
	-- 2. BẢNG ĐỘ XE
	-- ===========================================================
	local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
	panel.Name = "LSCustomsPanel"
	panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)

	panel.Parent = screen

	local panelCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	panelCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	panelCorner.Parent = panel

	local panelStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	panelStroke.Color = ACCENT

	panelStroke.Thickness = 1.6
	panelStroke.Parent = panel

	local panelPad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	panelPad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 12)
	panelPad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 12)
	panelPad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 14)
	panelPad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 14)
	panelPad.Parent = panel

	local header = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
	header.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	header.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	header.TextSize = 16
	header.TextColor3 = ACCENT
	header.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	header.Text = "LOS SANTOS CUSTOMS"
	header.Parent = panel

	local subHeader = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	subHeader.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 22)
	subHeader.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 16)
	subHeader.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	subHeader.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	subHeader.TextSize = 12
	subHeader.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(168, 178, 192)
	subHeader.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	subHeader.Text = "Đang chờ xe trong khoang..."
	subHeader.Parent = panel

	local closeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	closeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	closeButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
	closeButton.BackgroundColor3 = ROW_BG
	closeButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
	closeButton.Text = "X"
	closeButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	closeButton.TextSize = 12
	closeButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(226, 232, 240)
	closeButton.Parent = panel

	local closeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	closeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
	closeCorner.Parent = closeButton

	local list = Instance.new("Frame")
	list.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 50)
	list.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 152)
	list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	list.Parent = panel

	local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	listLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
	listLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	listLayout.Parent = list

	local footer = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	footer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	footer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
	footer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
	footer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	footer.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	footer.TextSize = 11
	footer.TextWrapped = true
	footer.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	footer.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Bottom
	footer.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 160, 175)
	footer.Text = "[1] [2] [3] chọn dịch vụ   •   [ESC] đóng bảng"
	footer.Parent = panel

	type Row = {
		button: TextButton,
		title: TextLabel,
		price: TextLabel,
		action: string,
	}

	local rows: { Row } = {}

	local specs = {
		{ action = "repair", index = "1", title = "SỬA CHỮA TOÀN XE", hint = "Hồi 100% máu ẩn mọi chi tiết" },
		{ action = "paint", index = "2", title = "SƠN LẠI VỎ XE", hint = "Đổi màu sơn theo bảng màu GTA V" },
		{ action = "turbo", index = "3", title = "NÂNG CẤP TURBO", hint = "Tăng tốc độ tối đa (tối đa 3 cấp)" },
	}

	for i, spec in ipairs(specs) do
		local row = Instance.new("TextButton")
		row.Name = "Row_" .. spec.action
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44)
		row.BackgroundColor3 = ROW_BG
		row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.04
		row.BorderSizePixel = 0
		row.AutoButtonColor = true
		row.Text = ""
		row.LayoutOrder = i
		row.Parent = list

		local rowCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		rowCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
		rowCorner.Parent = row

		local rowStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		rowStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 66, 82)
		rowStroke.Transparency = 0.35
		rowStroke.Thickness = 1
		rowStroke.Parent = row

		local keyTag = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		keyTag.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		keyTag.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, 0)
		keyTag.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
		keyTag.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 48, 62)
		keyTag.BorderSizePixel = 0
		keyTag.Text = spec.index
		keyTag.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		keyTag.TextSize = 12
		keyTag.TextColor3 = ACCENT
		keyTag.Parent = row

		local keyCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		keyCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
		keyCorner.Parent = keyTag

		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 6)
		title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 16)
		title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		title.TextSize = 12
		title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(236, 242, 250)
		title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.Text = spec.title
		title.Parent = row

		local hint = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		hint.Position = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 22)
		hint.Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 14)
		hint.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		hint.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
		hint.TextSize = 10
		hint.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(142, 152, 168)
		hint.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		hint.Text = spec.hint
		hint.Parent = row

		local price = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		price.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		price.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0)
		price.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(66, 18)
		price.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		price.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		price.TextSize = 13
		price.TextColor3 = ACCENT
		price.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
		price.Text = "--"
		price.Parent = row

		table.insert(rows, { button = row, title = title, price = price, action = spec.action })
	end

	-- ===========================================================
	-- 3. TRẠNG THÁI + ĐIỀU KHIỂN
	-- ===========================================================
	local promptVisible = false
	local currentBay = 0
	local menuOpen = false

	local function setPanelOpen(open: boolean)
		menuOpen = open
		-- Cờ dùng chung: Vòng chọn súng / HUD sẽ nhường phím 1..8 & TAB khi menu này mở
		localPlayer:SetAttribute("UIMenuOpen", open)
		panel.Visible = open
		if open then
			panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(356, 268)
			TweenService:Create(panel, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(372, 268),
			}):Play()
		end
	end

	local function refreshPrices(car: any)
		if type(car) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		local prices = car.prices
		local turboLevel = tonumber(car.turbo) or 0
		subHeader.Text = string.format("%s   •   Hư hỏng %d%%   •   Turbo cấp %d", tostring(car.name), tonumber(car.damagePct) or 0, turboLevel)
		for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
			local price = if type(prices) == "table" then tonumber(prices[row.action]) else nil
			if price then
				row.price.Text = formatDollars(price)
				row.price.TextColor3 = ACCENT
			end
			if row.action == "turbo" then
				row.title.Text = if turboLevel >= 3 then "NÂNG CẤP TURBO (TỐI ĐA)" else "NÂNG CẤP TURBO"
				row.title.TextColor3 = if turboLevel >= 3 then Color3.fromRGB(140, 150, 165) else Color3.fromRGB(236, 242, 250)
			end
		end
	end

	chip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if promptVisible then
			remote:FireServer({ action = "open", bay = currentBay })
		end
	end)

	closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		setPanelOpen(false)
		remote:FireServer({ action = "close", bay = currentBay })
	end)

	local function fireRow(action: string)
		if not menuOpen then
			return
		end
		remote:FireServer({ action = action, bay = currentBay })
	end

	for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
		row.button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			fireRow(row.action)
		end)
	end

	remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
		if type(payload) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		local kind = payload.kind
		if kind == "prompt" then
			promptVisible = payload.visible == true
			currentBay = tonumber(payload.bay) or 0
			chip.Visible = promptVisible and not menuOpen
			if promptVisible then
				local vehicle = tostring(payload.vehicle or "")
				chipLabel.Text = if vehicle ~= "" then string.format("ĐỘ XE — %s", string.upper(vehicle)) else "ĐỘ XE — LOS SANTOS CUSTOMS"
			end
			if not promptVisible then
				setPanelOpen(false)
			end
		elseif kind == "menu" then
			currentBay = tonumber(payload.bay) or currentBay
			refreshPrices(payload.car)
			footer.Text = "[1] [2] [3] chọn dịch vụ   •   [ESC] đóng bảng"
			footer.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 160, 175)
			setPanelOpen(true)
			chip.Visible = false
		elseif kind == "closed" then
			setPanelOpen(false)
			chip.Visible = promptVisible
		elseif kind == "result" then
			local ok = payload.ok == true
			footer.Text = tostring(payload.message or "")
			footer.TextColor3 = if ok then Color3.fromRGB(86, 226, 140) else Color3.fromRGB(255, 118, 108)
			if payload.car then
				refreshPrices(payload.car)
			end
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
		if gameProcessed then
			return
		end
		if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
			return
		end
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
			if promptVisible and not menuOpen then
				remote:FireServer({ action = "open", bay = currentBay })
			end
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
			if menuOpen then
				setPanelOpen(false)
				remote:FireServer({ action = "close", bay = currentBay })
			end
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.One then
			fireRow("repair")
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Two then
			fireRow("paint")
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Three then
			fireRow("turbo")
		end
	end)

	local function hideOnSeatChange()
		if menuOpen then
			setPanelOpen(false)
		end
	end
	localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		chip.Visible = false
		setPanelOpen(false)
		hideOnSeatChange()
	end)
end

return LSCustomsUI

VehiclePromptUI.source:
--!strict
--[[
	VehiclePromptUI.luau
	Giao diện nút [F] lên xe thiết kế lại chuẩn GTA V (nhỏ gọn, tinh tế, KHÔNG BAO GIỜ chắn giữa màn hình):
	- Thay thế hoàn toàn bảng ProximityPrompt xám khổng lồ mặc định của Roblox (vì prompt.Style = Custom).
	- TỰ ĐỘNG ẨN 100% ngay lập tức khi nhân vật đã ngồi trên bất kỳ ghế nào (SeatPart ~= nil) -> không bao giờ
	  hiện nhầm nút "Vào ghế phụ" chắn ngang người khi đang ngồi lái!
	- Khi đi bộ lại gần tay nắm cửa xe:
	  1. Chấm ghim phím [F] siêu nhỏ (22x22 px) gắn gọn ngay trên tay nắm cửa 3D để biết đang đứng gần cửa nào.
	  2. Thanh chip mỏng 228x30 px nằm sát mép đáy màn hình (giữa Minimap & Tên Đường), bấm chuột/chạm tay cũng vào xe được!
]]

local ProximityPromptService = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local VehiclePromptUI = {}

function VehiclePromptUI.mount(localPlayer: Player)
	local playerGui = localPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") :: PlayerGui

	local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild("GtaVehiclePromptGui")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end

	local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screen.Name = "GtaVehiclePromptGui"
	screen.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	screen.ResetOnSpawn = false
	screen.DisplayOrder = 18
	screen.Parent = playerGui

	-- 1. Thanh Chip Gọn Nhẹ Sát Mép Đáy Màn Hình (Không bao giờ che nhân vật hay thân xe!)
	local bottomChip = Instance.new("TextButton")

	bottomChip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)

	bottomChip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(234, 30)
	bottomChip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 13, 18)
	bottomChip.BackgroundTransparency = 0.14
	bottomChip.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bottomChip.AutoButtonColor = true
	bottomChip.Text = ""
	bottomChip.Visible = false
	bottomChip.Parent = screen

	local chipCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

	local chipStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	chipStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
	chipStroke.Transparency = 0.35
	chipStroke.Thickness = 1.2
	chipStroke.Parent = bottomChip

	local keyBadge = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	keyBadge.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	keyBadge.Position = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0.5, 0)
	keyBadge.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
	keyBadge.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(241, 245, 249)
	keyBadge.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	keyBadge.TextSize = 12
	keyBadge.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 16, 24)
	keyBadge.Text = "F"
	keyBadge.Parent = bottomChip

	local kbCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	kbCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
	kbCorner.Parent = keyBadge

	local actionLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	actionLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	actionLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 34, 0.5, 0)
	actionLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -42, 1, 0)
	actionLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	actionLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	actionLabel.TextSize = 12
	actionLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	actionLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(241, 245, 249)
	actionLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	actionLabel.Text = "Vào ghế lái • Banshee GT"
	actionLabel.Parent = bottomChip

	-- 2. Chấm Ghim Nhỏ Gọn (22x22 px) Gắn Đúng Tay Nắm Cửa 3D (nhỏ gấp 15 lần bảng mặc định của Roblox!)
	local handlePin = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	handlePin.Name = "DoorHandleMiniPin"
	handlePin.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22)
	handlePin.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 0.35, 0)
	handlePin.AlwaysOnTop = true
	handlePin.Enabled = false
	handlePin.Parent = screen

	local pinBox = Instance.new("Frame")
	pinBox.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	pinBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 16, 24)
	pinBox.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
	pinBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
	pinBox.Parent = handlePin

	local pinCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	pinCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
	pinCorner.Parent = pinBox

	local pinStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	pinStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
	pinStroke.Thickness = 1.4
	pinStroke.Parent = pinBox

	local pinTxt = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	pinTxt.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	pinTxt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	pinTxt.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	pinTxt.TextSize = 11
	pinTxt.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252)
	pinTxt.Text = "F"
	pinTxt.Parent = pinBox

	local currentPrompt: ProximityPrompt? = nil

	local function isPlayerSeated(): boolean
		local char = localPlayer.Character
		local hum = if char then char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		return hum ~= nil and hum.SeatPart ~= nil
	end

	local function refreshVisibility()
		local pr = currentPrompt
		if not pr or not pr.Parent or not pr.Enabled or isPlayerSeated() then
			bottomChip.Visible = false
			handlePin.Enabled = false
			handlePin.Adornee = nil
			return
		end

		local keyName = pr.KeyboardKeyCode.Name
		if keyName == "" or keyName == "Unknown" then
			keyName = "F"
		end
		keyBadge.Text = keyName
		pinTxt.Text = keyName

		local obj = pr.ObjectText
		local act = pr.ActionText
		actionLabel.Text = if obj ~= "" then (act .. " • " .. obj) else act

		local adornee = pr.Parent
		if adornee and adornee:IsA("BasePart") then
			handlePin.Adornee = adornee
			handlePin.Enabled = true
		else
			handlePin.Adornee = nil
			handlePin.Enabled = false
		end
		bottomChip.Visible = true
	end

	-- Cho phép bấm trực tiếp vào thanh Chip đáy màn hình (hỗ trợ cả Mobile / Chuột!)
	bottomChip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		local pr = currentPrompt
		if pr and pr.Parent and pr.Enabled and not isPlayerSeated() then
			pr:InputHoldBegin()
			pr:InputHoldEnd()
		end
	end)

	ProximityPromptService.PromptShown:Connect(function(prompt)
		if prompt.Style ~= Enum.ProximityPromptStyle.Custom then
			return
		end
		currentPrompt = prompt
		refreshVisibility()
	end)

	ProximityPromptService.PromptHidden:Connect(function(prompt)
		if currentPrompt == prompt then
			currentPrompt = nil
			refreshVisibility()
		end
	end)

	-- Kiểm tra liên tục mỗi frame: vừa đặt mông lên ghế lái là ẩn sạch nút [F] trong 0.00s!
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if currentPrompt ~= nil then
			refreshVisibility()
		elseif bottomChip.Visible or handlePin.Enabled then
			bottomChip.Visible = false
			handlePin.Enabled = false
		end
	end)
end

return VehiclePromptUI

WeaponClient.source:
--!strict
--[[
	WeaponClient.luau
	Tâm ngắm chấm trắng chuẩn GTA V + Bắn tia đạn Tracer + Hiệu ứng nháy tâm khi bắn trúng / bắn vỡ khối!
	(Giữ nguyên quy tắc MÁU ẨN: tuyệt đối không hiện thanh máu thô trên gạch đá/xe).
]]

local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local WeaponClient = {}

local function drawLocalTracer(startPos: Vector3, endPos: Vector3, color: Color3?, thick: number?)
	local dist = (endPos - startPos).Magnitude
	if dist < 0.5 then
		return
	end
	local beam = Instance.new("Part")
	beam.Name = "BulletTracer"
	beam.Anchored = true
	beam.CanCollide = false
	beam.CanQuery = false
	beam.CastShadow = false
	beam.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	beam.Color = color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 102)
	beam.Transparency = 0.25
	local t = thick or 0.09
	beam.Size = Vector3.new(t, t, dist)
	beam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((startPos + endPos) * 0.5, endPos)
	beam.Parent = Workspace
	Debris:AddItem(beam, 0.055)
end

function WeaponClient.mount(localPlayer: Player, fireRemote: RemoteEvent)
	local mouse = localPlayer:GetMouse()
	local playerGui = localPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

	local reticleGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	reticleGui.Name = "GtaWeaponReticle"
	reticleGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	reticleGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	reticleGui.Parent = playerGui

	-- Tâm ngắm chấm trắng nhỏ gọn chuẩn GTA V (bám theo vị trí trỏ chuột khi cầm súng)
	local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
	dot.Name = "AimDot"
	dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6)
	dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	dot.Visible = false
	dot.Parent = reticleGui
	local dCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	dCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	dCorner.Parent = dot
	local dStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	dStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	dStroke.Thickness = 1.5
	dStroke.Parent = dot

	-- Nháy dấu '×' mảnh khi đạn trúng Part có máu ẩn (Đỏ rực khi viên đạn đó làm VỠ TUNG khối!)
	local hitTick = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	hitTick.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	hitTick.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	hitTick.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22)
	hitTick.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hitTick.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	hitTick.TextSize = 16
	hitTick.Text = "×"
	hitTick.TextTransparency = 1
	hitTick.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
	hitTick.Parent = dot

	local tickToken = 0
	fireRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(evt, shattered)
		if evt == "hit" then
			tickToken += 1
			local myT = tickToken
			hitTick.TextColor3 = if shattered
				then Color3.fromRGB(248, 62, 62)
				else Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252)
			hitTick.TextSize = if shattered then 21 else 15
			hitTick.TextTransparency = 0
			hitTick.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.25
			task.delay(0.14, function()
				if tickToken == myT then
					hitTick.TextTransparency = 1
					hitTick.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	local holdingTrigger = false
	local lastLocalShot = 0

	local function getEquippedGtaWeapon(): Tool?
		local char = localPlayer.Character
		if not char then
			return nil
		end
		local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
		if tool and tool:GetAttribute("IsGtaWeapon") == true then
			return tool
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function uiBlocksCombat(): boolean
		if localPlayer:GetAttribute("WeaponWheelOpen") == true then
			return true
		end
		if localPlayer:GetAttribute("UIMenuOpen") == true then
			return true
		end
		local char = localPlayer.Character
		local hum = if char then char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		if hum and hum.SeatPart then
			return true -- đang lái xe thì không bắn
		end
		return false
	end

	local function tryFireOnce(tool: Tool)
		if uiBlocksCombat() then
			return
		end
		local cd = tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("FireCooldown")) or 0.16
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastLocalShot < cd then
			return
		end
		lastLocalShot = now

		local muzzle = tool:FindFirstChild("Muzzle") :: BasePart?
		local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") :: BasePart?
		local origin = if muzzle then muzzle.Position elseif handle then handle.Position else nil
		if not origin then
			return
		end

		local targetPos = mouse.Hit.Position
		local dir = targetPos - origin
		if dir.Magnitude < 0.1 then
			return
		end

		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		local char = localPlayer.Character
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = if char then { char } else {}
		local isMelee = tool:GetAttribute("IsMelee") == true
		local pellets = math.max(1, tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Pellets")) or 1)

		-- RPG: KHÔNG vẽ tia hitscan (rocket bay 145 stud/s, server tự dựng part bay + vệt lửa)
		if tool:GetAttribute("IsExplosive") == true then
			local flash = Instance.new("Part")
			flash.Name = "RpgMuzzleFlash"
			flash.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
			flash.Size = Vector3.new(2.4, 2.4, 2.4)
			flash.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 140)
			flash.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			flash.CanCollide = false
			flash.CanTouch = false
			flash.CanQuery = false
			flash.Transparency = 0.35
			flash.CFrame = CFrame.new(origin + dir.Unit * 2.2)
			flash.Parent = Workspace
			Debris:AddItem(flash, 0.1)
			fireRemote:FireServer(origin, targetPos)
			return
		end

		if isMelee then
			-- Cận chiến: vệt chớp ngắn màu trắng thay cho tia đạn
			local res = Workspace:Raycast(origin, dir.Unit * 7, params)
			local endPt = if res then res.Position else (origin + dir.Unit * 5)
			drawLocalTracer(origin, endPt, Color3.fromRGB(226, 232, 240), 0.16)
			fireRemote:FireServer(origin, targetPos)
			return
		end

		local res = Workspace:Raycast(origin, dir.Unit * 350, params)
		local endPt = if res then res.Position else (origin + dir.Unit * 180)

		if pellets > 1 then
			-- SHOTGUN: vẽ 3 tia loe nhẹ cho cảm giác tản đạn (server vẫn bắn đủ 8 viên)
			for i = -1, 1 do
				local spreadDir = (dir.Unit + Vector3.new(0.035 * i, 0.02 * math.abs(i), 0) + Vector3.new(
					math.random() - 0.5,
					math.random() - 0.5,
					math.random() - 0.5
				) * 0.03).Unit
				local r = Workspace:Raycast(origin, spreadDir * 150, params)
				local e = if r then r.Position else (origin + spreadDir * 120)
				drawLocalTracer(origin, e, Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 120), 0.12)
			end
		else
			drawLocalTracer(origin, endPt)
		end
		fireRemote:FireServer(origin, targetPos)
	end

	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
		if gp then
			return
		end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			local tool = getEquippedGtaWeapon()
			if tool then
				holdingTrigger = true
				tryFireOnce(tool)
			end
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			holdingTrigger = false
		end
	end)

	-- TỐI ƯU: cache vũ khí đang trang bị (trước đây dò Character mỗi frame)
	local cachedWeapon: Tool? = nil
	local weaponDirty = true

	local function refreshWeaponCache()
		weaponDirty = false
		local char = localPlayer.Character
		cachedWeapon = if char then getEquippedGtaWeapon() else nil
	end

	localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
		weaponDirty = true
		char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
			if ch:IsA("Tool") then
				weaponDirty = true
			end
		end)
		char.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(ch)
			if ch:IsA("Tool") then
				weaponDirty = true
			end
		end)
	end)

	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if weaponDirty or (cachedWeapon ~= nil and cachedWeapon.Parent == nil) then
			refreshWeaponCache()
		end
		local tool = cachedWeapon
		if tool then
			local loc = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
			dot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(loc.X, loc.Y)
			dot.Visible = true
			if holdingTrigger and tool:GetAttribute("AutoFire") == true then
				tryFireOnce(tool)
			end
		else
			dot.Visible = false
			holdingTrigger = false
		end
	end)
end

return WeaponClient

Client.source:
--!strict

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GtaRemotes")
local hudRemote = remotes:WaitForChild("HudAction") :: RemoteEvent
local weaponRemote = remotes:WaitForChild("WeaponFire") :: RemoteEvent
local weaponSync = remotes:WaitForChild("WeaponSync") :: RemoteEvent
local weaponReload = remotes:WaitForChild("WeaponReload") :: RemoteEvent

local GtaHud = require(script:WaitForChild("UI"):WaitForChild("GtaHud"))
local VehiclePromptUI = require(script:WaitForChild("UI"):WaitForChild("VehiclePromptUI"))
local LSCustomsUI = require(script:WaitForChild("UI"):WaitForChild("LSCustomsUI"))
local WeaponClient = require(script:WaitForChild("WeaponClient"))
local GtaWeaponWheel = require(script:WaitForChild("UI"):WaitForChild("GtaWeaponWheel"))
local NPCAnimator = require(script:WaitForChild("NPCAnimator"))

GtaHud.mount(localPlayer, hudRemote)
VehiclePromptUI.mount(localPlayer)
LSCustomsUI.mount(localPlayer)
WeaponClient.mount(localPlayer, weaponRemote)
GtaWeaponWheel.mount(localPlayer, weaponSync, weaponReload)

-- Dáng đi / đứng / ngồi lái / bắn của NPC: xoay Motor6D ngay trên máy người chơi
NPCAnimator.mount()
